title: Virtual AR & Collections Specialist
description:
Role Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented, English-fluent AR & Collections Specialist based in the Philippines to manage daily invoicing and accounts receivable for two active US-based product brands. You will work directly in QuickBooks Online (QBO), create and send invoices daily out of our ERP Cin7, monitor aging reports, and professionally follow up on past-due accounts via phone,
, and written communication. This is a client-facing role that requires confident, professional English communication with US-based customers and business accounts. This is a long-term, part-time remote role with room to grow.



Key Responsibilities

Daily Invoicing

• Generate and send accurate customer invoices daily in QuickBooks Online/Cin7

• Ensure invoices reflect correct pricing, terms, quantities, and ship-to information

• Match invoices to purchase orders and sales orders as applicable

• Coordinate with operations or sales to confirm order details before invoicing

• Maintain organized digital invoice records

Accounts Receivable Management

• Monitor AR aging reports daily and flag overdue accounts proactively

• Apply customer payments accurately and in a timely manner in QuickBooks Online

• Reconcile customer accounts and resolve billing discrepancies

• Track open balances, credits, and unapplied payments across both brands

• Maintain up-to-date customer account notes and communication logs in QuickBooks / GHL

Collections & Past-Due Follow-Up

• Call on past-due accounts professionally and persistently, using a structured follow-up cadence

• Send collection
s and written notices for accounts at 30, 60, and 90+ days past due

• Negotiate payment arrangements when appropriate, within owner-approved parameters

• Escalate seriously delinquent accounts to ownership with full documentation

• Maintain a collections activity log with call notes, outcomes, and next follow-up dates

Reporting & Communication

• Provide weekly AR aging summary to ownership with status on all past-due accounts

• Flag any high-risk accounts or unusual payment patterns immediately

• Coordinate with the bookkeeper VA on month-end close and reconciliation as needed

• Communicate professionally with US-based customers via phone and
 during business hours

Requirements

• 3+ years of accounts receivable and invoicing experience (required)

• QuickBooks Desktop proficiency — must be hands-on and comfortable with daily invoicing and AR workflows

• Exceptional written and spoken English — this role involves direct phone and
 contact with US customers

• Proven experience making collection calls professionally and effectively

• Strong attention to detail — invoicing accuracy is non-negotiable

• Ability to work independently, prioritize daily tasks, and meet deadlines without micromanagement

• Comfortable working US Central Time business hours (at least partial overlap required)

• Reliable internet connection, quiet workspace, and clear phone/VoIP audio quality

• Experience supporting a US-based employer (preferred)

Nice to Have

• Experience with QBO and Cin7

• Familiarity with Amazon FBA/FBM remittances or Walmart Seller Center payouts or Synder reporting

• Background in product-based, manufacturing, wholesale, or distribution businesses

• Experience with multi-brand or multi-entity AR management

• QuickBooks Online certification or ProAdvisor status

What We Offer

• Stable, long-term part-time role with a growing US product brand

• Direct communication with ownership — no layers of management

• Clear processes and defined escalation paths so you can do your job confidently

• Flexible scheduling within US Central Time business hour overlap requirements

• Opportunity to grow hours and responsibilities over time

How to Apply

Please submit your resume along with a brief cover note (in English) describing your QuickBooks Online invoicing experience and your approach to collecting on past-due accounts. Please include any relevant examples of collection follow-up cadences or AR workflows you have managed. Applications without QBO experience and demonstrated collections experience will not be considered

title: Manager, Creator Partnerships and UGC
description:
The Manager, Creator Partnerships & UGC is the business owner of the MAG Creator Platform, My Amazon Guy’s proprietary system for managing user-generated content (UGC) and affiliate partnerships across 400+ brands.



This role oversees the platform’s success end-to-end: strategy, operations, and team growth. Working alongside the Lead Developer, the Manager ensures the product roadmap, creator network, and campaign operations scale efficiently while meeting ROI targets for MAG’s brands.



As the point leader for creator partnerships and affiliate-driven growth, the Manager will establish scalable workflows for onboarding, compliance, content approvals, payments, and reporting. By building strong creator relationships and ensuring campaign excellence, they will drive revenue and elevate content quality across the portfolio.



Key Responsibilities:

• Oversee the Creator Platform as primary business owner, aligning technical development with business objectives.

• Guide roadmap priorities and recommend feature improvements to enhance creator experience and performance tracking

• Manage the end-to-end creator lifecycle, from onboarding and content delivery to payment and compliance

• Lead campaigns and affiliate programs across 400+ brands, ensuring visibility, ROI, and tracking accuracy.

• Develop standards for creator quality, performance scoring, and brand compliance.

• Recruit and lead a high-performing operations team, establishing clear SOPs and maintaining quality assurance

• Monitor key KPIs (creator engagement, ROI, content quality) and deliver quarterly performance reports to leadership

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Developers, Brand Managers, Strategists, and Finance to align platform growth with company goals.



Qualifications:

• 5+ years in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, affiliate management, or UGC operations (agency or brand side)

• Proven success owning programs or products end-to-end — from roadmap to ops

• Deep understanding of UGC, affiliate programs, and social media ecosystems (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube)

• Comfort with analytics dashboards and data-driven decision

• Experience managing or collaborating with developers on SaaS or internal tools

• Strong leadership: able to hire, mentor, and scale a high-performing operations team

• Excellent communication, project management, and stakeholder alignment skills

description:

We are fully remote and work with high-profile creators. Results over hours. Extreme ownership. Fast decisions, zero bureaucracy.

THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF

• You have only run Instagram or TikTok and are hoping YouTube transfers over

• You need heavy oversight to hit a publishing calendar

• You are not comfortable being measured on subscriber growth and watch time



RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own YouTube end to end for assigned client channels: long-form, Shorts, SEO and analytics

• Build and execute strategies to grow subscribers, watch time and overall channel performance

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Proven track record growing YouTube channels, with specific success stories

• Portfolio and analytics that back up your results (screenshots, channel links, or case studies)

• Experience working with creators or brands on measurable growth, not just posting

NICE TO HAVE

• Exposure to Threads, Instagram Reels or TikTok for cross-platform repurposing

• Consistent publishing cadence hit with zero missed uploads

• Measurable lift in watch time and average view duration across owned channels

• Thumbnail and title testing producing a clear CTR improvement

• Clean, on-time performance reporting each week



HOURS AND JOB TYPE

Remote, open worldwide. Standard working hours are 6:00 AM to 2:00 PM EST, Monday to Friday.



WHO YOU WORK WITH

You report to the Social Media Team Managers. You will work closely with Video Editors, Scriptwriters and Thumbnail Designers to bring channels to life, and coordinate with Social Media Specialists on overall content strategy.



TOOLS

title: SEO Specialist
description:
I’m looking for an experienced Local SEO specialist to help build, optimize, and grow a portfolio of websites targeting local service markets throughout the United States.



This is a long-term role for someone who understands Local SEO beyond basic keyword placement and can independently analyze competition, optimize websites, monitor performance, and make informed decisions to improve Google rankings.



You will be provided with our internal training, processes, tools, and strategy after joining.



We will initially aim to launch approximately one new website per week while continuing to monitor and improve existing websites.



## Responsibilities



Your responsibilities may include:



* Performing local keyword research

* Analyzing Google search results and competitors

* Using Ahrefs or similar SEO tools for competitive research

* Building websites using SitePanda

* Optimizing website content for search engines

* Writing and improving title tags and meta descriptions

* Optimizing headings, page structure, URLs, and internal links

* Creating and optimizing service-related pages

* Performing on-page SEO

* Configuring domains and basic DNS settings

* Setting up call tracking and related website tools

* Connecting websites to Google Search Console

* Submitting sitemaps and monitoring indexing

* Monitoring keyword rankings and organic performance

* Building citations and relevant backlinks

* Identifying new SEO opportunities

* Creating backlinks

* Diagnosing websites that are not performing as expected

* Maintaining organized tracking of website performance



## What I'm Looking For



Strong experience with Local SEO is the most important requirement.



You should be familiar with:



* Local SEO

* Google Search Console

* Ahrefs

* Keyword research

* SERP and competitor analysis

* On-page SEO

* Internal linking

* Local citations

* Link building

* Content optimization

* Local service business websites

* Basic domain and DNS configuration

* Backlinks, backlinks, backlinks



Experience working with websites in industries such as home services, automotive services, contractors, or other local businesses is a plus.



Previous experience with SitePanda or our specific internal tools is not required. They are straightforward to learn, and training will be provided.



## What Makes a Strong Candidate



I’m looking for someone who can do more than follow an SEO checklist.



You should understand how to evaluate a search results page, identify opportunities, understand the difference between domain-level and page-level competition, and determine what changes may be necessary to improve a website's rankings.



You should also be comfortable looking at SEO data and answering questions such as:



* Why is one competitor outranking another?

* How competitive is a particular search result?

* Which pages need additional optimization?

* Where would backlinks have the greatest impact?

* What additional keywords should a website target?

* Why might a newly launched website not be gaining visibility?



I value analytical thinking and SEO judgment more than simply producing large amounts of content.



## Workload



We will initially start at approximately 10-15 hours per week.



The role will involve a combination of launching new websites and improving existing ones.



This role is at your own pace. You will not have a set schedule or work hours. As long as you get the work done, we will be happy.



## Confidentiality



You will be working with an internal website and SEO strategy that we consider confidential.



More information about our processes, market-selection methodology, training materials, and overall strategy will be provided to the selected candidate after hiring.



We are looking for someone who is comfortable working discreetly with proprietary processes and information.



## When Applying



Please answer the following:



1. How many years of Local SEO experience do you have?



2. Please describe a local business website you personally helped improve or rank.



3. What measurable results did you achieve?



4. Which SEO tools do you regularly use?



5. How do you evaluate whether a Google search result is highly competitive or relatively easy to enter?



6. If a strong domain is ranking with a relatively weak individual page, how would you interpret that?



7. What steps would you typically take during the first 90 days of SEO work on a newly launched local website?



8. What is your approach to backlinks for local websites?



9. Please provide examples of websites or SEO projects you have personally worked on, if available.



10. Start your application with the phrase "Local SEO" so I know you read the full posting.



Please do not send a generic SEO proposal. I am specifically interested in candidates with hands-on Local SEO experience who can explain their decision-making and show real examples of past results.

description:
# Ticket Fulfilment Specialist (UK & Europe)



## About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Ticket Fulfilment Specialist to join our growing ticket brokerage business.



This is not an entry-level position. We are specifically seeking someone who has worked within the ticketing industry for at least 3 years and whose most recent role involved ticket fulfilment, ticket operations, ticket brokerage, ticket resale, or a similar ticketing-focused position.



The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience managing ticket orders from purchase through to customer delivery, working across major platforms and handling high volumes of orders with accuracy and attention to detail.



## Requirements



### Essential



* Minimum 3 years of ticketing industry experience

* Most recent role must have been within the ticketing industry

* Strong understanding of ticket fulfilment processes

* Experience working with platforms such as Ticketmaster, AXS, See Tickets, Eventim, Gigs & Tours, etc.

* Experience handling mobile tickets, PDF tickets, transfer tickets and delayed delivery events

* Strong attention to detail

* Excellent organisational skills

* Ability to work independently and manage multiple orders simultaneously

* Fluent written and spoken English



### Preferred



* Experience fulfilling UK and European events

* Experience working for a ticket broker, reseller, agency or ticketing company

* Experience managing high-value orders

* Understanding of ticket resale marketplaces such as Viagogo, StubHub and similar platforms



## Key Responsibilities



* Manage ticket orders from purchase through to customer delivery

* Monitor upcoming events and fulfilment deadlines

* Chase suppliers for tickets when required

* Resolve fulfilment issues before they impact customers

* Ensure accurate ticket delivery across multiple platforms

* Communicate with internal teams regarding order status

* Maintain fulfilment records and operational reporting

* Escalate high-risk orders and potential issues proactively



## What We're Looking For



We want someone who genuinely understands ticket fulfilment and can hit the ground running.



If you need training on basic ticketing processes, this role is probably not for you.



We're looking for somebody who has already worked in a fast-paced ticketing environment, understands the pressure of event deadlines, and takes pride in ensuring customers receive the correct tickets on time.



## Location



Remote



## Application



Please include:



* Your CV

* Details of your most recent ticketing role

* The ticketing platforms you have worked with

* The countries/markets you have fulfilled for (UK, EU, USA, etc.)

* A brief summary of your ticket fulfilment experience

We manage several growing UK-based brands across technology, AI, education and specialist support services.

Our businesses already have websites, products, services and existing content. We are now looking for someone who can help us significantly improve our visibility, content, lead generation and customer acquisition.

This is not simply a social-media posting role.

We need someone who understands how to turn content and digital marketing into website traffic, enquiries, qualified leads, appointments and ultimately customers.

You will initially focus on TK Tech Digital and one additional brand. Once we have established a successful working relationship, there will be an opportunity to work across additional brands.

About TK Tech Digital

TK Tech Digital helps businesses grow and modernise through:

- Website design and development

- AI solutions and AI assistants

- Business automation

- Data dashboards and reporting

- Digital growth services

We already have completed projects and case studies. Your job will include helping us turn this work into compelling marketing campaigns that attract new clients.

Your Responsibilities

You will be responsible for helping us build and operate a consistent digital marketing and lead-generation system.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Developing monthly and weekly content calendars

- Managing Instagram, TikTok, 
 and

 marketing campaigns

 outreach

We would particularly like to hear from someone with experience in several of the following:

Digital marketing • Growth marketing • Social-media management • TikTok • Instagram • LinkedIn •

 marketing • SEO • Google Analytics • Google Search Console • CRM systems • WordPress • AI tools

Experience marketing technology, SaaS, AI, education or professional-service businesses would be particularly useful.

The Most Important Requirement

We are not looking for someone who only knows how to make attractive social-media posts.

We want someone who understands the commercial purpose of marketing.

You should be comfortable measuring:

Traffic → Leads → Enquiries → Meetings → Proposals → Customers → Revenue

There will be opportunities for increased compensation and responsibility if you perform well and help us grow.

I am particularly interested in someone looking for a long-term position, rather than somebody managing a very large number of unrelated freelance clients.

What Success Looks Like

During your first 90 days, we would expect you to help us:

- Establish a consistent content schedule

- Improve the quality and consistency of our social channels

- Turn existing projects into strong case studies

- Increase qualified website traffic

- Build targeted prospect databases

- Launch structured lead-generation campaigns

- Improve SEO visibility

- Generate genuine business enquiries

- Track where leads originate

- Identify which content and marketing channels generate the best results

You will work closely with the business owners rather than being expected to work without direction.

We have significant expertise and content available. We need someone who can help us package, distribute and market it effectively.

How to Apply

Please do not send a generic application.

Start your application with the words:

“GROWTH FIRST”

Then answer the following questions:

1. Tell us about one business you have helped grow through digital marketing. What did you personally do?

2. What measurable result did your work achieve?

3. Show us three examples of content you personally created or managed.

4. Have you generated leads through LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok,

Important

title: Administrative Assistant & Customer Support – Construction
description:
We are hiring for an Administrative Assistant & Customer Support specialist for a Sales and Operations team. You'll keep bids, proposals, change orders, and project paperwork moving, support marketing, and be a point of contact for clients. This is a remote, long-term, full-time role (40 hours a week) reporting to the Project Manager.



**Flexible hours, with a REQUIRED DAILY OVERLAP of 2PM–5PM Los Angeles time**



What You'll Do

- Track the status of all outstanding bids and client communications, flag when action is needed, and help with follow-ups

- Draft, send, and track decorative proposals and change orders, and advise the manager on follow-ups until they're signed

- Set up new projects: Create digital folders, download plans, update the calendar, and prepare files for estimation

- Request material quotes from outside suppliers

- Other administrative support as needed



MUST-HAVE SKILLS

- Detail-oriented with consistent follow-through, able to manage multiple tasks across different areas

Nice-to-Haves

- Experience with CRM online systems for sales and marketing (e.g., HubSpot)

description:

I need someone to do the first rough cut.

That’s it. No music, graphics, captions, transitions, B-roll, zooms, effects, or other creative editing. I’m looking for someone who can work quickly and accurately while preserving my original footage.



There is a significant amount of footage, so immediate availability over the next 1–4 weeks is important.



Once I finish the creative edit, there may also be an opportunity to send the project back to you for basic finishing such as audio cleanup/leveling, color or exposure correction, and final export. 



This is initially a project-based position, but I regularly create course and marketing videos, so there may be ongoing work for the right person.

- Be experienced in Adobe Premiere Pro

title: Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
About Linton Co



Linton Co is looking for a highly organized, technical, and data-driven Marketing Operations Specialist to join our growing marketing team.



This role is responsible for the technical backbone of our marketing engine. You will manage marketing technology, build landing pages and forms, create funnels and automated follow-up sequences, implement tracking and analytics, and use performance data to identify opportunities for improvement.



This is an execution-focused role. You will take an established marketing strategy and be responsible for building it accurately, ensuring everything is properly tracked, and continuously improving the systems based on performance data.



You should be someone who enjoys working inside marketing platforms, troubleshooting systems, analyzing data, and making sure the details behind a campaign are working correctly from the first click through to the final conversion.



What You Will Do

Marketing Technology & Systems



You will serve as an internal resource for our marketing technology stack, particularly GoHighLevel for B2B marketing and Klaviyo for B2C marketing.



You will maintain contact databases, lists, integrations, deliverability, and overall platform organization. You will also identify opportunities to improve our existing technology stack and recommend new tools or solutions when they can improve efficiency, tracking, automation, or campaign performance.



Funnels, Landing Pages & Automation



You will build and maintain landing pages, forms, and multi-step marketing funnels for lead generation and campaigns.



You will connect landing pages and forms to the appropriate funnels and build automated
 and SMS sequences based on funnel stages, lead behavior, and other relevant triggers.



You will make sure leads move through the funnel correctly and receive the appropriate messaging at each stage.



You will troubleshoot issues such as leads not receiving follow-up messages, incorrect tagging, broken integrations, missing data, or other funnel-related problems.



You will also work closely with the sales team to understand lead quality and lead value and use that information to improve funnel logic, automation, and lead scoring.



Tracking, Analytics & Reporting



You will manage tracking and tagging across platforms including GA4, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Tag Manager, and other relevant marketing platforms.



You will ensure conversion events, pixels, UTMs, and other tracking mechanisms are properly implemented and consistently maintained across campaigns.



You will build and maintain reporting dashboards that clearly show marketing and funnel performance.



You will create data visualizations that make it easy to understand where leads originated, how they are progressing through the pipeline, and whether those leads ultimately generated revenue.



You will work with the sales team to connect closed revenue back to the original campaign, lead source, and marketing activity whenever possible.



You will regularly audit tracking and reporting systems to identify data gaps, inconsistencies, or discrepancies and take ownership of correcting them.



You will also document funnel logic, automation workflows, tracking configurations, and recurring processes through clear SOPs so that our systems are organized and scalable.



Optimization & Testing



You will analyze marketing and funnel performance to identify friction points, drop-off areas, conversion opportunities, and other areas where performance can be improved.



You will propose and execute A/B tests involving landing pages,
s, SMS campaigns, subject lines, funnel steps, messaging, and other campaign elements.



You will monitor test results, document findings, and make data-driven recommendations for future improvements.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone with at least 2 years of experience in marketing operations, marketing automation, CRM management, funnel management, or a similar role.



You should have hands-on experience with GoHighLevel and/or Klaviyo, or comparable platforms such as HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, or Marketo.



You should have practical experience building landing pages, forms, automated workflows, and multi-step marketing funnels.



You should have a working knowledge of Google Tag Manager, GA4, Google Ads, Meta Ads, conversion tracking, pixels, and UTM tracking.



You should be comfortable working with campaign data and turning that information into specific, actionable recommendations.



Experience building dashboards and data visualizations using tools such as Looker Studio, Google Sheets, Tableau, or similar platforms is important.



You should be comfortable using AI tools to assist with building systems, analyzing data, creating reports, troubleshooting, and improving campaign performance.



Experience designing and running A/B tests is highly valuable.



Most importantly, you need to have strong attention to detail. This position is responsible for maintaining the accuracy of the marketing data and systems that the company relies on to make business decisions.



Nice to Have



Experience working with both B2B and B2C marketing campaigns is a plus.



Advanced Google Tag Manager experience, including server-side tracking, is a plus.



Basic knowledge of HTML and CSS for landing page customization is helpful.



Experience with SMS marketing and TCPA compliance is also a plus.



Who Will Succeed in This Role



The ideal candidate is technical, organized, analytical, and highly detail-oriented. You don't need to be the person creating the overall marketing strategy, but you need to be able to take a strategy and execute the technical components accurately.



You should enjoy solving problems, investigating why something is not working, working across multiple marketing platforms, and finding ways to make systems more efficient.



You should be comfortable taking ownership of projects and following through without needing constant supervision.



If you are someone who can build the system, verify that it is working, measure the results, identify what needs to improve, and implement those improvements, we would like to hear from you.



How to Apply



Please send your updated resume and portfolio to 
 portfolio should include examples of relevant marketing operations work, such as funnels, landing pages, automation workflows, dashboards, tracking implementations, campaign systems, or other projects that demonstrate your technical and analytical capabilities.



 Subject Line: LINTON MARKETING



Applications without an updated resume and portfolio may not be considered.



Please make sure your portfolio clearly shows your actual involvement in the projects you submit. We are particularly interested in seeing examples of systems you have built, marketing automation you have managed, tracking implementations, dashboards, funnel optimization, and measurable improvements you have contributed to.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Medical Virtual Assistant – Insurance, Referrals & Workers’ Comp
description:
We are a growing U.S. medical practice looking for an experienced Medical Virtual Assistant to support our Primary Care and Workers’ Compensation operations.



This is NOT a general administrative VA position. We are specifically looking for someone who has experience working with a U.S. medical practice and understands insurance verification, referrals, prior authorizations, patient scheduling, and medical records.



Primary Responsibilities:

• Confirm scheduled appointments 48 hours in advance

• Verify insurance eligibility and confirm our practice is in-network with the patient’s specific plan

• Send patient intake forms and make sure completed forms are uploaded to the chart

• Help manage Primary Care appointments, including annual physicals and chronic-care follow-ups

• Track referrals from start to finish

• Complete and follow up on prior authorizations

• Confirm patients have scheduled their specialist appointments

• Obtain specialist notes after referral visits and return them to the patient's chart/provider

• Schedule necessary patient follow-up appointments

• Maintain an active Workers’ Compensation case list

• Contact employers to obtain WC claim numbers, adjuster information and billing information

• Follow up with WC carriers, employers and our billing team regarding pending or denied claims

• Make sure employer/WC documentation is properly sent and received

• Prepare clinic staff for upcoming WC follow-up visits and employer-specific requirements

• Help fill appointment openings when patients cancel or reschedule



Who We Are Looking For:

• Previous experience working remotely for a U.S. medical practice strongly preferred

• Experience with insurance eligibility/benefits verification

• Experience with medical referrals and prior authorizations

• Workers’ Compensation experience is a major plus

• Familiarity with EMR/EHR and medical scheduling systems

• Excellent spoken and written English

• Comfortable making phone calls to patients, insurance companies, specialist offices, employers and WC carriers

• Very organized and excellent at following up on outstanding tasks

• Able to work independently and take ownership of tasks until they are completed

• Reliable internet and quiet professional work environment

• Must understand patient confidentiality and HIPAA requirements



Work Schedule:

Monday–Friday during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



Schedule & Growth Opportunity

This position will initially be part-time, Monday–Friday from 9:00 AM–1:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time (20 hours/week).  

We are looking for someone who can grow with our practice. For the right candidate who demonstrates reliability, strong communication, attention to detail, and the ability to independently manage assigned workflows, we anticipate the opportunity to transition this position to full-time (approximately 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time) Monday-Friday.



To Apply:

Please start your application with the words “MEDICAL VA.”



Please answer:

1. How many years have you worked with U.S. medical practices?

2. What types of medical practices have you supported?

3. Describe your experience verifying insurance eligibility and benefits.

4. Describe your experience with referrals and prior authorizations.

5. Have you handled Workers’ Compensation cases? If yes, what did you handle?

6. Which EMR/EHR, scheduling, and insurance systems have you used?

7. Are you comfortable making outbound phone calls during U.S. business hours?

8. What hours can you work in Eastern Time?

title: US RCM Specialist
description:
IMPORTANT:

1. Please read until the end. Specific application instructions are provided at the end of this job posting.

2. This is a specialized role. In depth expertise, knowledge, and experience of US RCM, including critical thinking and business analysis, and close working dynamics with senior leadership, are required. Only apply if you meet this criteria.



About Rocket Doctor



Rocket Doctor is a cloud-based telehealth company bringing advanced medical care into homes across North America. We are a passionate group of medical professionals, technical experts, and patient care professionals who believe everyone deserves access to quality healthcare.





About the Role



We are building our US Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) operations in-house and are looking for an experienced RCM Specialist to become one of the first members of the team.



This is a hands-on, generalist RCM role suited for someone who understands the full lifecycle of US professional billing and is comfortable working across multiple areas of the revenue cycle rather than specializing in only one function.



Because the operation is starting at a relatively small scale, the successful candidate will initially touch several areas—including eligibility, coding review, claim submission, rejections, denials, A/R follow-up, payment posting, and reconciliation. As the operation grows, these responsibilities may eventually be divided among more specialized team members.



You do not need to be an expert in every area of RCM. We are looking for someone with solid practical experience, strong fundamentals, and enough end-to-end understanding to identify issues, troubleshoot them, and help us establish reliable workflows.





Key Responsibilities



Perform insurance eligibility and benefits verification, including review of patient demographics, insurance information, coordination of benefits (COB), and payer requirements.

Review encounters for billing readiness and identify missing or inconsistent information before claim submission.

Review CPT, ICD-10, modifiers, place of service, and other claim information for general accuracy and completeness.

Perform basic coding review and escalate complex coding or documentation questions when appropriate.

Prepare and submit professional claims through a practice management system and/or clearinghouse using CMS-1500 / 837P workflows.

Monitor clearinghouse responses and correct claim rejections, validation errors, and other submission issues.

Track outstanding claims and conduct A/R follow-up through payer portals, phone calls, and other available channels.

Review denied or underpaid claims, interpret EOBs, ERAs, CARC/RARC codes, determine root causes, and take appropriate corrective action.

Correct and resubmit claims, prepare reconsiderations or appeals, and follow through until resolution.

Post insurance payments, adjustments, patient responsibility, and other transactions from 835/ERA and EOBs.

Assist with secondary billing and coordination of benefits when applicable.

Reconcile payments and identify discrepancies between claims, remittances, and expected reimbursement.

Maintain clear documentation of claim activity and follow-up actions.

Help identify recurring billing issues and recommend improvements to reduce preventable rejections and denials.

Assist in developing SOPs, job aids, checklists, and quality standards as we build the RCM operation.

Participate in quality reviews and help ensure processes are consistently followed.

Work closely with Operations, clinical teams, finance, and other stakeholders to resolve billing-related issues.

Support additional RCM functions as needed while the operation continues to grow.





Required Experience



At least 3 years of hands-on experience in US healthcare Revenue Cycle Management, medical billing, or professional billing.

Practical experience across several stages of the revenue cycle rather than experience limited to only one highly specialized function.

Experience with US outpatient and/or professional claims.

Working knowledge of:

Eligibility and benefits verification

Patient demographics and insurance validation

Coordination of Benefits (COB)

CPT and ICD-10

E/M coding fundamentals

Modifiers and place-of-service requirements

CMS-1500 / 837P claims

Clearinghouse workflows

Claim rejections and denials

A/R follow-up

EOB and ERA interpretation

CARC/RARC denial codes

835 remittance files

Payment posting and contractual adjustments

Experience working with payer portals and contacting US insurance companies regarding claim status and resolution.

Strong attention to detail and ability to identify discrepancies in claims, payments, and patient insurance information.

Strong written communication and documentation skills.

Preferred Experience

Experience supporting telehealth, primary care, outpatient physician practices, or similar professional services.

Experience working with Medicare, Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, and commercial insurance plans.

Experience with coding review or medical coding in addition to billing.

CPC, CCS-P, or another recognized coding certification is an advantage but not required.

Experience helping build or improve RCM workflows, SOPs, or QA processes.

Experience joining a new or growing RCM operation where processes were still being established.

Familiarity with practice management systems, clearinghouses, and ERA/EFT enrollment processes.





This role will be a particularly good fit for someone who:



Understands how the different parts of the revenue cycle affect one another.

Can investigate a claim problem instead of simply passing it to another department.

Is comfortable wearing multiple hats while the team is small.

Knows when they can resolve an issue independently and when specialized expertise is needed.

Enjoys building processes rather than only working within an already mature operation.

Can balance productivity with accuracy and compliance.

Is organized and comfortable keeping track of claims requiring continued follow-up.

Can recognize recurring problems and help turn solutions into repeatable processes.

Wants the opportunity to grow alongside an RCM operation as more specialized roles and leadership positions are added.





What Makes This Role Different



This is not a traditional production role where you will perform the same RCM task throughout the day.



You will be joining at the early stage of building an in-house US RCM operation, which means you will have visibility across the revenue cycle and an opportunity to help shape how the operation works.



Initially, the team will be small and responsibilities will be broad. As claim volume and the team grow, functions such as eligibility, coding, claim submission, denials, A/R, payment posting, QA, and training may eventually develop into dedicated roles.



For someone with strong RCM fundamentals and a builder mindset, this is an opportunity to play an important role in establishing that foundation.



If interested, please include a link to your updated resume as well as link to a 3-5 minute video introduction to your message/application and send it to jobs [at] rocketdoctor [d0t] io.

title: Full Cycle Bookkeeper - Experienced 5 yr +
description:
Read this entire posting before applying. If you skip to the apply button, you will be rejected automatically.

I am done wasting time and money on VAs who overpromise and underdeliver. This posting is intentionally blunt so only qualified, serious candidates apply. If you do not meet ALL of the requirements below, do not apply — you will not be considered, and applications that ignore this will be deleted without a response.

Non-Negotiable Requirements — ALL of these are deal-breakers if not met:



1 -Speak and write English clearly. If you have a thick accent or are not fluent in written and spoken English, do not apply. This is an immediate disqualifier.

2 - Be an actual, hands-on expert in bookkeeping, payroll, and HR administration. I use QuickBooks Online, Cin7 Core for inventory/COGS, QBO for AP, and QBO for payroll. If you claim experience with these tools and then have to Google how to do basic tasks once hired, this is an immediate disqualifier. You will be tested before hire — see below.

3 - Explain things simply. I am not an accountant. If I ask you a question and you can't break it down in plain language I understand right away, do not apply. I need someone who translates the technical into the simple, not someone who talks over my head.

4 - Follow instructions exactly. I have had VAs guess at what I wanted, get "creative," do work I never asked for, and then expect to be paid for it. This happens ONCE and we're done. I am open to your suggestions on better ways to do things — but only with my approval before you act. Suggest, don't assume.

5 - Do not pad your hours. I know roughly how long tasks take, and I am generous about it. If I see 15-minute tasks billed as multi-hour tasks, my generosity disappears immediately and so does the job.

6 - Show up on time, every time. I understand life happens — tell me in advance and I will be understanding. Chronic lateness or last-minute excuses (storms, internet outages, etc., without advance notice) will end this immediately. One strike.

7 - We pay via Payoneer ONLY. No exceptions. If you don't have a Payoneer account or can't set one up, do not apply. This is nonnegotiable — no PayPal, no Wise, no bank transfer, no other method.

8 - We track time using Timeproof. Mandatory, no exceptions. If you are not willing to use Timeproof for every hour billed, do not apply. This is not up for discussion.

9 - Meetings are professional — no children visible or audible on camera. These are leadership meetings. My team does not bring kids into the office, and I expect the same from you. Have children asleep, at school, or with another caregiver during our scheduled meeting times. If a child is on camera or heard in the background, the meeting will end.

10 - If I call you during paid hours, you answer. Period. No exceptions, no "I saw it but was busy." If you're on the clock, you're reachable.



What You'll Be Doing:



Full-cycle bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online — transaction coding, reconciliations, AP/AR

Inventory and COGS tracking and reconciliation in Cin7 Core

Vendor bill capture, approval routing, and payment processing through or QBO

Payroll support and coordination through Paylocity

HR administrative support — onboarding documentation, recordkeeping, basic compliance tasks

Monthly financial reporting to ownership



Application Instructions — Read Carefully:



To prove you read this far, start your application with the word LEDGER in the subject line. Applications without it will not be opened.

Confirm in your application that you have a Payoneer account, are willing to use Timeproof for every hour worked, can keep meetings child-free, and will answer calls during paid hours. If you don't confirm all four, your application will be skipped.

Include your specific hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online and/or Cin7 Core — not "familiar with," actual experience.

Include your available start date and your hourly rate expectation.

Be prepared to complete a short paid skills test before any offer is made.



This is a long-term, part-time position for the right person, with room to grow. If you meet every requirement above and can prove it, I want to hear from you. If you don't, please save us both the time.

title: Commercial Loan Processor
description:
Virtual Assistant — Debt Placement (DealRail LLC)



Full-cycle: match deals to lenders, submit packages, follow up to term sheet



About DealRail



DealRail LLC (
) is a commercial loan brokerage based in Pompano Beach, FL, serving borrowers across the U.S. We broker business-purpose loans only — DSCR, bridge, ﬁx-and-ﬂip, ground-up, SBA, mobile home park, multifamily, and other commercial programs. We are not a lender and do not handle consumer or home loans.

Founder team: Spencer Thomas (CEO), David Delgado (COO), Jonathan Reich (CTO).

We have a proprietary 231-lender research workbook with program notes, states covered, property types, loan-size ranges, and broker-friendliness ﬂags. Your job is to work that book to get deals placed.

Role overview



You will own the placement workﬂow end-to-end for each incoming loan request: intake → lender match → package → submit → follow-up → term sheet summary.

This is not a data-entry role. We need someone who understands commercial debt, can read a deal quickly, and can push lenders for answers without being pushy.

Responsibilities



1. Intake & QC — Review new applications from dealrail.co/apply for completeness. Run our document checklist, ﬂag gaps, and request missing items from the borrower.

2. Lender matching — Match each deal against the 231-lender workbook using: loan program, loan size, state, property type, and broker-friendly status. Produce a shortlist of 5–10 best-ﬁt lenders with a one-line rationale per lender.

3. Package building — Build a clean lender submission package: executive summary, sources & uses, property/borrower snapshot, and supporting docs. Keep it tight — lenders skim.

4. Submission — Submit via lender portals and
, logging every submission (date, contact, method) in our tracker.

5. Follow-up — Run a disciplined follow-up cadence (Day 1, 3, 7) until you get a decline or term sheet. Escalate hot responses to Spencer same-day.

 

6. Term sheet triage — Collect term sheets, normalize key terms (rate, LTV/LTC, fees, term, prepay, conditions) into a comparison sheet, and ﬂag the top 2–3 for Spencer.

7. Database hygiene — Keep lender notes current. Flag program changes (e.g., a lender exiting a program or being acquired) when you spot them.

Must-haves





  2+ years in commercial lending, mortgage brokering, or as a lender BDO / loan processor / broker assistant

  Working knowledge of DSCR, bridge, ﬁx-and-ﬂip, and SBA basics; mobile home park / multifamily familiarity is a plus

  Excellent written English — you will
 lenders as DealRail

  Strong Excel/Google Sheets; comfortable in CRMs and lender portals

  Organized tracker mindset: nothing slips, every follow-up has a date

  Available for overlap with U.S. Eastern business hours

Nice-to-haves



  Existing relationships with wholesale / broker-friendly lenders

  Experience with Finsight, Lender Price, or similar submission tools

  Prior VA/remote placement experience with a U.S. broker

What success looks like





  30 days: You can independently match and submit 3–5 deals/week with clean packages and zero missed follow-ups.

  60 days: You are running the full pipeline and surfacing 2–3 competitive term sheets per viable deal.

  90 days: Lender response rates and placement speed are measurably up; Spencer only touches exceptions and negotiations.

Hours & pay



  Part-time to start with a path to full-time as volume grows (to be conﬁrmed)

  Remote; U.S. Eastern hours overlap required

  Pay commensurate with commercial lending experience

How to apply



1. Send a brief intro + your commercial lending background

 

2. Complete a short paid test task: we will give you a sample deal and a slice of our lender list — you return your top 5 lender matches with rationale plus a draft outreach

3. Two references from a broker, lender, or borrower you supported



DealRail LLC handles business-purpose loans only. We do not oﬀer consumer or residential home loans.

title: Systematic Trader – Prove Your Edge, Get Backed
description:
Systematic Trader · Arkscale Ventures · Remote · Full time

Base $1,000/month (USD) + 15% of net trading profit, rising to 30% once verified + capital scaling



WHO WE ARE

Arkscale Ventures backs people who can prove what they do. We have built a research rig that tests trading strategies honestly: tick data, a strategy engine, a 24/7 paper trading bot, weekly reporting, and a review process built to catch self-deception. We have used it to reject three mentors' methods and four guru claims. We are now looking for one trader whose edge survives it.



THE ROLE

You bring a mechanical, rules-based strategy with a real track record. We run it on our rig, forward, on live prices, for 60 days with the rules frozen. If it holds, we fund it, first on a prop firm challenge, then on our capital, and you run and improve it with our research support.



WHAT YOU GET

- Base salary: $1,000 per month during the proving period.

- Profit share: 15% of net trading profit after costs during proving, rising to 30% once the strategy is verified and funded.

- Capital: prop firm funding first, then Arkscale capital as the track record grows.

- Infrastructure: data, execution bot, monitoring, reporting and an independent review process.



WHO YOU ARE

- You trade or have traded a systematic, rules-based strategy that another person could execute from the written rules alone. No discretion, no "market feel".

- You have at least 12 months of VERIFIED live results: a broker-verified Myfxbook or FX Blue track record, prop firm payout certificates, or read-only broker access. Screenshots and backtests alone will not be considered.

- You know your numbers cold: sample size, expectancy per trade after costs, maximum drawdown, worst month, and why the edge exists.

- You can explain what would break your strategy, and you have seen it fail before.

- Fluent English, comfortable working with autonomous research agents and written review.



WHAT WE WILL NOT ACCEPT

Signal sellers, course sellers, discretionary traders, strategies that cannot be written as rules, or track records we cannot verify independently. If your results depend on judgement that is not in the rules, this is not the role for you.



HOW WE CHOOSE

1. Application (below).

2. Verification: we check your track record at source.

3. Rules handover: you write the strategy as frozen, executable rules. We code it and confirm it reproduces your results.

4. 60 day forward test on our paper bot, rules frozen, live prices, real simulated costs. Salary starts here.

5. If expectancy is positive after costs over the sample, we fund the prop challenge and move to the full profit share.



HOW TO APPLY

 your answers to 
 with the subject "Systematic Trader: [your full name]".



1. Your strategy in one paragraph: market, timeframe, entry, exit, stop, position sizing.

2. A link to your verified track record and how we can check it at source.

3. Number of trades in the record, expectancy per trade after costs, max drawdown, best and worst month.

4. Why the edge exists, and what would make it stop working.

5. One strategy you used to trade and abandoned, and why.

6. Your country and time zone.

title: Operations & Client Success Manager
description:
Step 1: Set the Stage

Imagine a world where weekends belong entirely to families, not to domestic chores. Where exhausted professionals cross their thresholds into pristine sanctuaries, leaving the crushing mental load at the door. We are building that exact reality for every home in North Leeds.

Step 2: Team and Mission

You will work directly alongside our Founder at Prime Home Cleaning Ltd. You will join a mission to alleviate the severe pressures of modern life for dual-income households. Your daily impact will be measured in relationship harmony restored, cognitive decompression delivered, and weekends successfully handed back to our clients.

Step 3: Culture and Work Ethos

We operate with absolute integrity and zero hidden agendas. We protect our clients' sanctuaries with uncompromising vetting and relentless operational precision. We treat every single clean as a critical mission to restore peace of mind.

Step 4: Candidate Challenge

Do not apply if you are a mercenary simply looking to clock in and collect a paycheck. We are hunting for a true Patriot who is fiercely protective of our 5.0-star reputation and obsessed with flawless execution. Continue reading only if inside you are screaming, "HELL YEAH!"

Step 5: Role Description

a. ROLE TITLE: Operations & Client Success Manager

b. Role Summary:

You will be the operational engine and the absolute frontline of our brand. You will seamlessly merge inbound sales, empathetic customer service, and daily scheduling to ensure our "Safe Hands" promise is never compromised.

c. Mission Alignment:

You propel our mission by converting overwhelmed, skeptical prospects into relieved clients, and by ensuring our housekeeping fleet runs with pinpoint, reliable precision across West Yorkshire.

d. Role Highlights:

• Transforming exhausted prospects into loyal clients by clearly selling the value of our flat-rate "weekend reclamation" packages.

• Masterminding the Jobber scheduling board to ensure flawless daily routing and zero missed cleans.

• Acting as the empathetic, zero-judgement voice of the business when managing client enquiries and acute "mess shame" anxieties.

• Proactively driving our 48-Hour Satisfaction Guarantee, turning potential service corrections into 5-star loyalty.

• Managing the daily support and operational deployment of our strictly vetted primary housekeepers.

• Building bulletproof back-office systems that scale effortlessly with our rapid, intent-driven growth.

Step 6: Candidate Attributes

• Extreme Accountability: You own outcomes entirely. If a schedule breaks or a client is unhappy, you fix it before placing blame.

• Deep Empathy: You listen to the invisible "mental load" our clients carry and respond with total validation and zero judgement.

• Operational Precision: You treat the CRM and scheduling boards as sacred. You do not let small details slip through the cracks.

• Resourcefulness: You solve daily operational fires independently. You find the path when the standard route is blocked.

• Commercial Astuteness: You confidently communicate the value of a £127 flat-rate clean over a £14/hr cash worker without being aggressive.

• Resilience: You maintain a calm, steady demeanour when handling urgent client requests or sudden housekeeper absences.

• Absolute Integrity: You fiercely uphold our stringent vetting and security standards because you understand we are trading in trust.

• Speed: You respond to inbound quote requests and operational bottlenecks with extreme urgency.

• Immaculate Organisation: You naturally systematise chaos. You build structure where others see overwhelm.

• Clear Communication: You write and speak in crisp, reassuring British English, ensuring expectations are set perfectly.

• Radical Humility: You are entirely devoid of ego. You will do whatever dirty work is required to support the team.

• Infectious Drive: You are hungry to grow a 5-star local empire. You view our standard as the baseline, not the finish line.

title: E-commerce Operating Partner – Run Your Own Online Product Business, With Our Money Behind It
description:
E-commerce Operating Partner · Arkscale Ventures · Remote (Philippines) · Full time

Base $1,000/month (USD) + 15% profit share + path to equity



WHO WE ARE

Arkscale Ventures funds and builds new businesses. We provide the capital, the company, the systems, the finance and the discipline. We are looking for an experienced e-commerce operator to lead the launch and run a new online product business, with a real share of what we build together.



THE ROLE

You have helped build an online product business for someone else. You know what sold, why it sold, and how the machine behind it ran: product selection, suppliers, listings, ads, customer service and fulfilment. Now you lead one of your own.



You choose the opportunity, propose the business, and run it end to end: sourcing, launch, marketing, customer service and the numbers. We fund it, own the infrastructure, and review performance with you monthly. You can use a tightly budgeted specialist (designer, video editor) where needed, but you manage them. The outcome is yours to own.



WHAT YOU GET

- Base salary: $1,000 per month, paid in USD.

- Profit share: 15% of the business's operating profit, paid monthly on cleared funds once the launch budget has been recovered. The costs that count are agreed in writing up front, and you see the numbers.

- What that looks like: a business making $10,000 profit a month pays you $1,500 in profit share on top of your base. At $20,000, it is $3,000 on top.

- Equity: a path to a shareholding in the business once it reaches agreed profit targets.

- A funded launch budget, the company, store, ad accounts, payments, tools and finance, from day one.



WHO YOU ARE

- You have personally made commercial decisions in an online product business: what to sell, how to price it, where and how to advertise, which supplier to use. Not just followed instructions.

- You can show the numbers behind at least one product that made money: selling price, product cost, ad spend, return on ad spend, revenue and profit.

- You have run suppliers, fulfilment and customer service, and can manage a small team or freelancers.

- You know when to stop. You have seen products fail and can explain why.

- Fluent written and spoken English, comfortable selling to US or UK customers.



WHAT WE WILL NOT ACCEPT

Your former employer's customer lists, internal documents, private campaign data or brand assets. We are backing your skill and judgement, not someone else's files.



HOW WE CHOOSE

1. Your application (below): the numbers and the decisions you personally made.

2. A business proposal, as part of the interview: one opportunity you would launch today, with the customer, the product and what makes it different, how you would acquire customers, expected margins, cash required, and the point at which you would stop.

3. A 30 minute call to go through your proposal and your track record.

4. For the successful candidate: a funded, bounded market test. If it passes, we scale it with you.



HOW TO APPLY

 your answers to 
 with the subject "E-commerce Operator: [your full name]". Applications without specific products, numbers and decisions will not be considered.



1. One product business you helped run that made money: the product, selling price, product cost, monthly ad spend, return on ad spend, monthly revenue and profit, sales channel and supplier country.

2. Which decisions in that business were yours, and which were the founder's?

3. What ad creative or channel worked best, and why?

4. One product or launch that failed: what happened and what you learned.

5. Does that business still work today? If not, why not?

6. What would you launch tomorrow with a $3,000 test budget, and why?

7. Your country, time zone and expected start date.

8. A LinkedIn profile or a reference we can contact.

title: Piping Isometric & Spool Drawing Reviewer (Urgent)
description:
What We Need



We need an experienced piping drafter/checker to review ~60 piping isometrics and spool drawings against a 3D model. The contractor who prepared the drawings delivered poor quality — dimensions, routing, and details don't match the model.



Your tasks:



Open and measure from the 3D model (provided as .stp, .dwg, or .nwd)

Compare each isometric (PDF) against the 3D model

Mark all deviations clearly (redline / markup on the PDF)

Deliver a summary of findings per isometric



This is not a training position. You must already know how to read and interpret piping isometrics — pipe sizes, materials, weld points, supports, BOM tables, spool breaks, flow direction. We don't have time to explain the basics.



Ongoing opportunity: This type of review work comes up regularly. In the near future, spool drawing reviews will also be needed. We're looking for someone who can become our go-to person for these tasks on a recurring basis.



Requirements

Proven experience reviewing or creating piping isometrics (industrial/process piping)

Ability to work with 3D models in at least one of: STEP viewer, AutoCAD (.dwg), Navisworks (.nwd)

Familiarity with ISO 3D projection conventions for piping

Strong attention to detail

Available to start within 24–48 hours

Reliable internet and own software/licenses

How to Apply



Please include in your application:



Your hourly or per-isometric rate (salary expectation required)

2–3 references or work samples showing your experience with piping isometrics — e.g. marked-up isometrics, spool drawings you created or reviewed, or a brief description of relevant projects

A short note on which 3D file formats you can work with

Your realistic availability and turnaround time for ~60 isometrics



Applications without salary expectation and references for isometric work will not be considered.

title: Senior video-editor
description:
We are a Dutch D2C brand based in the Netherlands. We run paid video ads on Meta 
 & Instagram) for the Dutch and Belgian market. Our creatives are built around strategic concepts, and every video has one job: grab attention, hold it, and turn viewers into customers.

We're looking for a Senior Video Editor who doesn't just cut clips together, but understands why a video works.



Who We're Looking For

Someone who understands how people actually watch ads on Meta: thumb on the screen, sound often off, ready to scroll away at any second. You know how to structure a video so the viewer stays, from the first frame to the CTA.

Ideally, you can look at a script and tell us: "This part will lose people. Let's move the payoff up," or "This hook is too slow, try this instead." We value editors who bring their own ideas and actively look for ways to make our ads better.



This is NOT a role for YouTube editors, vlog editors or wedding/event editors. We need someone with real experience in performance ads for D2C brands.



What You'll Do

- Edit high-converting AI UGC videos and B-roll-driven ads for Meta (Reels, Stories, Feed)

- Structure videos for maximum retention: hook → problem → proof → solution → CTA

- Create scroll-stopping hooks in the first 1–3 seconds

- Build clear, strong CTAs that drive action

- Create and source B-roll using AI tools and stock libraries

 

Produce videos with our AI stack:

- Higgsfield for AI video and visuals

- HeyGen for AI avatars and UGC-style talking heads

- ElevenLabs for Dutch voiceovers

- Use Claude for optimising visual prompts



Give feedback on scripts: where they're too slow, unclear or weak

Create multiple variations per concept for testing (different hooks, angles and CTAs)

Add captions, motion graphics, sound design and pacing optimized for sound-off viewing



Requirements (Must-Have)

- Minimum 2 years of experience editing Meta ads for D2C / e-commerce brands. This is non-negotiable.

- A portfolio with real paid ads you've edited (Meta or TikTok ads, not organic or YouTube content)

- Deep understanding of hooks, retention, pacing, storytelling and CTAs in short-form ads

- Experience with AI UGC and comfort with tools like Higgsfield, HeyGen and ElevenLabs

- Comfortable editing videos in Dutch. You don't need to speak it, but you must work accurately with Dutch scripts, voiceovers and captions (we'll provide translations).

- Good English to communicate about briefs, scripts and feedback

- A stable internet connection and a strong editing setup



Nice to Have

- Experience with health, wellness or 45+ target audiences

- Copywriting skills for hooks and on-screen text

- Experience working with European brands

- Understanding of ad metrics (hook rate, hold rate, CTR) and how editing affects them



What We Offer

- Long-term, stable position with a growing Dutch brand

- Work with the latest AI video tools

- Your ideas are heard. We want you to think along, not just execute.

- Room to grow into a lead creative role



How to Apply

Send us:

- Your portfolio with links to paid Meta ads for D2C brands you edited

- Pick one ad from your portfolio and explain: what was the hook, how did you structure the video, and why did it work?

- Which D2C brands have you edited ads for, and for how long?

- Your experience with Higgsfield, HeyGen and ElevenLabs

- Your expected monthly salary



⚠️ Start your application with the word "RETENTION" so we know you read the full post. Applications without it will not be reviewed.

title: Operations & Compliance VA | Solar & Electrical, ServiceM8
description:
Application form:



Role Overview



Candidates with hands-on ServiceM8 and Xero experience, ideally from an Australian electrical or solar trades business, will be prioritised for this role.



An Australian solar and electrical business needs a detail-oriented, systems-driven VA to act as a right-hand person for the business owner, taking over rebate paperwork, handover documents, ServiceM8 job admin, invoicing and basic bookkeeping. This is not a sales or operations manager role — it's about making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



The VA will build up gradually, starting with simple, repetitive tasks like standardising ServiceM8 job entries, then moving into rebate applications and claims once the job flow is understood. Every task is documented as an SOP using a shadow-and-document method.



Success looks like rebates lodged and claimed as jobs are completed rather than in a monthly catch-up, handover documents sent every week, clean and consistent job information in ServiceM8, bookkeeping ready for the accountant, and the business owner freed up to focus on leads, the website and marketing.



What You'll Own



ServiceM8 Job & Schedule Administration (Your Starting Point)



Apply a standard job-entry template so every job in the ServiceM8 calendar has clear, consistent information for the crew

Use the template as a job checklist, including prompts for portal applications and paperwork

Maintain job records, notes and scheduling admin in ServiceM8

Set up automated payment reminders in ServiceM8 where required



Solar Rebates & Compliance Paperwork



Prepare and submit rebate and compliance applications through PowerCore, BridgeSelect/FormBay and Pylon portals

Lodge rebate claims and track each one through to payment

Move rebate processing from a monthly batch to a steady daily or weekly routine

Maintain a tracker of outstanding applications and claims



Job Completion & Handover Documentation



Prepare and send customer handover documents after every completed install

Run a weekly close-out to confirm all paperwork is complete for jobs finished that week

Maintain checklists so no completed job is left without its documentation



Invoicing & Bookkeeping



Issue invoices at each stage: 10% deposit, 50% before installation, and final invoice on completion

Monitor Xero for unpaid deposits and balances, particularly retailer and trade clients, and follow up as needed

Complete basic bookkeeping in Xero, including reconciliation, so records are clean and ready for the accountant

Support payroll as the role develops

title: Crypto BD Team Lead: $1,500-2,500/mo Base Pace + Uncapped Deal Bonuses (Remote)
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

- Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀



Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.



𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆



Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. IMPORTANT: Your subject line must start with BOND OPS.

2. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

3. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

4. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

5. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

6. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.
