title: Direct Response Copywriter / Creative Strategist for Ecommerce & Meta Ads
description:
Dear Professionals,



We are building a team to launch ecommerce stores and scale the strongest ones through direct response marketing on social media advertising platforms.



We are looking for an exceptional copywriter and/or creative strategist who knows how to turn customer insights into compelling ads that drive purchases.



Our ambition is big, and we want to work with people who bring sharp thinking, strong execution, and the desire to build something extraordinary through collaboration, vision, and teamwork.



Who we are looking for



You understand that great copy starts before the first sentence is written. You research the customer, identify what makes an offer compelling, and develop angles that give people a clear reason to buy.



You know how to capture attention, build desire, address objections, and turn product features into benefits customers care about.



Most importantly, you have experience writing direct response ads for ecommerce brands, particularly on Meta.



What you will do



Research products, competitors, customer reviews, desires, pain points, and buying objections.



Develop fresh advertising angles and creative concepts for different customer motivations and awareness levels.



Write compelling hooks, video ad scripts, UGC scripts, primary text, and headlines.



Give editors and creators clear direction on visuals, demonstrations, pacing, and how to bring your scripts to life.



Analyze creative performance with the team and use the findings to develop stronger iterations.



Use AI to accelerate research, ideation, and production while maintaining originality, persuasive thinking, and natural language.



Our system will rely heavily on AI for speed and volume. We need someone with the judgment to turn those capabilities into marketing that feels specific, believable, and compelling.



What makes you a strong fit



Proven experience in direct response copywriting and/or creative strategy for ecommerce.



A portfolio of paid social ads, ideally including Meta video ads.



Strong understanding of customer psychology, positioning, offers, and persuasive storytelling.



The ability to create genuinely different angles rather than endless variations of the same message.



Excellent written English and the ability to adapt your voice to different products and audiences.



Ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to explain your decisions and respond constructively to feedback.



We are especially interested in people who can combine copywriting with creative strategy. If you excel in one of these areas, please explain your strengths clearly.



Why join us?



You will have the opportunity to help shape our marketing from the beginning, see your ideas tested in real campaigns, and grow your responsibilities as the business grows.



We value initiative, thoughtful experimentation, and measurable results. If you want to do ambitious work with a team that takes performance seriously, we would love to hear from you.



How to apply



Please include:



Three to five examples of your strongest ecommerce ads or scripts, explaining your exact contribution.



Any available performance results, with context about the campaign, testing period, and spend. Please distinguish verified results from estimates.



A brief explanation of the customer insight and advertising angle behind one of your examples.



Your experience using AI in your research and creative workflow.



Your availability and expected compensation.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid practical assignment so we can evaluate your research, creative thinking, and copywriting on a real product.



Compensation will be discussed based on your experience, demonstrated skills, and scope of responsibility.



If you have the skills, ambition, and commitment to help us build and scale successful ecommerce brands, you are more than welcome to apply.



Good luck!

title: Real Estate Dispositions Coordinator Needed to Sell 20+ Houses Per Month!
description:
Dispositions Coordinator — Real Estate



Are you the person who follows a process every single day and never lets important follow-ups fall through the cracks?



Are you persistent, highly organized, resourceful, and comfortable holding people accountable to deadlines?



We’re a growing real estate investment company looking for a Dispositions Coordinator to manage our property pipeline, build buyer and JV relationships, and help move every deal successfully from contract to close.



This is not a high-pressure sales role.



This is a process, follow-up, communication, research, and execution role.



Most buyer communication happens through text and
, but you must also be confident picking up the phone when a conversation, deadline, or problem requires it.



You'll have a clear daily process to follow. We're looking for someone who executes that process consistently, keeps everything organized, follows up relentlessly, and takes ownership without needing to be reminded.



What You'll Own



Property Dispositions



* Market properties immediately after photos and property information are received

* Send
 blasts, texts, and other buyer communications for every new property

* Follow our daily marketing and follow-up process consistently

* Follow up with interested buyers until you receive a clear answer

* Schedule buyer walkthroughs and coordinate access with our transactions team

* Follow up immediately after walkthroughs for feedback and offers

* Track buyer activity, offers, property status, and next steps accurately in Podio

* Coordinate closely with our transactions team until every deal successfully closes



If a property isn't selling, you don't simply wait.



You follow the process, increase follow-up, research additional buyers, try new approaches, and communicate what you're seeing to the team.



Buyer Follow-Up & Accountability



Getting a buyer to commit to a property isn't the finish line. We need every deal to actually close.



* Stay on top of buyers after they commit to a property

* Ensure contracts, signatures, deposits, and other deadlines are completed on time

* Follow up persistently when something is outstanding

* Be friendly but firm when buyers aren't meeting agreed-upon deadlines

* Pick up the phone when text or
 isn't getting the job done

* Verify buyer funding and ability to close

* Identify potential issues early and communicate them immediately

* Maintain accurate buyer notes and profiles in Podio

* Build strong relationships with reliable buyers



You should be comfortable sending the second, third, or fourth follow-up when necessary.



We are always respectful, but we don't allow important deadlines to drift because we're afraid to follow up.



Build Our Buyer Network



One of the most important parts of this role is continually expanding our network.



We want someone who naturally asks:



"Who else could buy this property?"



* Add a minimum of 10 new qualified buyers or real estate professionals to our database every day

* Research active cash buyers, investors, landlords, flippers, builders, agents, and other potential buyers

* Use online research, public records, social media, networking, and other creative methods to uncover new relationships

* Research who is actively purchasing similar properties in our markets

* Maintain and improve our VIP buyer list

* Keep buyer profiles accurate and useful

* Build genuine relationships with buyers instead of simply collecting contact information



We're looking for someone with a knack for research and thinking outside the box.



If one approach doesn't work, you should naturally want to find another.



Build JV Partner Relationships



We also want this person constantly expanding our network of wholesalers and other real estate professionals who have deals we can help sell.



* Continually identify and reach out to new potential JV partners

* Build relationships with wholesalers, investors, agents, and other deal sources in our markets

* Research active wholesalers and investment companies we aren't currently working with

* Introduce our company and explain how we can help them successfully disposition their properties

* Follow up consistently with potential JV partners instead of contacting them once and forgetting about them

* Maintain relationships with existing JV partners so they continue bringing us opportunities

* Track JV conversations, relationships, opportunities, and follow-ups in our CRM

* Look for creative new ways to find wholesalers and partners with deals we can help sell

* Consistently work toward bringing new JV opportunities into our pipeline



The goal isn't simply to maintain the relationships we already have. We want someone who is continually creating new relationships that can produce more deals for the company.



Follow the Process — Every Day



This may be the most important part of the job.



We have systems and processes that work. We need someone who follows them consistently without needing to be chased.



* Follow the daily dispositions checklist and workflow

* Complete every scheduled buyer and JV follow-up

* Update Podio after every meaningful interaction

* Keep every active property's status and next action current

* Respond quickly to messages, calls, and
s during business hours

* Submit an accurate EOD report every day

* Track offers received, properties sold, days to sell, deposits received, new buyers added, and JV activity

* Communicate problems early instead of waiting until they become emergencies



You won't need someone to create your to-do list every morning. The process already exists. Your job is to execute it exceptionally well.



You're the Right Fit If You



* Are extremely organized and process-driven

* Follow checklists and systems consistently without being reminded

* Are persistent with follow-up

* Communicate clearly and professionally through text,
, and phone

* Are comfortable picking up the phone when necessary

* Can be firm without being rude

* Don't feel uncomfortable following up multiple times when something is outstanding

* Keep your CRM clean and accurate

* Take ownership instead of waiting for instructions

* Love researching and figuring things out

* Enjoy finding and developing new relationships

* Naturally look for alternative solutions when the obvious answer isn't working

* Can manage multiple active deals and deadlines simultaneously

* Communicate proactively without leadership having to chase you

* Move with urgency while still paying attention to details

* Have experience in real estate, wholesaling, dispositions, coordination, customer service, or operations

* Are available Monday–Friday during EST business hours



You Are NOT the Right Fit If You



* Need constant direction to know what to do next

* Follow a process for a few days and then stop

* Send one follow-up and consider your job done

* Are afraid to hold someone accountable to a deadline

* Avoid phone conversations even when a call would solve the problem faster

* Skip CRM updates or treat reporting as optional

* Wait for someone else to solve problems

* Struggle to research and find information independently

* Aren't comfortable proactively reaching out and developing new relationships

* Get overwhelmed managing multiple priorities at once

* Let small problems become big problems because you didn't communicate them



Our Core Values



We are a faith-driven team that moves with speed and precision, communicates obsessively, treats everyone with kindness, and outworks everyone around us.



We believe you can be kind without being passive, persistent without being disrespectful, and independent without ignoring the process.



If that resonates, you'll fit in well here.



Compensation



* Competitive base salary paid weekly

* Monthly team closing bonuses

* Weekly bonus opportunities

* Real growth potential as we continue scaling

* We promote from within when people consistently perform



To Apply



Submit the following:



1. Your resume

2. A 2–3 minute video introduction telling us who you are, your background, and why you believe this role fits you



Don't read us a script. We want to see how you naturally communicate and get a feel for who you are.



Upload your video to Loom, YouTube (unlisted), or Google Drive and include the link.



Applications without a video will not be considered.

title: Video Editor Wanted - VSL + Direct Response Ads for Mens Health Brand
description:
About us



We're a fast-growing DTC men's health brand selling supplements online. We spend real money on
 and Instagram ads every month, and video is what drives our sales. We need an editor who understands that every edit has one job: keep the viewer watching and get them to buy.



This is not a YouTube, wedding, or corporate video role. If you've only edited vlogs or cinematic travel content, this probably isn't the right fit.



What you'll be editing



Direct response video ads for
/Instagram (15–90 seconds): UGC-style talking heads, skits, animated explainers, and B-roll-driven voiceover ads

VSLs (video sales letters), 5–20 minute long-form videos where B-roll has to change every few seconds to hold attention

Multiple hook variations of the same ad (we test 3+ hooks per script)

Ads built from AI-generated footage (clips from tools like Seedance, Kling, and Higgsfield), which means stitching clips together, fixing inconsistencies, and compositing product labels/packaging in post



How we work



Every project comes with a written brief, a script, and an "inspo" reference ad. Your job is to study the reference closely (pacing, cut frequency, caption style, B-roll choices) and match that energy for our product. We care about structural accuracy to the reference more than your personal creative style.



Must-haves



2+ years editing short-form ads (not just organic content)

A portfolio that includes at least some paid social ads. Supplements, health, fitness, or beauty is a big plus

Strong in Premiere Pro or CapCut Desktop; After Effects is a plus

Fast, punchy pacing with no dead air, and pattern interrupts every few seconds

Clean, readable captions in the style we specify (bold, animated, keyword-highlighted)

Able to source good stock and B-roll footage quickly

Good written English. You'll be reading detailed briefs and need to follow them exactly

Reliable internet and the ability to deliver 3–5 ad variations per day once you're up to speed



Nice-to-haves



Experience editing VSLs or long-form sales videos

Experience working with AI-generated video or images

Motion graphics and basic animation

Understanding of why certain ads convert (hooks, retention, CTAs)

Sound design and music selection that matches the ad's tone



Pay and hours



Full-time, 40 hours/week

title: Logistic Assstant
description:
Position Summary



The Campaign Operations and Logistics Coordinator is responsible for monitoring the daily delivery and inventory activities associated with customer campaigns. The role ensures that campaign orders are dispatched, transported, received, and fulfilled according to schedule while maintaining accurate visibility of stock availability by product and SKU.



The coordinator works closely with suppliers, warehouses, third-party logistics providers, transport partners, customer contacts, and internal campaign teams to identify risks, resolve missing information, and escalate delivery or inventory issues before they affect campaign execution.



Key Responsibilities



Delivery Tracking and Coordination*



Review all planned campaign deliveries daily.

Confirm the status of each delivery, including booked, dispatched, in transit, delivered, delayed, or awaiting confirmation.

Verify supplier dispatch dates and shipping documentation.

Confirm that transport has been booked and assigned.

Check customer warehouse booking dates and delivery slots.

Monitor estimated arrival times and identify deliveries at risk of missing scheduled slots.

Confirm warehouse or third-party logistics receipt of delivered and inbound goods.

Obtain proof of delivery or warehouse receipt confirmation when required.

Record the current status, risks, responsible contact, and next action for every delivery.

Follow up with suppliers, transport providers, warehouses, and customers regarding missing or conflicting information.



Inventory Monitoring*



Review daily stock levels for all campaign products and SKUs.

Monitor available, reserved, inbound, blocked, damaged, quarantined, and unavailable inventory.

Compare available and incoming inventory against open orders and planned deliveries.

Confirm that reserved inventory is allocated to the correct customer orders.

Track inbound stock quantities and expected arrival dates.

Verify that warehouse or third-party logistics inventory records are current.

Investigate discrepancies between system inventory and warehouse-confirmed stock.

Determine whether upcoming deliveries can be fulfilled using available or confirmed inbound inventory.

Identify and escalate potential shortages before they affect fulfilment.



Risk Management and Escalation*



Classify delivery and inventory activities as on track, at risk, blocked, or missing information.

Escalate issues on the same day when delivery, booking, dispatch, transport, warehouse receipt, or stock availability is unclear.

Raise delivery risks when transport is not booked, dispatch dates are unconfirmed, warehouse slots are missing, or delivery timing is at risk.

Raise inventory risks when available stock is insufficient, inbound stock is delayed, reserved quantities do not match demand, or stock is blocked or damaged.

Coordinate corrective actions with the appropriate supplier, warehouse, transport provider, customer, or internal owner.

Maintain clear ownership and target completion dates for unresolved actions.



Reporting and Task Management*



Maintain accurate campaign delivery and inventory trackers.

Update campaign tasks and follow-up actions in Asana or another designated project management system.

Prepare a daily end-of-day logistics update covering:

Deliveries reviewed

Inventory and SKUs checked

On-track deliveries

Delayed or at-risk deliveries

Stock shortages or discrepancies

Missing confirmations or information

Escalations completed

Outstanding actions and priorities for the following day

Provide campaign stakeholders with timely and accurate operational updates.

Maintain organized records of communications, confirmations, risks, and resolutions.



Required Qualifications

Previous experience in logistics coordination, supply chain operations, inventory management, order fulfilment, campaign operations, or a related field.

Experience working with suppliers, warehouses, transport providers, or third-party logistics partners.

Strong understanding of delivery tracking, warehouse bookings, inventory allocation, and order fulfilment processes.

Ability to review operational information and identify risks, inconsistencies, and missing confirmations.

Strong organizational and follow-up skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to manage multiple orders, products, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.

High level of accuracy and attention to detail.

Proficiency in spreadsheets, project management platforms, and inventory or order management systems.

Ability to work independently and escalate urgent issues appropriately.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting customer campaigns, retail promotions, product launches, or time-sensitive fulfilment activities.

Familiarity with Asana or a similar task management platform.

Experience working with warehouse management, transport management, enterprise resource planning, or inventory management systems.

Knowledge of proof-of-delivery processes, customer warehouse booking requirements, and third-party logistics operations.

title: AI Video Editor / AI Filmmaker for DTC E-commerce Brand
description:
We are a growing DTC e-commerce company looking for a **full-time Video Editor with strong AI video generation skills**.



AI content creation is the priority. You should be able to create high-quality AI footage across different styles, then turn that footage into polished, fast-paced ads.



What You'll Create



We produce AI video in styles including:



- **Ultra-realistic:** footage that is extremely difficult to distinguish from real video

- **Claymation**

- **Pixar-style / high-end 3D animation**

- **3D medical, anatomical, X-ray and skeleton visuals**

- **AI-generated B-roll**

- Other creative AI visual styles as concepts require



We have one important rule:



AI should either look extremely realistic OR deliberately stylized and clearly artificial.



We do **not** want the uncanny middle ground where footage is supposed to look real but obviously looks AI-generated.



What We Need From You



You should be able to:



- Generate high-quality AI video and images

- Work with the latest AI models and quickly learn new ones

- Follow detailed creative briefs accurately

- Turn around work quickly and reliably

- Create multiple variations from your own work

- Iterate quickly when we find a concept, visual or ad that performs

- Work independently and suggest better creative solutions when appropriate

- Edit complete advertisements when needed



Our target production volume is approximately **5–7 videos per week**, including variations of existing videos.



Editing Skills



AI generation is the priority, but you should also be comfortable with:



- Cutting and assembling ads

- Strong pacing

- Animated captions

- Basic motion graphics

- Minor VFX

- Sound effects and sound design

- Music

- Transitions

- Colour correction/grading

- Stabilisation and footage cleanup



Premiere Pro and After Effects experience is preferred, especially because we need complete editable working files.



AI Tools



You should be comfortable working across the current generation of leading AI tools rather than depending on only one platform.



Our current workflow includes tools such as:



- Higgsfield

- Seedance

- Nano Banana

- ChatGPT

- Claude

- ElevenLabs



Experience with other leading video/image generation models such as Kling, Veo, Runway, Sora, ComfyUI or similar tools is a plus.



We can provide required subscriptions when necessary, but **we prefer someone who already has an established AI production workflow and their own tools/subscriptions.**



The same applies to stock footage, music and asset subscriptions.



File Delivery



We care strongly about organised, reusable source material.



For completed work, you may be required to provide:



- Final export **with music and captions**

- Final export **without music and captions**

- Clean AI-generated footage

- Clean source footage/selects, trimmed, stabilised, colour-graded and ready for reuse

- Premiere/After Effects or other project files

- All project assets

- Prompts and generation settings

- Source/reference images

- Music and SFX files

- Editable captions



Your work should be organised so another editor can easily open the project and continue working from it.



Who We're Looking For



You do not need to have 10 years of experience.



We care more about someone who is:



- Hard-working

- Fast

- Reliable

- Available full-time

- Detail-oriented

- Good at following instructions

- Able to learn new AI tools very quickly

- Comfortable receiving feedback

- Able to create variations quickly

- Interested in continuously improving their AI generation skills



Strong previous experience is preferred, but a highly capable intermediate editor who learns extremely quickly is also welcome.



There is **no requirement to work Netherlands/European hours**. You can work according to your normal schedule as long as communication and delivery are reliable.



Application



Start your application with the word: SWEET!



Then answer these questions:



1. How long have you been working with AI video generation?

2. Which AI video and image-generation tools do you currently use?

3. Which AI/software subscriptions do you personally already have?

4. Which editing software do you use?

5. Which stock footage, music or asset subscriptions do you have?

6. Can you provide complete editable project files and source assets?

7. How many videos could you realistically produce per working day?

8. Send your **best examples of photorealistic AI video**.

9. Send your **best examples of stylized/animated AI video**.

10. Send examples of **medical/anatomical/3D AI visuals**, if available.

11. Send examples of your normal video editing work.

12. Tell us briefly about one AI video you created: which tools did you use and what parts did you personally create?



Please send **specific examples of your own work**, not a large generic portfolio.



Shortlisted applicants will first complete a **small test**, followed by a paid full assignment if successful.



This is a full-time position with the potential for long-term work.

title: YOUTUBE ADS EXPERT
description:
YOUTUBE ADS EXPERT

Full-Time | Remote | WRK Marketing

Starting Pay: $1,000/month

Schedule: 40 hours/week, Monday to Friday

Location: Remote



================

THE SHORT VERSION

================



You will be the YouTube Ads Expert for an Inc. 5000 performance marketing agency. You'll build, launch, and scale YouTube ad campaigns that drive real sales and leads for our clients, not just views.



If you know why one campaign gets cheap views but no conversions while another prints profitable customers, and you can tell within the first five seconds of an ad whether it's going to work, keep reading.



If you are looking for a brand awareness role where success is measured in impressions, this is not that job...



===================

ABOUT WRK MARKETING

===================



WRK Marketing is a performance marketing agency serving ecommerce and lead generation clients across the US. We build marketing systems, launch campaigns, improve funnels, manage paid traffic, produce creative, test offers, and grow revenue for our clients. We move fast. Priorities shift. YouTube is one of our biggest growth channels, and we need someone who can own it.



========================

WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO

========================



Your job is to turn YouTube into a profitable, scalable acquisition channel across multiple client accounts.



In a typical week, you might:



- Build and launch YouTube campaigns in Google Ads, including Demand Gen, in-stream, in-feed, Shorts, and video within Performance Max

- Structure campaigns, ad groups, and audiences for clean testing and efficient scaling

- Build and test audiences, including custom segments, customer match, remarketing lists, lookalikes, and placement targeting

- Manage bidding strategies and budgets, including tCPA, tROAS, and Maximize Conversions, and make scaling decisions based on the data

- Set up and audit conversion tracking with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and enhanced conversions so the numbers are right before we spend

- Analyze performance daily: view rate, CPV, CTR, CPA, ROAS, and view-through conversions, and act on what you see

- Give the creative team specific direction on hooks, ad length, structure, and CTAs based on what's working in the account

- Plan and run creative tests so every campaign produces clear learnings

- Work with strategists, editors, and landing page teams to make sure the full path from ad to conversion is tight

- Write clear performance updates for clients and internal teams

- Keep campaigns and tasks organized in ClickUp so nothing stalls and nobody has to ask for status



The mix changes based on client needs and launch schedules. Flexibility is part of the job description.



=====================

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

=====================



PROVEN YOUTUBE ADS EXPERIENCE

You've managed real budgets on YouTube and can show results. You know Google Ads inside and out, and you understand how YouTube campaigns behave differently from search and from Meta.



DIRECT-RESPONSE MINDSET

You measure success in sales, leads, CPA, and ROAS. You know the difference between a view that looks good in a report and a view that turns into a customer.



CREATIVE INSTINCT

You understand what makes a YouTube ad work: a hook that stops the skip, a clear problem and solution, proof, and a strong CTA. You can look at an ad and tell the creative team exactly what to change.



TRACKING AND DATA SKILLS

You can set up and troubleshoot conversion tracking, spot bad data, and read attribution with a critical eye, including view-through conversions.



EXCELLENT COMMUNICATION

You can explain what's working, what's not, and what you're doing next in four sentences. You write clear updates for clients and the team. You ask sharp questions instead of guessing.



GENUINE OWNERSHIP

You check your accounts without being reminded. You catch a spending problem before it becomes an expensive one. You don't wait to be told what's next.



STRONG PLUSES

Agency experience. Experience scaling ecommerce or lead gen brands on YouTube. Experience with Google Search and Shopping. Experience managing multiple client accounts at once.



======================

TOOLS YOU MIGHT TOUCH

======================



Google Ads, YouTube Studio, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Merchant Center, Looker Studio, ClickUp, Slack, Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Sheets), Shopify, GoHighLevel or similar CRMs, reporting dashboards, and AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude.



Hands-on experience with Google Ads video campaigns, GA4, and Google Tag Manager is a major advantage.



==========================

SCHEDULE, PAY, AND BENEFITS

==========================



- Full-time remote, Monday through Friday

- 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time, with a one-hour lunch (40 hours per week)

- $1,000/month



Please only apply if you can consistently work Eastern Time hours and the pay works for you.



==============

HOW TO APPLY

==============



Send all three of the following. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.



1. YOUR RESUME

2. PROOF OF WORK

Case studies, campaign results, screenshots of account performance, or examples of YouTube campaigns you've built and scaled. Spend levels, CPA, and ROAS numbers are a big plus.

3. A PERSONALIZED VIDEO INTRODUCTION, 2 TO 3 MINUTES



In your recording, please tell us:

* Why we should hire you

* Your experience running YouTube ads, your approach, including budgets and results

* Why you are the right fit for this role



The recording does not need to be fancy. We just want to hear from you directly.

Applications missing any of the three required items will not be reviewed.

We move quickly with strong candidates. If this sounds like you, apply now!

title: QA Legal Assistant
description:
About the Opportunity



Are you a detail-driven legal professional with an exceptional eye for accuracy and a commitment to getting every detail right?

We are seeking a QA Legal Assistant to serve as a critical quality-control resource within our legal department. This role is ideal for someone who naturally catches inconsistencies, notices missing details others overlook, and takes pride in producing accurate, organized, and compliant work.

As a QA Legal Assistant, you will work behind the scenes to review, verify, and audit legal documentation, case files, administrative workflows, and critical deadlines before information moves forward.

Your attention to detail will help protect the firm from preventable errors, maintain compliance standards, and ensure our attorneys and legal teams have accurate information they can rely on.

If you thrive in an environment where precision, organization, consistency, and accountability matter, this could be an excellent opportunity for you.



Key Responsibilities



Legal Document Quality Control

- Review, proofread, and audit legal filings, contracts, correspondence, and other legal documents for accuracy and completeness.

- Verify names, dates, case information, attachments, citations, formatting, and other critical details.

- Maintain a high standard of accuracy and ensure documents are ready for submission or attorney review.

- Identify discrepancies, omissions, inconsistencies, and potential errors before they reach the next stage of the process.



Workflow & Compliance Audits

- Perform ongoing quality assurance reviews of specialized administrative workflows, including withdrawal-focused operations.

- Verify that required procedures, documentation, approvals, and compliance requirements are consistently followed.

- Identify process gaps and escalate issues that require attorney or management attention.

- Help maintain consistent quality standards across recurring workflows.



Case File & Data Auditing

- Conduct regular audits of digital case files, databases, and document management systems.

- Verify that records are complete, accurately categorized, properly documented, and organized.

- Identify missing or inconsistent information and coordinate corrections when necessary.

- Help ensure files remain organized and audit-ready.



Calendar & Deadline Verification

- Review department calendars and filing schedules for accuracy.

- Verify that court deadlines, discovery dates, follow-ups, and other critical dates are properly documented and tracked.

- Identify potential scheduling discrepancies or missing deadlines and promptly escalate concerns.



Case Information & Intake Review

- Review factual summaries, case notes, intake information, and supporting documentation for accuracy.

- Verify information before it is escalated to attorneys, clients, or external stakeholders.

- Ensure information is consistent across relevant systems and documents.



Qualifications & Requirements

- Minimum 1 year of experience in a legal environment.

- Experience with legal proofreading, quality assurance, compliance reviews, document auditing, or similar responsibilities.

- Associate's degree or equivalent professional administrative/legal experience.

- Strong understanding of legal procedures and administrative workflows.

- Experience reviewing or auditing withdrawal-focused workflows under strict compliance requirements is highly valued.

- Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to identify small errors, inconsistencies, and missing information.

- Highly organized with strong process-following and documentation skills.

- Excellent written English and proofreading abilities.

- Ability to work independently while maintaining consistent quality and productivity.

- Strong judgment when handling confidential and attorney-client privileged information.

- Comfortable working with digital case management systems, databases, document management platforms, and remote-work technology.

- Ability to consistently meet deadlines while maintaining a high standard of accuracy.



What Makes This Role Important

Quality control is more than proofreading—it is a critical part of protecting the integrity of our legal operations.

In this role, you will help ensure that the right information is in the right place, deadlines are accurately tracked, documents are complete, and processes are followed correctly.



Your work will provide attorneys and legal teams with greater confidence that the information they rely on has been carefully reviewed and verified.



Schedule

Monday–Friday | 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST

Fully Remote





How to Apply

Please submit your resume highlighting your experience in legal quality control, compliance, proofreading, document review, case management, or administrative auditing.



Candidates with a strong track record of accuracy, organization, and attention to detail are encouraged to apply.

title: Remote Director of Maintenance
description:
Green Ocean Property Management is a growing property-management organization serving residential rental and condominium/HOA portfolios, supported by related service businesses. Our maintenance operation must deliver fast, reliable service while controlling quality, labor, vendor capacity, billing, and client expectations.

Position Summary

The Maintenance Director is the senior functional leader responsible for maintenance performance across Green Ocean Property Management and Pro Services Boston. Reporting to the COO, this person owns service levels, field-team people management, project and coordination workflows, vendor capacity, department financial performance, and the systems required to deliver consistent work.

This is not primarily a dispatcher, technician, or individual project-manager role. The Director leads the maintenance function through clear scorecards, documented processes, direct management of the field team, and defined responsibilities for the Field Operations Specialist, Project Manager / Estimator, and Maintenance Coordination Team. The right person will make maintenance predictable, profitable, and less dependent on the CEO or COO for daily decisions.

Core Outcomes

Reliable service response: Emergency and routine requests are acknowledged, scheduled, and completed against approved service levels.

Controlled backlog: Every open item has a clear owner, status, next action, and escalation path; aged work is reduced and kept within approved limits.

Profitable maintenance delivery: Labor, vendor cost, billing completeness, project margin, and rework are measured and actively managed.

Consistent field quality: Inspections, workmanship standards, documentation, callbacks, and quality reviews are built into the operating process.

Clear people accountability: Field staff receive direct expectations, coaching, performance follow-up, and capacity planning from the Maintenance Director.

Scalable systems: Intake, coordination, project delivery, field execution, vendor management, and owner/property-manager handoffs are documented and repeatable.

Key Responsibilities

Maintenance Operations Leadership

Own the maintenance operating system from request intake through scheduling, field execution, documentation, billing handoff, and closeout.

Set emergency and routine service levels, escalation rules, quality standards, and communication expectations.

Run weekly maintenance operating reviews covering backlog, aging, scheduled work, emergencies, callbacks, staffing, vendor capacity, and financial performance.

Ensure the Maintenance Coordination Team maintains accurate work-order status, scheduling, resident communication, vendor communication, and after-hours handoffs.

Hold the Project Manager / Estimator accountable for scopes, estimates, schedules, project delivery, change control, documentation, and project margins.

Use the Field Operations Specialist for inspections, technical troubleshooting, difficult jobs, field recommendations, and workmanship checks without assigning people-management duties to that role.

Maintain complete, decision-ready records in PropertyMeld, Buildium, approved trackers, and related source systems.

Field Team and People Leadership

Directly manage field staff, including performance expectations, schedules, coaching, attendance, discipline, development, and staffing decisions.

Define required skills, productivity expectations, quality standards, safety practices, and documentation requirements for each field role.

Build labor and vendor capacity plans that match seasonal demand, portfolio growth, emergency coverage, and project commitments.

Identify performance issues early, document expectations, and complete timely follow-up rather than allowing unresolved problems to move upward to the COO.

Create practical onboarding and training plans for field staff, coordinators, estimators, and vendors.

Maintain a span of control that is workable at current headcount and recommend another frontline leadership seat only when workload and staffing data justify it.

Financial and Vendor Leadership

Own the maintenance budget, labor plan, vendor plan, gross-margin review, billing completeness, and material cost controls.

Ensure all billable labor, materials, vendor costs, estimates, approvals, and change orders are documented and handed to Finance on time.

Review vendor performance, pricing, availability, insurance requirements, service quality, and replacement risk.

Partner with Finance to reconcile operational activity with billing, payroll, vendor bills, receivables, and department reporting.

Identify unprofitable work types, repeated callbacks, underbilling, capacity gaps, and process failures, then bring a corrective recommendation to the COO.

Executive and Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as the COO's accountable leader for maintenance outcomes and risks.

Coordinate with Property Operations, Leasing, Customer Success, On Ramp, Finance, and Systems/Data on handoffs that cross departments.

Convert maintenance data into a short executive do-list with an owner, deadline, metric, and expected business effect.

Build and maintain maintenance playbooks for routine work, emergencies, projects, inspections, vendor use, resident communication, and billing handoff.

Identify risks early and bring a recommendation, not only a problem, to the COO and CEO.

Decision Authority and Boundaries

The Maintenance Director is expected to improve routine maintenance processes, manage staff and vendors, enforce approved controls and deadlines, assign work, resolve routine escalations, and make day-to-day operating decisions within approved policies and budgets.

The Director prepares evidence-based recommendations for executive approval on material unbudgeted commitments, senior hires or terminations, major vendor changes, significant pricing or policy changes, legal or safety matters, and other decisions reserved for the COO or CEO. The Director owns maintenance management and results. The role should not depend on personally performing routine field work or redoing coordinator and project-manager tasks.

Proposed Scorecard

Final targets should be confirmed during the first 30 days after reviewing the current baseline.

Emergency and routine service requests meet approved acknowledgment, scheduling, and completion standards.

Aged work orders remain within approved limits, and every material exception has an owner, next action, and date.

Scheduled work, field productivity, project delivery, and vendor capacity are reported weekly.

Billing documentation, labor, material, estimate, approval, and change-order records are complete and timely.

Callbacks, rework, quality defects, safety issues, and repeated failures are measured and reduced against baseline.

Field staff, the Project Manager / Estimator, Field Operations Specialist, and Maintenance Coordination Team deliver their scorecards without the Director redoing their work.

First 90 Days

First 30 Days - Diagnose and Establish Control

Review the maintenance organization, open roles, direct-report capabilities, workload, current vendors, and existing scorecards.

Assess PropertyMeld data, backlog, aging, emergencies, callbacks, projects, estimates, billing handoffs, margin reporting, and field capacity.

Confirm decision rights for the Field Operations Specialist, Project Manager / Estimator, Maintenance Coordination Team, and field staff.

Identify material client, safety, staffing, vendor, financial, and key-person risks.

Agree with the COO on the final scorecard, reporting cadence, approval limits, and escalation rules.

Days 31-60 - Install the Operating Cadence

Launch one weekly maintenance operating review and one monthly financial and capacity review.

Publish service levels, backlog definitions, escalation rules, quality checks, and communication standards.

Implement direct-report scorecards and regular one-on-ones.

Create the field and vendor capacity plan and assign owners to the highest-risk gaps.

Document the required workflow from intake through billing handoff and closeout.

Days 61-90 - Demonstrate Independent Execution

Run a complete maintenance operating cycle without relying on the CEO or COO for daily decisions.

Show measurable movement in aged backlog, scheduling reliability, quality, billing completeness, and team accountability.

Present a 12-month maintenance improvement plan ranked by business impact, risk, effort, cost, and owner.

Demonstrate that field staff and supporting roles operate against clear metrics and decision rights.

Required Qualifications

Significant progressive experience leading maintenance, facilities, construction service, field operations, or a comparable multi-site service function.

Proven people-management experience, including performance expectations, coaching, discipline, hiring, staffing, and direct accountability for a field team.

Working knowledge of work-order operations, emergency response, estimating, project delivery, vendor management, quality control, and safety practices.

Experience owning a department budget, labor capacity, vendor cost, billing completeness, and operating metrics.

Ability to distinguish technical expertise from people leadership and assign each responsibility to the correct role.

Strong written and verbal communication, follow-through, documentation, and comfort holding staff, vendors, and peers accountable.

Experience with property-management, maintenance-management, scheduling, reporting, and collaboration systems.

Ability to lead a distributed team across field and remote functions.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in residential property management, condominium/HOA management, multifamily operations, or an in-house maintenance business.

Experience with PropertyMeld, Buildium, QuickBooks Online, Google Workspace, and workflow or reporting automation.

Experience improving response time, backlog aging, gross margin, billing completeness, vendor capacity, callbacks, or field productivity with measurable results.

Relevant trade, construction-management, facilities, project-management, or safety qualification.

Benefits and Time Off

Benefits for this full-time role include:

Health insurance: Employer-sponsored health coverage. Eligibility, plan terms, and the employer contribution are governed by the applicable benefit plan and offer letter.

Paid time off (PTO): 15 paid days annually, subject to company policy.

Paid sick time: 5 paid days annually, subject to company policy and applicable law.

Paid holidays, subject to the company holiday calendar.

Leadership Profile

Leads through clear outcomes rather than constant task supervision.

Creates practical controls without unnecessary bureaucracy.

Uses source data before drawing conclusions and distinguishes urgent work from high-value work.

Solves recurring problems through ownership, process, and systems.

Coaches people while holding a firm performance standard.

Communicates bad news early, plainly, and with a recommended next step.

Equal Opportunity

Green Ocean Property Management is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. Employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without unlawful discrimination.



Internal Hiring Note

Because this role directly manages field staff and leads several specialized functions, the hiring process should test people leadership, maintenance operations, financial judgment, vendor management, and the ability to build systems without personally taking over every task. Technical maintenance knowledge without proven people accountability is not sufficient.

Role Performance Metrics

Primary scorecard. Targets are recommended starting points and should be confirmed against the current baseline during the first 30 days.

#

Metric

Target

Measurement source

1

Emergency response control

100% of emergency requests acknowledged within the approved emergency SLA; every missed SLA has a documented cause and corrective action.

PropertyMeld emergency reports and escalation log.

2

Aged backlog control

100% of work older than the approved aging threshold has an owner, next action, and due date; aged backlog improves against the confirmed baseline.

PropertyMeld backlog and aging reports.

3

Schedule reliability

At least 90% of scheduled work is completed by the promised date, excluding documented access, approval, or scope-change delays.

PropertyMeld schedule, completion records, and exception reasons.

4

Billing and margin control

100% of billable labor, materials, vendor costs, approvals, and change orders are documented and submitted on time; department margin is reviewed monthly.

PropertyMeld, time records, vendor bills, Buildium, and finance reporting.

5

Quality and team accountability

Callbacks and rework remain within the approved target; 100% of required scorecards, one-on-ones, reviews, and documented performance follow-ups are completed on time.

Quality reviews, callback log, manager scorecards, and HR records.



Ownership standard: The Director owns these results through field staff, the Project Manager / Estimator, Field Operations Specialist, and Maintenance Coordination Team. Results should reflect independent team performance rather than work the Director personally completed or redid.

 and Instagram.



This is not a role for someone who simply sets campaigns live and checks them once a week. We’re looking for someone who is hands-on, proactive and constantly optimising — someone who understands how quickly Meta advertising changes and stays ahead of new strategies, platform updates, creative trends and consumer behaviour.



The Role



You’ll be responsible for managing and continually improving our Meta Ads account, with a strong focus on profitable growth.



You’ll work closely with our team, who produce a high volume of organic social content and creative in-house, to identify what is working organically and turn the strongest concepts into high-performing paid campaigns.



You’ll need to understand when a campaign is ready to scale, when it needs adjusting, when creative is becoming fatigued and how to increase budgets strategically without destroying performance.



Key Responsibilities



Manage Meta Ads across
 and Instagram from strategy through to execution.



Monitor and optimise campaigns consistently throughout the week.



Build, test and refine campaign structures, audiences and creative strategies.



Know when and how to scale winning campaigns while maintaining profitability.



Increase budgets strategically based on performance rather than simply spending more.



Continually test new creatives, hooks, formats, audiences and campaign approaches.



Identify creative fatigue and recommend when new content is required.



Analyse performance across ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPM, conversion rate and other relevant metrics.



Understand attribution and how Meta fits into the wider customer journey.



Keep up to date with Meta platform changes, algorithm updates and new advertising features.



Stay across current social media, fashion, ecommerce and creative trends.



Use organic social performance to help identify potential paid advertising opportunities.



Provide clear reporting and explain what is working, what isn’t and what you recommend doing next.



Work closely with us rather than operating as a disconnected external media buyer.



Who We’re Looking For



You must have previous specialist experience managing Meta Ads for ecommerce brands and be able to demonstrate proven results.



Ideally, you have experience in fashion, streetwear, kidswear, footwear or another fast-moving ecommerce category.



You should be someone who:



Has a strong track record of growing ecommerce brands through Meta Ads.



Understands how to scale campaigns without unnecessarily blowing out CPA or reducing ROAS.



Is confident managing meaningful advertising budgets.



Is highly analytical but also understands the importance of creative.



Understands what makes people stop scrolling and purchase.



Keeps up with Meta Ads rather than relying on strategies that worked two years ago.



Understands current Instagram, TikTok and social content trends.



Is proactive and brings ideas to us rather than waiting to be told what to do.



Is comfortable making frequent optimisations based on performance.



Communicates clearly and can explain strategy without unnecessary marketing jargon.



Treats the account like they are part of the business.



Experience Required



Applicants must have previous hands-on Meta Ads experience.



We will be looking for examples of accounts you have personally managed, including:



Monthly advertising spend managed



Ecommerce revenue generated



ROAS / CPA results



Examples of accounts you have successfully scaled



Your role in creative strategy and testing



Examples of how you have handled declining performance or creative fatigue



Please do not apply if your experience is primarily theoretical, agency account management or delegating campaign management to another team member. We want the person applying to be the person actually working inside our account.



Hours



Approximately up to 15 hours per week initially.



For the right person, the role has the opportunity to grow alongside the business and our advertising spend.



We care more about results, responsiveness and consistent account management than simply filling hours.



About Us



We are a multi-brand kids streetwear boutique specialising in fashion, sneakers and emerging brands. Social media is a major part of our business and we create a significant amount of content in-house.



We move quickly, regularly launch new products and brands, and need someone who understands that advertising for a fast-moving ecommerce business requires constant attention, testing and adaptation.



If you live and breathe Meta Ads, understand ecommerce and know how to turn strong creative into scalable performance, we’d love to hear from you.



To Apply



Please include:



A short introduction about your Meta Ads experience



Brands or ecommerce accounts you have managed



Typical monthly ad spend you have worked with



Examples of proven results



An example of an account you successfully scaled and how you approached it



Your current availability



Your hourly or weekly rate



Please only apply if you have direct, proven Meta Ads experience and will personally be managing the account.

title: AI Performance Static Ad Designer — Meta Ads / DTC E-Commerce
description:
We are hiring an **AI Performance Static Ad Designer** to produce and iterate
/Instagram image ads at **high volume** for established e-commerce brands.



This is NOT a traditional graphic design role.



We are not looking for someone who spends an entire day making one beautiful image.



We are looking for someone who understands how to use **AI + design + direct-response principles** to rapidly produce large numbers of high-quality advertising concepts, test variations, study winning creatives, and continuously create better iterations.



## Your Main Goal



Turn winning marketing ideas into **large quantities of testable Meta ad creatives**.



You will take:



- Winning ads

- Creative briefs

- Customer pain points

- Hooks

- Headlines

- Product photos

- Competitor inspiration

- Scripts

- Reviews

- Marketing angles



…and transform them into **many different static image ads designed to stop the scroll and generate sales.**



We want someone who thinks:



**“How can I turn this one winning concept into 10–20 new executions?”**



Not:



**“How do I make one prettier version?”**



## What You Will Do



You will regularly:



- Create new
/Instagram static ad concepts

- Reiterate proven winning ads

- Produce multiple visual variations of the same marketing angle

- Generate realistic AI imagery

- Create infographic-style ads

- Create testimonial/review ads

- Create comparison ads

- Create problem/solution ads

- Create native-looking social ads

- Create product-focused ads

- Create before/after style concepts where appropriate

- Create educational/mechanism-based ads

- Create unusual scroll-stopping visual concepts

- Change hooks while preserving winning concepts

- Test different layouts, imagery, headlines, avatars, environments and visual mechanisms

- Study performance feedback and generate the next round of iterations



You should be able to take ONE winning concept and produce variations such as:



**5 different hooks  

× 3 different visual directions  

× 2 different layouts**



= **30 possible executions from one concept.**



## AI Skills Are Extremely Important



You should be highly comfortable using modern AI image-generation and editing tools.



Examples include:



- ChatGPT / GPT Image

- Nano Banana

- Midjourney

- Flux

- Ideogram

- Higgsfield

- Photoshop Generative Fill

- Canva AI

- Figma

- Other AI image-generation tools



You do NOT need to use every tool listed above.



However, you should be able to create high-quality advertising assets quickly without waiting for someone else to provide every image.



## Direct Response Matters



We care much more about **performance advertising** than traditional branding.



You should understand concepts such as:



- Scroll stopping

- Hooks

- Pain points

- Customer avatars

- Desire

- Curiosity

- Problem

title: E-Commerce Meta/Facebook Ads - Senior Performance Video Editor / AI Creative Editor.
description:
Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term

$1,500–$3,000 USD/month + Performance Bonuses



We are building a high-volume performance creative team for established e-commerce brands and are looking for exceptional Direct Response Video Editors.



This is not a traditional video editing job.



We are not looking for someone whose primary skill is making videos look cinematic or aesthetically pleasing.



We are looking for editors who understand why ads make people stop, watch, click, and buy.



Your work will be launched on Meta with real advertising spend. You'll get to see which creatives win, which fail, and use that data to continuously improve.



WHAT YOU'LL CREATE



You'll create performance advertisements across formats including:



• UGC ads

• Direct-response Meta ads

• Short-form VSLs

• Long-form VSLs

• AI UGC

• AI avatars

• Voiceover + B-roll ads

• Founder-style ads

• Testimonial ads

• Problem → mechanism → solution ads

• Greenscreen ads

• Podcast-style ads

• Product demonstrations

• AI-generated scenes and B-roll

• New iterations of proven winning creatives



You will receive assets such as:



• Scripts

• Creative briefs

• Raw UGC

• Product footage

• Customer testimonials

• Voiceovers

• Images

• Existing winning ads

• Competitor/reference creatives

• Performance feedback



But we do not want an editor who can only work when every asset is handed to them.



A great editor should be able to receive a script and figure out what needs to appear visually during every line.



YOU SHOULD BE ABLE TO ANSWER QUESTIONS LIKE:



What should appear on screen during this sentence?



Where is attention likely to drop?



Does this section need a pattern interrupt?



Should this line use UGC, product footage, AI B-roll, animation, screenshots, graphics, or something else?



Which words deserve emphasis on screen?



How can the first 3 seconds become significantly stronger?



What made the original winning ad work?



How can we create 10 new executions without removing the elements responsible for its performance?



That thinking is more important to us than knowing every shortcut in Premiere Pro.



AI IS A MAJOR PART OF THIS ROLE



You should already be comfortable using AI as part of the creative process.



Experience with tools such as:



• Veo

• Kling

• Higgsfield

• Runway

• ElevenLabs

• HeyGen

• AI UGC platforms

• AI image generators

• AI voice generation

• AI avatars



is highly valuable.



If a script requires footage that doesn't exist, we expect you to think about how it can be sourced, generated, recreated, or visualized.



All necessary paid AI tools will be provided by us.



DIRECT RESPONSE EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



You must have previous experience creating paid advertising creative for e-commerce / DTC brands.



Experience with brands or creative teams similar to:



• Resilia

• Lymphoria

• Rosabella

• Serene Herbs

• Everly

• ClarityMD

• Happy Mammoth

• Menerals



is a major advantage.



If you have directly worked with one of these brands or a similar high-volume DTC advertiser, tell us.



We are especially interested in editors who have worked on brands spending significant amounts of money on Meta.



DO NOT APPLY IF YOUR PORTFOLIO IS PRIMARILY:



• Weddings

• Gaming videos

• Podcasts

• YouTube talking-head content

• Travel montages

• Corporate videos

• Music videos

• Organic social media content



Those editing skills can be useful, but this position is specifically for performance advertising.



QUALITY + VOLUME



Creative volume matters.



Depending on complexity, you should eventually be capable of producing approximately 3–5+ finished ad executions per working day.



Some will be completely new concepts.



Others will involve taking a proven winner and creating strategically different executions.



We do not want:



Winner + different first 3 seconds

Winner + different caption color

Winner + different music



and calling those three new ads.



We want editors capable of changing visual execution, storytelling, footage, format, delivery, hook mechanism, spokesperson, AI scenes, pattern interrupts, demonstrations, and other variables while preserving the underlying reason the original concept worked.



WHAT MAKES SOMEONE EXCEPTIONAL HERE



The best person for this role:



• Understands direct response marketing

• Understands customer psychology

• Has excellent visual instincts

• Understands Meta ad pacing

• Knows how to retain attention

• Sources great B-roll independently

• Can create assets with AI

• Thinks beyond the editing brief

• Studies winning advertisements

• Learns quickly from performance data

• Can explain why an ad should work

• Accepts feedback without ego

• Works quickly

• Is highly reliable

• Wants to become one of the best performance editors in the industry



COMPENSATION



$1,500–$3,000 USD per month depending on experience, portfolio quality, speed, and demonstrated performance.



Performance bonuses are available for creatives that become winning advertisements.



Exceptional editors can earn more as they prove their ability to consistently create winning ads.



This is a long-term role.



We are building a serious creative operation, not hiring someone for a temporary freelance project.



Top performers can eventually move into positions such as:



Senior Editor

Lead Editor

Creative Strategist

Creative Team Lead



PAID TEST



Shortlisted candidates will receive the same paid editing test.



You will receive:



• Product information

• Script

• Raw assets

• Reference advertisements

• Creative direction



You will create:



1 complete direct-response Meta advertisement



plus



3 genuinely different hook executions.



We will evaluate:



• Hook strength

• Visual storytelling

• Editing quality

• Direct-response understanding

• B-roll selection

• Pacing

• Retention

• AI usage

• Creativity

• Ability to follow direction

• Speed

• Attention to detail



HOW TO APPLY



Do not send us your entire portfolio.



Send:



Your 3 best PAID e-commerce / Meta advertisements.



The brands you created advertisements for.



For each example, tell us exactly what you personally did.



If known, tell us approximately how much advertising spend the creative received or any performance information you are allowed to share.



Tell us which AI video, image, voice, and UGC tools you currently use.



Tell us how many finished direct-response ads you can realistically produce per working day.



Tell us your expected monthly compensation.



Tell us your timezone and normal working hours.



Tell us if you have ever worked for Resilia, Lymphoria, Rosabella, Serene Herbs, Everly, ClarityMD, Happy Mammoth, Menerals, or another large performance-driven DTC brand.



And answer this question:



An advertisement is profitable and scaling heavily on Meta.



You are asked to create 10 new variations.



How would you determine what elements should remain unchanged, what elements you would test, and how would you make the 10 versions genuinely different without destroying what made the original advertisement successful?



Please give a detailed answer.



Applications that do not answer this question will not be considered.



We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to edit videos.



We are looking for someone who understands how to create advertisements that sell products.

title: Mechanical Engineer
description:

Role Title: Mechanical Engineer – Video Annotation Specialist

micro1 is looking for Mechanical Engineers with 2+ years of experience to support a customer project focused on training advanced AI and robotics systems.



In this role, you will review and annotate videos involving robots, mechanical systems, tools, components, and physical interactions. title: Role As the Director of Business Workshops, you'll teach entrepreneurs the Acquisition.com sales and marketing framework
description:
As the Marketing Execution Coordinator at Evergreen State Heating & Air Conditioning, you’ll make sure our marketing gets executed every day, across every channel, and that we can clearly see what is working.



We are preparing for the largest marketing push in our company’s history.



We have the offer.



We have the sales team.



We have the operating capacity.



We have the marketing budget.



We have the plan.



Your job is to make sure it gets done.



You’ll coordinate campaigns across digital,
, SMS, direct mail, customer reactivation, influencers, referral partners, PR, content, reviews, and other marketing channels.



You are not expected to personally be the expert in every channel.



You are expected to know what needs to happen, who owns it, when it is due, whether it got done, and what happened as a result.



The visible part of this job is marketing.



The real job is execution, organization, follow-up, communication, and accountability.



If something is falling behind, you surface it.



If someone owes you something, you follow up.



If there is no system, you help build one.



If something can be done better, you improve it.



Nothing falls through the cracks.



Responsibilities



Run the marketing calendar: Make sure campaigns, content, promotions,
s, SMS, direct mail, outreach, and other marketing activities have owners and deadlines.



Drive daily execution: Follow up with team members, contractors, agencies, designers, vendors, influencers, partners, and media contacts until tasks are complete.



Coordinate campaigns: Help execute marketing across
, Instagram, Google, YouTube,
, SMS, direct mail, customer reactivation, referral partners, influencers, PR, and our website.



Manage outreach: Coordinate consistent outreach to influencers, referral partners, past customers, old estimates, community partners, and other opportunities.



Manage content execution: Make sure content is created, edited, approved, scheduled, and published consistently.



Track the numbers: Maintain a simple marketing scoreboard showing spend, leads, appointments, sales, revenue, and customer acquisition cost.

title: VA for Dubai Based Style Consultant and Bespoke Tailor
description:
Executive Virtual Assistant – Client Relations & Business Operations | Dressing Dubai



-



Dressing Dubai is a personal styling brand, a Dubai-based style consultant specialising in bespoke tailoring and luxury menswear.



I help busy professionals, entrepreneurs and business owners build wardrobes that suit their lifestyles—from business suits and wedding outfits to elevated casualwear and complete wardrobe transformations.



As the business grows, I spend more of my time consulting with clients. I’m looking for an exceptional virtual assistant to take ownership of the daily operations behind the scenes, ensuring every enquiry is handled, every appointment is organised and every client receives thoughtful, personal service.



**About the role**



You will work directly with me as my right-hand person, managing client communication, my diary, social media administration, fabric orders and general business admin.



You should be comfortable taking responsibility, keeping track of multiple conversations and moving tasks forward without constant reminders. Your work will help turn enquiries into appointments and build lasting relationships with clients.



This is a role for someone who enjoys both people and organisation: you can write a warm, natural message to a client, then accurately update an order tracker and follow up with a supplier.



**Your responsibilities**



**Client enquiries and follow-up**



- Manage inbound Instagram DMs and WhatsApp Business messages during agreed working hours.

- Respond professionally in a tone that feels personal, warm and consistent with Dressing Dubai.

- Understand what each prospective client needs, collect relevant details and help book consultations.

- Follow up thoughtfully with people who have enquired but haven’t booked.

- Maintain a clear record of every lead, conversation and next action.

- Flag conversations that require my styling advice, pricing decisions or personal attention.



**Diary and appointment management**



- Manage my calendar, including consultations, fittings, collections and other commitments.

- Coordinate appointments with clients and the showroom team.

- Send confirmations and reminders, manage rescheduling and follow up on missed appointments.

- Keep me prepared with a daily schedule and relevant client notes.

- Plan appointments around client deadlines, travel and important events.



**Client relationships and aftercare**



- Maintain organised client records, including preferences, previous purchases, birthdays and relevant upcoming events or travel.

- Send thoughtful birthday messages and personalised follow-ups.

- Contact clients ahead of trips, weddings or other occasions when they may need new garments, allowing sufficient production time.

- Check in after collections and request reviews or feedback when appropriate.

- Make each client feel remembered and well looked after.



**Fabric orders and order administration**



- Place fabric orders based on my confirmed selections and instructions.

- Double-check fabric references, quantities, colours, supplier details and delivery information before submitting orders.

- Track confirmations, availability, invoices and delivery dates.

- Follow up with suppliers and the team on outstanding items.

- Maintain an accurate order tracker and flag delays or discrepancies promptly.

- Obtain approval before making substitutions or changes to agreed orders.



Training will be provided on our fabrics, suppliers and ordering process. Accuracy and reliable follow-through are essential.



**Social media management**



- Manage the content calendar and schedule approved posts, reels and stories.

- Coordinate with me and my content creator to keep content organised and publishing consistent.

- Prepare captions and simple supporting content in the brand’s tone.

- Repurpose and repost existing content where appropriate.

- Monitor comments and messages, respond to routine enquiries and flag relevant opportunities.

- Review new followers and highlight potential clients, collaborators and useful connections.

- Track basic performance, particularly enquiries and consultation bookings generated by content.



**General administration and organisation**



- Keep client databases, spreadsheets, files and task lists accurate and up to date.

- Create simple checklists and processes for recurring tasks.

- Follow up on outstanding actions with clients, suppliers and the team.

- Send a concise daily update covering appointments, new leads, pending orders and decisions needed from me.

- Identify ways to make the business more organised and the client experience smoother.



**Who I’m looking for**



- Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate naturally and confidently with clients.

- Experience supporting a business owner, managing client relationships or coordinating business operations remotely.

- Strong organisation and attention to detail, particularly when handling orders, dates and client information.

- Good judgement: you know what you can handle independently and when to ask for input.

- A proactive approach—you notice what needs doing and follow through.

- Confidence using WhatsApp Business, Instagram, calendars, spreadsheets and task-management tools.

- Discretion and professionalism when handling private client conversations and business information.

- A reliable computer, stable internet connection and a suitable working environment.

- Consistent availability during our agreed schedule.



Experience in luxury services, fashion, hospitality, concierge services or another business where personal client service matters would be valuable. Tailoring knowledge is a bonus, but it is not essential.



**What success looks like**



- Enquiries receive timely, helpful replies during agreed coverage hours.

- Leads have clear next steps and follow-ups happen when promised.

- My calendar is accurate and clients arrive prepared for appointments.

- Fabric orders are accurate, tracked and followed through.

- Clients receive relevant, personal communication.

- Social content goes out consistently.

- I can focus on consultations knowing the daily administration is being handled.



**What you can expect**



- Direct communication and a close working relationship with me.

- Training on the business, brand voice, client journey and ordering processes.

- Clear guidance on pricing, approvals and situations to escalate.

- The opportunity to take increasing ownership as you learn the business.

- A long-term working relationship with room for the role to develop.



**How to apply**



Please use **“Dressing Dubai – Right-Hand VA”** as your application subject and include:



1. A short introduction explaining why this role suits you.

2. Your CV and relevant experience managing client messages, schedules, orders or business operations.

3. One example of a process you improved or a problem you solved without waiting to be asked.

4. Your available working hours in Dubai time, earliest start date and expected monthly salary for those hours.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a video interview.



I’m looking for someone who takes pride in being dependable, organised and thoughtful—and who wants to become a trusted part of Dressing Dubai.
