title: B2B Marketing & Business Development Manager
description:
B2B Marketing & Business Development Manager – Australian Market



Location: Philippines – Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Working Hours: Australian Business Hours

Market Focus: Australia



About the Role



UniGuard Australia is looking for an experienced B2B Marketing & Business Development Manager to help develop and execute our marketing and business development strategy for the Australian market.



UniGuard provides technology solutions across areas such as workforce management, employee and asset tracking, lone-worker safety, GPS tracking, access control, IoT monitoring, security, and related business solutions.



This is not purely a social media or content marketing position.



We are looking for someone with a strong commercial mindset who can identify market opportunities, determine the right target customers, develop effective go-to-market strategies, generate qualified B2B leads, build a structured sales pipeline, and eventually help us build and manage a sales/business development team.



You will work directly with the Managing Director and collaborate with our existing product, development, design and content teams.



Key Responsibilities

- Marketing & Go-to-Market Strategy

- Review UniGuard's product portfolio and identify priority products and market opportunities within Australia.

- Develop and execute B2B marketing and go-to-market strategies.

- Identify target industries, Ideal Customer Profiles (ICP), key decision-makers and potential market segments.

- Develop product positioning, value propositions and key marketing messages.

- Conduct competitor and market research to identify opportunities and improve our market positioning.

- Develop marketing plans based on measurable commercial objectives.



Lead Generation & Business Development

- Develop and manage B2B lead-generation strategies across appropriate channels.

- Build targeted prospect lists and identify potential Australian customers.

- Develop outbound prospecting strategies using channels such as LinkedIn,
, search, partnerships and other relevant B2B channels.

- Generate and qualify potential business opportunities.

- Develop strategies to move prospects through the sales pipeline.

- Support meetings, product demonstrations, proposals and commercial follow-ups where required.

- Continuously test and improve lead-generation strategies based on results.



Sales Process & Pipeline Development

- Establish a structured sales process from prospecting through to qualification, meetings, proposals, follow-up and closing.

- Develop appropriate sales scripts, outreach processes and follow-up strategies.

- Establish and maintain a clear sales pipeline and reporting process.

- Monitor conversion rates and identify opportunities to improve sales performance.

- Work with management to establish appropriate sales targets and KPIs.



Team Development & Leadership

- Assess the future sales resources required to execute the Australian growth strategy.

- Recommend an appropriate sales/business development team structure based on market opportunities and performance.

- Assist with recruiting, onboarding and training future sales or Business Development Representatives.

- Manage and support the sales team once established.

- Provide strategic direction to our existing content and design team for marketing campaigns and sales materials.



What We're Looking For

- Proven experience in B2B marketing, business development, sales, or a combination of these areas.

- Experience developing and executing B2B marketing or go-to-market strategies.

- Strong understanding of B2B lead generation and sales pipeline development.

- Experience identifying target markets, customer segments and decision-makers.

- Strong commercial mindset with an understanding of how marketing activities contribute to pipeline and revenue.

- Previous experience managing or building a sales/business development team.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong communication, presentation and leadership skills.

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

- Willing and able to work Australian business hours.



Highly Preferred

- Previous experience working with Australian companies or targeting the Australian B2B market.

- Experience in Technology, SaaS, IoT, Security, Workforce Management, Asset Tracking or related industries.

- Experience selling technology solutions to businesses.

- Experience building a marketing or business development function from the ground up.

- Existing professional network within the Australian B2B market.

- Experience recruiting and managing remote sales teams.



What Success Looks Like

During your first 90 days, we expect you to:

- Develop a strong understanding of UniGuard's products and potential Australian markets.

- Identify priority products, industries and target customer profiles.

- Develop an initial marketing and business development strategy.

- Establish a structured lead-generation and sales process.

- Begin generating and qualifying B2B opportunities.

- Establish clear marketing and sales KPIs and reporting.

- Provide recommendations regarding the future sales team structure required to scale the business.

Over time, the role will increasingly focus on growing qualified pipeline, sales opportunities, conversion rates and revenue.



Who This Role Is Best Suited For

This position would suit someone who enjoys building a commercial function rather than simply inheriting an existing marketing system.

You should be comfortable answering questions such as:

Which products should we prioritise? Who should we sell them to? How do we reach those customers? How do we generate qualified opportunities? How should we structure the sales process? What team do we need to scale it?

If your experience is primarily limited to social media posting, graphic design or content creation without significant B2B strategy, lead generation or business development experience, this position may not be the right fit.



How to Apply

Please submit:

- Your updated CV/resume.

- A brief introduction outlining your B2B marketing and business development experience.

- Details of any previous experience working with Australian businesses or the Australian market.

- An example of a B2B marketing, lead-generation or business development strategy you have previously managed.

- Your expected monthly salary.

- Your availability to start.

)

Looking forward to hearing from you!

title: Marketing Project Manager
description:
Location: Remote

Work Schedule: Monday-Friday 9:00am-5:00pm EST

Salary: $1200/month



About Founders & Funders



Founders & Funders (F&F) is one of the fastest-growing startup event platforms in the U.S., bringing together exceptional founders, investors, and ecosystem partners through our signature VC Reverse Pitch™ events.



We’re building more than events—we’re building a media and community brand at the center of the startup ecosystem.



As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a highly organized Marketing Project Lead who can help ensure our marketing initiatives stay aligned, on schedule, and moving forward.



About the Role

The Marketing Project Lead is a project management role focused on keeping Founders & Funders’ marketing and media initiatives organized and moving from idea to completion.



This is not a people-management position. Instead, you’ll be responsible for managing projects, timelines, priorities, dependencies, and deliverables across different contributors and functions.



You’ll work closely with the Media & Production team, LinkedIn/Content team, and other marketing contributors to make sure everyone understands what needs to be done, who owns each deliverable, and when it needs to be completed.

You’ll be the person making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



Responsibilities:

1. Marketing Project Management

- Own and manage timelines for key marketing and media projects

- Create clear project plans, milestones, deadlines, and deliverables

- Coordinate projects across the Newsletter, Website, Podcast, Media & Production, and LinkedIn/Content functions

- Ensure everyone involved understands their responsibilities, deadlines, and dependencies

- Follow up on outstanding tasks and deliverables to keep projects moving

- Identify bottlenecks, delays, or dependencies before they become larger issues

- Maintain visibility into project status and communicate updates to leadership

- Help prioritize projects based on business needs, deadlines, and available resources

- Keep project documentation, timelines, and workflows organized

- Establish repeatable project management processes and workflows



2. Newsletter Projects

- Coordinate the planning and production timeline for the Founders & Funders newsletter

- Ensure content, design, approvals, and publishing stay on schedule

- Coordinate with writers, designers, editors, and other contributors

- Track newsletter deliverables from initial concept through publication

- Ensure deadlines are clearly communicated and followed



3. Website Projects

- Coordinate website updates, new pages, campaigns, and other website-related projects

- Work with designers, developers, content contributors, and other stakeholders

- Establish timelines and track website deliverables

- Ensure required content, assets, approvals, and technical updates are completed on time

- Communicate project status and flag delays or blockers



4. Podcast Projects

- Manage the project timeline for podcast episodes from planning through publication

- Coordinate guest scheduling, recording, editing, graphics, show notes, publishing, and promotion

- Ensure each contributor understands their deliverables and deadlines

- Track episode progress and follow up on outstanding items

- Coordinate with the Media & Production team to keep episodes moving toward publication

- Ensure podcast content is properly handed off for repurposing across other marketing channels



5. Other Marketing & Brand Projects

- Manage timelines and deliverables for other marketing and brand initiatives as assigned

- Coordinate campaigns, launches, events, partnerships, promotional initiatives, and special marketing projects

- Work with internal teams and external contributors to ensure projects move from concept to completion

- Translate marketing priorities into clear project plans, action items, owners, and deadlines

- Coordinate creative, content, design, media, and other deliverables required for each project

- Monitor progress and proactively follow up to keep projects on track

- Identify gaps, dependencies, and potential delays and escalate them when necessary

- Help ensure all marketing and brand projects are aligned with Founders & Funders’ goals, messaging, and brand standards



6. Cross-Functional Coordination

- Serve as the central point of coordination for assigned marketing projects

- Work with the Media & Production team, LinkedIn Specialist, content contributors, designers, editors, and other team members

- Keep projects aligned across multiple functions and moving toward the same objective

- Facilitate project check-ins and provide clear status updates when needed

- Make sure deliverables are completed according to agreed timelines and standards

- Escalate significant delays, resource constraints, or project risks to leadership

- Help leadership maintain visibility across active marketing initiatives



Qualifications:

- At least 4 years experience in project management, marketing project management, operations, or a similar coordination role

- Strong organizational and project management skills

- Experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously

- Excellent follow-through and attention to detail

- Strong communication and coordination skills

- Comfortable working across multiple teams and contributors

- Able to create structure and clarity in a fast-moving environment

- Proactive—you identify what needs to happen next and make sure it happens

- Strong at following up without micromanaging

- Comfortable identifying and escalating blockers when necessary

- Resourceful and scrappy—you can find solutions when plans change or information is incomplete

- Adaptable and comfortable working in a startup environment

- Strong sense of ownership and accountability

- Comfortable using project management and collaboration tools such as 
, Asana, Trello, Notion, Slack, or similar platforms



Nice to Have

- Experience managing marketing, media, content, or creative projects

- Experience coordinating newsletters, websites, podcasts, or digital media

- Experience working with cross-functional marketing teams

- Familiarity with content production workflows

- Experience working in a startup, media, events, or fast-growing company

- Experience working with remote or distributed teams

- Familiarity with tools such as Canva, ChatGPT, Claude, Google Workspace, and other marketing platforms



What Success Looks Like



Success in this role means that marketing projects move forward smoothly, deadlines are visible and respected, and deliverables are completed without things falling through the cracks.



You’ll create the structure and accountability that allows our marketing and media contributors to do their best work.



You won’t be expected to manage the people doing the work—you’ll manage the projects, timelines, coordination, and execution that keep everyone moving in the same direction.

title: Senior US Tax Accountant & Financial Manager (Hospice & Healthcare)
description:

We are seeking a high-caliber Philippine Licensed CPA, US Enrolled Agent (EA), or Senior US Tax Specialist to take full ownership of financial operations, global cash-flow analysis, and tax compliance for a growing portfolio of US healthcare and hospice entities, along with related commercial property holding companies.

In this role, you will lead complex multi-entity accounting in QuickBooks, maintain bank-ready financial records, manage global cash flow, and oversee complete federal and state tax filing processes. You will report directly to executive leadership to ensure our global financial presentation, balance sheets, and debt structures meet bank and credit committee underwriting standards.



Key Responsibilities

 US Federal & State Tax Management: Prepare, review, and manage federal (Form 1040, 1065, 1120/1120-S) and multi-state tax returns across our healthcare, hospice, and property entities, ensuring strict IRS compliance and relocation/multi-state tax planning.

 

Underwriting & Bank-Ready Financial Statements: Maintain precise, audit-ready financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) and global cash-flow models to support commercial credit reviews, bank financing applications, and executive decision-making.

 

QuickBooks Administration & Cleanups: Direct chart of accounts setup, multi-entity account reconciliations, historical cleanups, and routine maintenance across QuickBooks Online and Desktop.

 

Healthcare & Hospice Operational Accounting: Manage granular expense tracking, operational budgets, revenue cycle workflows, and debt service tracking tailored to hospice and healthcare facility operations.

Qualifications & Requirements

 

Licensure / Credentials (Any of the following):

 Active Philippine Licensed CPA (PRC), OR

 Active US Enrolled Agent (EA) status, OR

 Passed US CPA Exam / Active US CPA License (Highly Preferred).

 

US Taxation & Underwriting Expertise: 3–5+ years of hands-on experience handling complex US federal/state returns, global cash-flow analysis, and tax compliance across multiple entities.



 Industry Focus: Direct prior experience in healthcare, hospice, medical practice, or commercial real estate accounting.

 QuickBooks Mastery: Advanced proficiency in QuickBooks Online and Desktop (QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification is a strong plus).

 

Technical Workspace Setup: High-speed internet with power backup, a dedicated quiet workspace, and strict adherence to handling confidential health and financial records.



How to Apply:



To apply, please submit your application with the following:



1. Updated Resume / CV detailing your direct experience with US tax filings, QuickBooks multi-entity management, and healthcare/hospice financial operations.



2. A brief summary highlighting:

 The specific US tax forms you have prepared (1040, 1065, 1120/1120-S).



 The number of healthcare, hospice, or property entities you have managed simultaneously.



3. Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

description:

Our brand and client base is growing fast and we have TOO MANY leads to handle. As a result, we are rapidly expanding our team and looking for a high-performance DM setter who knows how to turn conversations into booked calls so we can help even more people!



If you thrive in a results-driven environment and want uncapped earning potential, keep reading.



Compensation:



- Full-time: 40–50 hours per week

- Pay: $650 USD per month

- Commission: 3-5% of cash collected from every client you book who enrolls

**Top performers earn significantly more. This is a performance-based role. Your income scales with your output.

- Initiating conversations with new followers, story viewers, and engaged prospects

- Reaching out to warm and targeted outbound leads daily

- Moving qualified prospects into booked sales calls

- Following up consistently with warm leads

What We’re Looking For:



Strong written English (clear, natural, professional — no grammar mistakes)

- Quick response speed and ability to handle multiple conversations at once

- 1–3+ years of experience as a DM setter (fitness industry preferred)

- Proven history of booking qualified calls that actually show up

- Reliable laptop + fast internet

- Comfortable sending 80–100+ high-quality messages per day

- Willing to work flexible hours, including weekends when needed

- Highly coachable and able to take feedback fast

- Competitive, disciplined, and motivated by performance

- We move quickly. You must be comfortable keeping up.



Why This Is a Big Opportunity:



- Work directly with a rapidly scaling online fitness coaching company with a passion for client results and excellence across the board

- Clear SOPs, scripts, and leadership support

- Real growth path for top performers (raises + leadership opportunities)

- Remote position

- Be part of a team with high standards and long-term vision

How To Apply:



Send a short message replying to this job post explaining why you want to apply



**within 24-72 hours, all eligible applicants will be invited to an interview.



Looking forward to speaking with you!

title: Luxury Client Success Manager — Retention, Engagement & Experience
description:
Type of Work: Full-Time

Hours: 40 hours per week

Starting Compensation: $1,200 per month

90-Day Compensation: Eligible to increase to $1,500 per month following a successful performance review and consistent achievement of KPIs



Job Overview



This is not a passive customer service role.



Bonding Biology Institute™ is seeking a highly organized, emotionally intelligent, and proactive Client Success Manager who will take full ownership of the client experience after enrollment.



Your primary responsibility is to ensure our clients feel seen, supported, valued, and actively engaged throughout their Love Success Journey™. You will monitor their progress, anticipate concerns, identify disengagement before it becomes a cancellation, and coordinate with our team to ensure each client receives an elevated, personalized experience.



Our clients should never have to disappear before we realize they needed support.



The right person will notice the silence, investigate the problem, take initiative, and follow through until it is resolved. You must be a self-starter who does not wait to be told what needs attention.



This role requires leadership, excellent judgment, meticulous tracking, emotional intelligence, and the ability to turn client information into decisive action.



Your Primary Mission



Your mission is to increase client engagement, satisfaction, retention, and long-term success by ensuring that every client:



- Receives a smooth and welcoming onboarding experience

- Understands what to do next in her journey

- Feels personally recognized and supported

- Remains engaged with classes, assignments, the app, and the community

- Receives proactive outreach when engagement declines

- Has concerns addressed thoroughly and promptly

- Experiences consistent follow-through from our team

- Continues progressing toward her desired transformation



Key Responsibilities



Own the Client Journey



- Oversee each client’s experience from enrollment through onboarding, participation, completion, renewal, or ascension

- Ensure every new client receives the correct welcome materials, agreements, login credentials, orientation information, schedules, and next steps

- Conduct proactive client check-ins at key milestones

- Make sure no client becomes lost, confused, inactive, or overlooked

- Maintain a clear understanding of where every client is in her journey



Track Client Health and Engagement



- Maintain an accurate client success dashboard or CRM

- Track onboarding completion, attendance, app activity, homework participation, community engagement, support requests, client sentiment, and progress

- Identify early warning signs such as missed classes, declining participation, unresolved concerns, negative feedback, or prolonged inactivity

- Create and execute recovery plans for at-risk or disengaged clients

- Document every important interaction, concern, action taken, responsible team member, deadline, and resolution



Increase Retention and Prevent Avoidable Cancellations



- Proactively contact clients who are becoming inactive or disconnected

- Determine the actual reason behind disengagement rather than accepting surface-level answers

- Help clients reconnect with their goals, program expectations, and next steps

- Coordinate additional support when appropriate

- Identify patterns that may be affecting retention and recommend solutions

- Support continuation, renewal, and ascension opportunities through excellent service and relationship-building



Create a Luxury Client Experience



- Ensure every interaction feels warm, polished, personal, responsive, and professional

- Learn relevant client details so communication does not feel generic or transactional

- Recognize progress, birthdays, milestones, wins, and meaningful breakthroughs

- Make clients feel remembered—not processed

- Handle sensitive situations with empathy, composure, discretion, and strong boundaries

- Escalate complaints, emotional concerns, billing matters, or high-priority situations promptly



Lead Cross-Functional Follow-Through



- Serve as the connection point between clients, coaches, community support, operations, billing, and the technical team

- Assign clear ownership when another team member must resolve an issue

- Follow up until the issue is fully resolved and the client has received confirmation

- Hold internal team members accountable for client-related deadlines

- Lead client experience meetings and present clear priorities, risks, and recommended actions

- Never assume that an issue is resolved simply because it was forwarded to someone else



Strengthen Community Engagement



- Welcome new members and help them feel connected immediately

- Encourage meaningful participation in classes, assignments, community conversations, and accountability activities

- Identify members who need encouragement, recognition, or additional support

- Help create conversations that make the community feel active, intimate, and transformational

- Monitor the emotional tone of the community and address concerns before they escalate

- Work with the team to reactivate inactive members



Reporting and Improvement



- Submit accurate daily and weekly client success reports

- Report what happened, what action was taken, what remains unresolved, who owns the next step, and when it will be completed

- Monitor retention, engagement, attendance, response times, client concerns, and reactivation results

- Gather client feedback and identify recurring gaps in the client journey

- Recommend practical improvements to systems, communication, onboarding, programming, and support

- Take initiative to improve the client experience without waiting for repeated instructions



This Role Is for Someone Who



- Is a natural leader and takes ownership without being micromanaged

- Is exceptionally thorough and notices details others miss

- Follows through completely—not halfway

- Can recognize a potential problem before it becomes a crisis

- Is emotionally intelligent, warm, nurturing, and professionally firm

- Communicates clearly by phone, video,
, text, and direct message

- Is comfortable speaking with sophisticated, high-achieving clients

- Can balance compassion with standards and accountability

- Makes decisions, proposes solutions, and takes appropriate action

- Keeps immaculate notes, records, deadlines, and follow-up systems

- Can manage multiple clients and priorities without allowing details to fall through the cracks

- Understands that activity is not the same as results

- Is dependable, responsive, resourceful, and solution-oriented



This Role Is Not for Someone Who



- Waits to be reminded about responsibilities

- Only responds when a client complains

- Forwards problems without confirming they were resolved

- Submits vague reports without names, details, outcomes, or next steps

- Needs constant direction to determine what should happen next

- Avoids difficult conversations

- Becomes overwhelmed by multiple priorities

- Treats client success as basic administrative support



Preferred Experience



- Client success, account management, customer experience, member retention, or community leadership

- Coaching, wellness, personal development, relationship education, luxury services, or high-ticket programs

- Managing a client journey from onboarding through completion or renewal

- Using CRMs, spreadsheets, project-management systems, membership platforms, or community apps

- Handling escalations, reactivating disengaged clients, and preventing cancellations

- Understanding emotional regulation, attachment styles, psychology, feminine energy, or relationship dynamics is a bonus



KPIs and Success Metrics



Performance will be measured by:



- Client retention and continuation rates

- Successful onboarding completion

- Class attendance and participation

- App and community engagement

- Reactivation of inactive clients

- At-risk clients successfully recovered

- Response and resolution times

- Client satisfaction and feedback

- Accuracy and completeness of CRM records

- Completion of proactive client check-ins

- Timeliness and quality of daily and weekly reports

- Reduction in unresolved client concerns

- Quality of leadership, initiative, and team follow-through



Compensation and Growth



Compensation begins at $1,500 per month for the first 90 days.



Following a successful 90-day performance review, compensation may increase to $2,200 per month based on:



- Consistent achievement of agreed-upon KPIs

- Demonstrated leadership and independent decision-making

- Accurate client tracking and reporting

- Strong client retention and engagement results

- Reliability, responsiveness, and complete follow-through

- Ability to identify and solve problems proactively



This position offers meaningful advancement opportunities for someone who becomes a trusted leader and consistently improves the client experience.



About Bonding Biology Institute™



Bonding Biology Institute™ is a luxury love mastery and relationship technology company founded by Shay Levister, also known as Shay Your Love Diva.



Through HerPocketCoach™, AI-powered support systems, Love Blocks®, the Five Love Archetypes™, and the 7-Stage Love Framework™, we help high-achieving women heal unhealthy relationship patterns, elevate their self-worth, and attract emotionally healthy, commitment-minded love.



We are building the future of relationship transformation through psychology, neuroscience, feminine embodiment, artificial intelligence, and structured emotional growth systems.



How to Apply



Please submit to 



- Your current resume

- A short video introducing yourself and explaining why you are an excellent fit

- A description of your client success, retention, community, or account-management experience

- An example of a time you identified and solved a client problem without being instructed

- An example of how you helped retain or reactivate a dissatisfied or disengaged client

- The systems or tools you have used to track client activity, follow-up, and outcomes



Please also respond to this scenario:



A client has missed two classes, has not logged into the app for 10 days, and says she has simply been busy. Explain exactly what you would do next, how you would communicate with her, what you would document, and how you would ensure the situation was fully resolved.



Please confirm if your able to work full time and exclusively for the company. 



Applications that do not include all requested materials will not be considered.

title: Client Care Coordinator / Legal Support Specialist
description:
Hourly Rate: $3.00–$4.00 USD per hour, based on experience

Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week

Work Location: Remote

Working Hours: Must be available during designated U.S. Eastern Time business hours



About John Brown Law Firm



John Brown Law Firm is a growing personal injury law firm serving clients in Georgia and South Carolina. We are committed to providing responsive, compassionate, and professional service to every client.



We are looking for a dependable and highly organized Client Care Coordinator / Legal Support Specialist to assist with client communication, intake, reception, case setup, administrative support, and pre-litigation case management.



This position combines the responsibilities of a legal assistant, intake specialist, receptionist, and client care coordinator. The ideal candidate is professional, compassionate, detail-oriented, comfortable speaking with clients, and able to manage multiple assignments in a remote work environment.



Primary Responsibilities



Client Care and Communication



* Serve as a primary point of contact for clients throughout the pre-litigation process.

* Contact clients regularly to provide updates and check on their medical treatment.

* Ask clients about upcoming appointments, treatment progress, missed appointments, new providers, and changes in their medical condition.

* Document all client communications accurately in SmartAdvocate.

* Respond to client calls,
s, text messages, and Case Status messages professionally and promptly.

* Schedule client calls with the attorney or case manager when necessary.

* Identify urgent client concerns and escalate them to the appropriate team member.

* Maintain a compassionate and professional tone when assisting injured clients.

* Help ensure clients understand the next steps in their cases without providing legal advice.



Intake and Reception



* Answer incoming telephone calls professionally.

* Gather information from prospective clients and complete detailed intake questionnaires.

* Screen potential personal injury matters according to the firm’s intake criteria.

* Enter lead information accurately into GoHighLevel and other firm systems.

* Conduct follow-up calls, text messages, and
s with prospective clients.

* Schedule consultations and attorney callbacks.

* Send representation agreements through DocuBee.

* Follow up with prospective clients regarding unsigned agreements and missing information.

* Confirm receipt of signed documents and assist with transferring signed clients into the case-opening process.

* Route calls and messages to the appropriate employee.

* Maintain accurate call notes and communication records.

* Provide backup reception coverage when other staff members are unavailable.



New Case Setup



* Open and organize new client files in SmartAdvocate.

* Confirm that client names, contact information, i
 details, insurance information, and other case data are accurate.

* Upload signed contracts, identification documents, insurance cards, photographs, police reports, and other supporting documents.

* Add new clients to Case Status.

* Prepare and send letters of representation.

* Send preservation letters, insurance notification letters, medical authorizations, and other standard correspondence.

* Notify insurance companies and medical providers of the firm’s representation.

* Request claim numbers, adjuster information, policy information, and coverage details.

* Confirm that all required opening documents and case information have been received.

* Follow the firm’s file-naming and document-upload protocols.



Legal and Administrative Support



* Assist case managers and attorneys with pre-litigation administrative tasks.

* Draft routine correspondence using firm templates.

* Request police reports, i
 reports, photographs, insurance information, and other case-related documents.

* Request medical records and billing statements when assigned.

* Coordinate record requests with the firm’s outside medical-records vendor.

* Follow up with providers regarding outstanding records, bills, balances, liens, and treatment information.

* Maintain organized digital case files.

* Review files for missing documents, incomplete information, or overdue follow-up tasks.

* Update case stages, notes, tasks, contacts, and important dates in SmartAdvocate.

* Calendar deadlines, follow-up dates, appointments, and other important events.

* Assist with preparing case summaries, treatment updates, and status reports.

* Perform data entry and other administrative assignments as needed.

* Help ensure that assigned cases continue moving forward.



Medical Treatment Follow-Up



* Regularly contact clients to confirm that they are attending medical treatment.

* Identify gaps in treatment or missed appointments.

* Follow up with clients who have stopped treating or have not scheduled recommended care.

* Obtain updated provider information and appointment dates.

* Contact medical providers to confirm attendance and treatment status when authorized.

* Notify the case manager of treatment gaps, transportation concerns, financial difficulties, or other barriers affecting treatment.

* Document all treatment updates and follow-up efforts in SmartAdvocate.

* Assist clients with administrative coordination while avoiding medical or legal advice.



Insurance and Claims Support



* Contact insurance carriers to establish claims.

* Obtain claim numbers, adjuster names, telephone numbers,
 addresses, and mailing addresses.

* Request declarations pages, policy limits, coverage confirmations, and other available insurance information.

* Confirm liability and property-damage claim information.

* Follow up with adjusters regarding unanswered correspondence and outstanding requests.

* Upload and document all insurance communications in SmartAdvocate.

* Immediately escalate coverage disputes, denials, recorded-statement requests, settlement offers, or other significant communications.



Required Qualifications



* Strong written and spoken English.

* Professional telephone and
 communication skills.

* Excellent organization and attention to detail.

* Ability to communicate with injured, frustrated, or emotional clients patiently and compassionately.

* Ability to follow written procedures, checklists, templates, and deadlines.

* Ability to manage multiple cases and assignments at the same time.

* Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional workspace.

* Strong computer and data-entry skills.

* Ability to work independently while remaining responsive to supervisors and team members.

* Willingness to learn personal injury terminology, procedures, and software.

* Ability to protect confidential and sensitive client information.

* Availability to work during required U.S. Eastern Time hours.



Preferred Qualifications



* Previous experience with a personal injury law firm.

* Previous experience as a legal assistant, intake specialist, receptionist, case assistant, client care specialist, or customer-service representative.

* Familiarity with SmartAdvocate, Case Status, GoHighLevel, DocuBee, RingCentral, Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, or electronic fax systems.

* Experience communicating with insurance companies, medical providers, law firms, or injured clients.

* Familiarity with medical terminology, insurance claims, medical records, and legal documents.



Legal experience is preferred but not required. We are willing to train a dependable candidate whose values, communication style, and work ethic align with our firm.



Performance Expectations



The selected candidate will be expected to:



* Answer and return communications promptly.

* Maintain accurate and complete case notes.

* Complete assigned tasks by their deadlines.

* Follow up consistently without requiring repeated reminders.

* Keep client and case information confidential.

* Communicate professionally with clients, providers, insurance representatives, attorneys, and coworkers.

* Identify urgent matters and escalate them appropriately.

* Remain available and responsive during scheduled working hours.

* Follow the firm’s procedures and accept coaching and feedback.

* Maintain a client-focused, solution-oriented attitude.



Technology and Workspace Requirements



The candidate must have:



* A reliable computer capable of running web-based legal software.

* A stable, high-speed internet connection.

* A working headset with a clear microphone.

* A quiet and private workspace suitable for confidential client calls.

* A backup plan for internet or power interruptions.

* The ability to participate in video meetings, training sessions, and screen-sharing.



Compensation



The starting rate is $3.00–$4.00 USD per hour, depending on experience, communication skills, and demonstrated ability.



Compensation may be reviewed based on performance, reliability, attendance, quality of work, and the ability to take on additional responsibilities.



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your updated résumé.

2. A brief explanation of your legal, intake, customer-service, or administrative experience.

3. A short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you are interested in the position.

4. Your available working hours in U.S. Eastern Time.

5. Your internet speed and backup internet or power options.

6. The software and case-management systems you have previously used.

7. Your requested hourly rate within the posted compensation range.



Please begin your application with the words “Client Care First” so we know you carefully reviewed the entire job posting.

description:
About The Attic AI



The Attic AI is an AI company that builds and deploys AI and machine learning solutions for clients across different industries. We handle the end-to-end lifecycle, from scoping and data pipeline design through model development, deployment, and monitoring. Our team includes data scientists, ML engineers, software engineers, and R&D researchers working together to deliver production-grade AI systems. We're a growing team, which means you'll have real ownership over how things are built and how we operate.



Role Overview



As Senior Data Engineer, you'll own the lakehouse that powers our AI and analytics solutions: medallion architecture, Delta Lake table design, Unity Catalog governance, and the ETL/ELT templates that other engineering teams adopt. This is a hands-on role that goes well beyond infrastructure operations — you'll model data, encode business rules, design opinionated transformation patterns, and land curated datasets that AI consumers rely on, with real ownership from scoping through deployment and governance.



⚠️ Databricks is a hard requirement for this role. Applicants without hands-on, production-level Databricks experience (not just exposure or fundamentals-level training) will not be considered, regardless of other qualifications.



What you'll work on:



- Building medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) end-to-end across enterprise data domains, including Delta Lake table design with partitioning, Z-ordering, schema evolution, and retention policies

- Authoring production Spark and PySpark pipelines for batch and streaming ingestion, orchestrated through Databricks Workflows with proper retry, alerting, and lineage capture

- Designing opinionated ETL/ELT templates and reusable transformation libraries (Python, PySpark, SQL) that other engineering teams adopt as new data sources land

- Implementing Unity Catalog as the central governance, lineage, and access control layer, including ABAC and row/column-level security policies

- Building feature pipelines and curated training datasets for AI and ML consumers, including ingesting unstructured content into vector-ready representations for retrieval and semantic search

- Maintaining technical documentation, architectural diagrams, runbooks, and ADRs, and partnering with Solution Architects on the engagement and client side



Basic qualifications:



- Production experience with Databricks is required (workspaces, compute, Workflows, Delta Lake, serverless SQL) — this is a must-have, not a nice-to-have

- At least 4 years of professional experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, or in a similar data platform role

- Has built medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) end-to-end in a production environment, not only operated an existing one

- Strong PySpark and SQL fluency, with the ability to design opinionated transformation patterns at scale

- Hands-on Unity Catalog experience (lineage, ABAC, external locations, Delta Sharing)

- Strong Python at production grade, including testing, packaging, and CI/CD discipline

- Comfortable with at least one cloud data layer (Azure ADLS Gen2 strongly preferred, AWS S3 acceptable)

- Documentation discipline and strong communication skills, including the ability to walk a client Solution Architect through design choices and trade-offs



Work Setup:



- Open to Philippine-based applicants only

- Remote (optional co-working space in BGC)

- Full-time

- Shift: 6:00 AM – 3:00 PM or 7:00 PM – 2:00 AM

title: Lead Direct Response Video Editor
description:
Lead Direct Response Video Editor — JustFloow



Full-time | Remote | Long-term role with leadership growth path



About Us

JustFloow is a fast-growing, seven-figure UK supplement brand. Our products, Genius Mind (cognitive performance) and Aura (nicotine-free nootropic pouches), are sold through paid social, primarily Meta. Creative is our biggest growth lever, and we take it seriously: structured weekly ideation, data-driven learnings, and a kill/iterate/scale verdict system on every ad.



The Role

This is NOT a "make it look nice" editing job. We're hiring an editor who is experienced in performance marketing and has been working with e-commerce brands for over 1 year. If it's in the supplement niche, then that's a benefit. It's key that the person we are hiring understands that every cut, caption, and pacing decision exists to hold and grab attention, show transformations, evoke emotions, show mechanisms and drive conversions.



You'll receive concepts and scripts from our creative team, but we don't want an order-taker. We want someone who takes the idea and makes it better. If we hand you a concept and you return exactly what was written without any critical thinking or creativity or editorial judgement, then this role isn't for you.



What you'll do

Edit direct response video ads for Meta (and TikTok/YouTube) — UGC-style, native-feel, VSL-style, and static-motion hybrids

Elevate every brief. Take our concept and improve it: stronger hook cuts, better pacing, smarter b-roll choices, and scroll-stopping first 3 seconds. First drafts should be near-final, not the start of five feedback rounds



Think in metrics. You know what hook rate, hold rate, and thumbstop mean. You watch retention graphs and adjust your editing accordingly



Produce hook variations. Deliver multiple hook cuts per concept as standard because you know that's how winners are found



Work fast under pressure. We run a weekly creative cadence with real deadlines. Quality AND speed, not one or the other

Own your craft. Study winning ads in the DTC/supplement space, bring references and ideas proactively, level up the whole team's output



Lead as we grow. This role has a path to leading our editing team, as we're on a trajectory to grow and hire a bigger team soon setting standards, reviewing others' work, building our editing playbook



Who we're looking for:



- 2+ years editing paid social direct response ads — not YouTube vlogs, not wedding videos, not corporate explainers. Ads that spent real money

- Deep fluency in Premiere Pro or CapCut Pro (After Effects a plus)

- You understand DR principles: hooks, pattern interrupts, pacing for retention, captions that hold attention, native platform feel

- Strong editorial judgment — you improve briefs, you don't just execute them

- You handle deadline pressure without quality dropping

- Excellent communication in English, reliable delivery, zero excuses culture

- Reliable internet, capable editing machine



Bonus points

- Supplement / health / wellness brand experience

- Experience with UGC creator footage and raw-asset organisation

- Motion graphics ability for statics-in-motion and mechanism visualisations

- Experience leading or reviewing other editors' work



What we offer:

- Competitive salary (based on experience) — paid on time, every time

- Full-time, long-term, stable role with a genuine leadership path

- Direct access to performance data — you'll SEE how your edits perform

- Work directly with the founder and growth team; your ideas get shipped

- 13th month pay and paid time off



How to apply — READ CAREFULLY



We only review applications that follow these instructions exactly. This is a precision role — the application is your first test.

Start your application with the word "THUMBSTOP" in the first line.



Include a portfolio of 3–5 direct response ads you personally edited. For each, tell us: the brand/product, what the brief was, and what YOU changed or added that improved it. (If you can share performance results, even better.)



Answer this in your own words: We send you a script for a 45-second UGC-style ad. The hook as written feels weak. What do you do and give us a real example of how you'd strengthen a weak hook.



Tell us your average turnaround time for a 60-second AI voiceover + b-roll DR ad (first draft), your expected monthly salary, and earliest start date.



Attach a short Loom video (2–3 minutes): introduce yourself and walk us through your single best-performing ad why it worked.



Applications missing any element above are deleted unread. Generic copy-paste applications are obvious and ignored.

title: Finance Assistant/Bookholder
description:
The Finance Assistant will be responsible for the reconciliation and management of internal accounts, assist the Assistant Finance Manager with daily accounting tasks such as updating internal system information with new data, communicating important and necessary information to the team, manage and execute daily transactions. The incumbent will also assist in the annual filings, file monthly reconciliations, and maintain electronic files and folders.



Reporting Line:

Day-to-day: Bookholders ? Assistant Finance Manager

Cash Flow, Compliance, Coordination: Bookholders ? Finance Manager

Key Responsibilities:

1. Property Financial Oversight (Reports to Asst FM) 

Manage all financial operations for assigned properties on behalf of the landlord.

Maintain accurate ledgers for rent, fees, expenses, and reserves per property.

Reconcile accounts regularly and ensure completeness and accuracy.



 2. Tenant Accounts & Rent Management (Reports to Asst FM) 

Monitor tenant accounts and process rent collections.

Apply payments accurately and handle late payments or delinquencies.

Serve as the first point of contact for tenant financial inquiries.



3. Vendor & Expense Management (Reports to Asst FM) 

Review and approve property-related invoices for Asst FM review.

Track recurring and one-time property expenses.

Ensure timely payment of vendors and compliance with budgets.



4. Reporting (Reports to Asst FM, with FM oversight) 

Prepare property-specific financial statements (Income, Expenses, Cash Flow, Budget vs. Actual).

Submit reports to Asst FM for consolidation and landlord presentation.

Escalate unusual financial activity to Asst FM, who may involve the FM.



5. Cash Flow Management (Reports to Asst FM, with FM oversight)

Monitor rental cash flow to ensure operating expenses and obligations are covered.

Flag any cash shortages or funding concerns to the FM.

Coordinate landlord distributions with FM approval.





6. Compliance & Documentation (Reports to FM) 

Ensure all financial activities comply with company policy, lease agreements, and regulatory requirements.

Maintain organized records for audits, inspections, and landlord review.

Report compliance concerns directly to FM.



 7. Coordination & Escalation (Reports to FM) 

Collaborate with property managers, maintenance, and other departments for smooth operations.

Escalate complex or cross-departmental financial issues directly to FM.

Support FM in ensuring timely financial decision-making across teams.

Qualifications:

1-2 years of General Accounting experience

Experience with Microsoft Excel, including the ability to understand and manipulate basic spreadsheets

Proficient Accounting and computer skills with the ability to quickly learn new programs

Effective communication skills, with the ability to clearly and concisely express ideas both verbally and in writing

Ability to display absolute discretion and confidentiality regarding sensitive information

Ability to take initiative to identify, prioritize and implement all elements required for the team to fulfill responsibilities

Ability to work well under pressure and effectively handle multiple, concurrent demands and appropriately prioritize responsibilities

Real Estate experience a plus

Quickbooks experience a plus



































































Key Interview Questions – Finance Assistant / Bookholder

???? Experience & Background

Can you describe the most complex reconciliation you’ve handled? What errors did you find, and how did you resolve them?





Have you ever managed accounts for multiple properties or clients at the same time? How did you stay organized?





What financial systems and tools have you used (QuickBooks, Excel, property management software)? Which one challenged you the most and why?







???? Property Financial Oversight

If you discover that a property’s ledger shows a surplus but the landlord insists there is a deficit, how would you verify the accuracy and explain your findings?





How would you handle a situation where rental income has been misallocated between two properties?





Tell me about a time when you found inconsistencies in property-related financial data. What steps did you take?







???? Tenant Accounts & Rent Management

A tenant claims they already paid rent, but there’s no record in the system. How do you investigate and resolve this?





How do you track and follow up on delinquent accounts without damaging the tenant relationship?





What process do you follow to ensure tenant payment entries are accurate and timely?







???? Vendor & Expense Management

If two invoices come in for the same service but with different amounts, how would you determine which one to process?





What steps do you take to ensure recurring expenses don’t exceed the approved budget?





Have you ever caught an error or overcharge from a vendor? How did you handle it?







???? Reporting & Cash Flow Management

How do you make sure your monthly reports are both accurate and ready on time, especially when you are managing multiple deadlines?





If you identify a cash flow shortfall for a property, what immediate actions would you take before escalating it to the Finance Manager?





What steps do you take to ensure accuracy in budget vs. actual reporting?







???? Compliance & Documentation

How do you make sure financial activities comply with lease agreements and company policies?





If an auditor asks for supporting documentation and you discover missing records, what would be your approach?





Tell me about a time you had to handle sensitive or confidential financial information. How did you protect it?







???? Coordination & Escalation

A property manager pushes you to approve an expense that doesn’t follow policy. What would you do?





How do you balance communication between landlords, tenants, and internal teams when dealing with financial disputes?





Tell me about a time you escalated a financial issue to leadership. What was the outcome?







???? Tools & Technical Skills

Walk me through how you would set up a spreadsheet in Excel to track rent payments for 50+ tenants.





How do you avoid errors when multiple tea
mbers are updating the same QuickBooks or Excel file?





Have you ever suggested or implemented a change to improve financial workflows? What was the impact?







???? Problem-Solving & Judgment

Imagine you discover that monthly reconciliations were skipped for two months. How would you catch up and ensure no errors were missed?





You’re under pressure to close books, but you notice a suspicious transaction. Do you escalate immediately or finish closing first? Why?





What’s the biggest financial mistake you’ve ever made, and how did you correct it?







???? Commitment & Fit

This role requires handling multiple properties/accounts at once. How do you manage time and prioritize when everything feels urgent?





How do you stay calm and accurate when deadlines overlap and you’re under pressure?





What motivates you more: accuracy, deadlines, or recognition? Why?

title: Senior Technical Project Manager (Independent Contractor)
description:
Location: Remote - Philippines

Reports to: Strategic Implementation and Success Lead (US Based)

Engagement Type: Independent Contractor

Schedule: Full-time engagement; consistent availability during an agreed US Mountain Time schedule (for example, 7:00 a.m.-3:00 p.m., 8:00 a.m.-4:00 p.m., or 9:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. MT), subject to project and client needs.



The Opportunity

EETech is a growing systems integrator with proprietary commerce technology. We are seeking two Philippines-based independent contractors to provide Senior Technical Project Management services as part of our overseas team. 

Our development environment is highly mature, featuring strong, autonomous developers and excellent architects. This engagement is not focused on micromanaging engineering work. Instead, we need experienced technical project management professionals who excel at meticulous tracking, capacity visibility, coordination, and clear reporting. Resources are currently managed across Azure Boards and 
, and these contractors will help maintain accurate, reliable project data so US leadership has a current view of project health. 



The work will primarily support two project tracks:

• Track 1 - Client Implementations: Manage the pipeline of third-party software integrations and standard digital presence projects.

• Track 2 - Core Platform and Launches: Manage the internal development roadmap for EETech Commerce while coordinating client projects launching on the platform.



Scope of Services

Visibility and Tracking

• Maintain accurate project and task data within Azure Boards and 
 so US leadership has reliable visibility into project status.

• Build and maintain capacity-planning trackers to forecast developer bandwidth and identify potential bottlenecks.

• Prepare clear, concise weekly status reports for the US Client Solutions team and VP. 



Agile Facilitation and Unblocking

• Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including stand-ups and sprint planning, to support overall project alignment.

• Proactively identify and help resolve project blockers, including obtaining pending client assets or technical decisions needed from architects so developers can remain focused on development work.



Cross-Functional Coordination

• For Client Implementations, coordinate third-party technology integrations against the applicable Statement of Work established with the US Success Leads.

• For Core Platform projects, coordinate competing priorities involving internal platform upgrades, architect requests, and custom feature requirements associated with upcoming client launches.



Client Engagement and Communication

• Engage directly with clients as needed to gather requirements, follow up on deliverables, and keep projects moving forward.

• Communicate clearly and confidently with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into plain-English project updates.

• Represent the project team professionally in client-facing interactions and maintain a positive, solutions-oriented approach.



Required Experience and Qualifications

• 4+ years of technical project management experience in software development.

• Proven experience managing capacity and resource planning in a matrix environment, including shared technical resources across implementations, maintenance, and internal SaaS projects.

• Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to build and maintain capacity trackers using tools such as Excel or 
.

• Working knowledge of web architecture sufficient to understand what senior developers and architects are building and translate technical information into clear updates for US stakeholders.

• Experience managing project processes in an environment where engineers retain ownership of technical implementation and code.

• Deep experience with Azure DevOps, particularly Azure Boards, and modern project-tracking tools such as 
.



Preferred Traits

• Comfortable with client-facing communication and building strong working relationships.

• Proactive, solutions-oriented approach with a strong sense of ownership.

• High level of accountability and ability to move initiatives forward independently.

• Naturally curious and interested in continuous learning and improvement.

• Strong attention to detail.

• Quick learner.



Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is for an independent contractor located in the Philippines and is not an offer of employment with EETech. The contractor will provide services under an independent contractor agreement and will be responsible for their own taxes, statutory contributions, insurance, equipment, and other obligations applicable to an independent business or self-employed service provider, except as otherwise stated in the written contractor agreement. The contractor relationship, compensation, invoicing terms, confidentiality, intellectual property obligations, termination provisions, and other contractual terms will be governed by the final written independent contractor agreement.



Nothing in this posting is intended to create an employer-employee relationship. The contractor will retain responsibility for the manner and means of performing the services, subject to agreed deliverables, deadlines, client commitments, security requirements, collaboration needs, and required availability windows.



Application Note

Please reply to this posting with your favorite color in the first line so we know you read the full description.

We are expanding our reach and looking for a data-driven, creative Email Marketing Expert to join our team and turn cold/warm lists into high-converting solar appointments.

Campaign Management: Set up, launch, and manage email marketing campaigns targeting residential homeowners.



Copywriting: Write compelling, high-converting email copy tailored to the solar industry.



List Management & Segmentation: Clean, organize, and segment email lists to ensure maximum engagement and minimize spam rates.



A/B Testing: Continuously test subject lines, email bodies, and send times to optimize open and click-through rates.



Tracking & Reporting: Provide weekly reports on key metrics (Open rates, CTR, Unsubscribes, and Lead Conversions).

Mastery of email marketing platforms (e.g., ActiveCampaign, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, or similar).



Strong understanding of email deliverability, SPF/DKIM/DMARC setups, and avoiding spam folders.



Exceptional written English skills with a knack for persuasive, direct-response copywriting.



Reliable high-speed internet connection and a distraction-free workspace.



Self-motivated and able to work independently within a 2-4 hour daily window.

Note: Your earning potential here is heavily tied to your success. If you know how to write emails that convert, you will make excellent money.

A brief summary of your email marketing experience (especially any experience in the solar or home improvement niches).

Help keep our technicians' schedules full



Performance Expectations

Contact a minimum of 20 customers per hour



Target 10–15 booked maintenance appointments per hour



Maintain strong attendance and productivity



Consistently track calls, contacts, and appointments booked



Communicate professionally with every customer



Requirements



Advanced/fluent English is required



Excellent spoken English with clear pronunciation



Strong customer service and communication skills

Confident asking customers to schedule appointments



Friendly, upbeat, and professional personality



Ability to follow scripts and processes



Strong computer skills and ability to learn scheduling/CRM software



Reliable internet connection



Reliable computer and headset



Quiet and professional work environment

Appointment setting



Customer service



Call centers

description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.



Qualifications



Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

• Handle support tickets from US medical practices

• Diagnose and fix GoHighLevel workflow issues

• Troubleshoot appointment booking and automation problems

• Support EMR sync issues (appointments, patient data)

• Help resolve insurance verification issues

• Communicate clearly with clinic staff and managers

• Document every issue with root cause and solution

• Help improve internal SOPs and AI support systems

• At least 2 years of GoHighLevel experience

• Strong understanding of workflows, triggers, pipelines, tags

• Experience supporting clients in SaaS or automation tools

• Strong problem-solving skills, you focus on “why it broke”

• Excellent written English

• Comfortable working US business hours (Central or Eastern time)

• Reliable internet and work setup



Nice to Have



• Experience with healthcare workflows

• Experience with EMRs like eClinicalWorks, Athena, Epic

• Knowledge of insurance verification systems

• Experience with automation tools or RPA

• Familiar with AI tools like ChatGPT



Work Schedule and Pay



• Full-time, 40 hours per week

• US Central or Eastern time coverage

• $9 to $12 per hour based on experience

• Performance bonuses based on quality and client satisfaction

• Growth path to Senior or Team Lead role



Why This Role Matters



Medical clinics depend on our system daily.



If something breaks, patients cannot book appointments. Clinics lose revenue.



You are the person who keeps everything running smoothly.



How to Apply



Send the following:



Short intro. Why this role fits you



Resume or LinkedIn

Loom video (2 to 3 minutes):

Show a GoHighLevel workflow you built or fixed

Explain what it does in simple terms



Answer these questions:



Question 1

A client says something is not working in their automation.

What are the first 2 things you would check?



Question 2

A client is frustrated and says the system is “broken.”

How would you respond in your first message?



Question 3

Tell us about a time you fixed a technical problem.

What was the issue and how did you solve it?



Important

Use the word ZAYAHELP in your subject line when you apply.

If this word is missing, your application will not be reviewed.

Applications without Loom video and answers will not be reviewed.

title: Content Writer
description:
About Fusion Vine

Fusion Vine is a remote-first company focused on building efficient, scalable systems that help businesses grow through smart operations, content, and digital execution. We specialize in combining human talent with AI-powered workflows to deliver high-quality results at scale.



Our team values clarity, accountability, continuous improvement, and performance-based growth. We work with clear processes, defined expectations, and a strong focus on outcomes.



Role Overview

Fusion Vine is hiring a Content Specialist to help scale content production through AI-assisted workflows. This role is ideal for motivated writers who can combine strong English skills with critical thinking and smart use of AI tools. Entry-level candidates are welcome: if you can think critically and move fast, we can work with you.



Key Goal

Produce high-quality, accurate, and well-structured content at speed: using AI as a tool, not a shortcut: while maintaining clarity, brand voice, and defined quality standards.



Responsibilities

Write and deliver content using AI models as a writing aid, not a replacement for judgment

Critically review and refine AI-generated drafts for readability, accuracy, tone, and structure

Fact-check content and ensure it meets quality standards before submission

Follow content briefs, SOPs, and style guidelines closely

Complete assigned article bundles within agreed timelines

Edit for grammar, readability, and proper formatting

Stay productive and proactive: do not wait to be pushed into tasks



Requirements

Strong English proficiency: written and reading comprehension

Ability to think critically and improve AI-generated content rather than copy it blindly

Self-motivated with a strong sense of urgency and follow-through

Reliable internet connection and a suitable work device

Ability to follow instructions, briefs, and feedback closely

Critical thinking and troubleshooting is essential

Comfortable using AI tools for content creation and editing

Entry-level candidates accepted: hustle and critical thinking matter more than years of experience



Nice to Have

Foundational knowledge or genuine interest in the topics being covered

Experience with SEO content writing

Familiarity with content management systems

Background in marketing, blogs, or long-form content

Prior experience working in a remote or freelance setting



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Speed of delivery: complete article bundles quickly and on schedule (e.g., 15 articles in 2 days, not 2 weeks)

Quality of output: submit polished, reviewed content that meets defined completion criteria

Critical thinking: demonstrate genuine review and refinement of AI outputs, not blind copy-paste

Responsiveness: jump into assigned projects immediately without delay

Consistency: maintain steady, reliable output throughout the trial period and beyond



Compensation

$3.50 – $5.00 per hour (we have 1 month trial worth of $3/hour, converting it to $5/hour after 1 month)

Rate determined based on experience, skills, and performance during the trial period

Piecework/bundle-based structure: payment upon completion of each assigned bundle

One-month trial period to assess fit and performance

Opportunity to increase rate and expand hours after a successful trial



Why Join Fusion Vine?

Fully remote work environment

Clear systems, expectations, and feedback from day one

Performance-based growth: your results determine your opportunities

Hands-on experience with AI-powered content workflows

Opportunity for long-term partnership if the trial goes well

Entry-level friendly: we value drive and quality output over credentials

title: Creative Manager (WordPress, Shopify, HTML/CSS)
description:
We’re a U.S.-based consulting and technology company with an international team. We build and manage websites, apps, digital products, and brands for clients across many industries.

We’re looking for a Creative Manager / Web Designer who can lead the creative direction of digital projects while also being hands-on with execution.



This is not a junior role and not a social media position.



We’re looking for someone with a strong design eye who can take a project from an idea or brief to a polished, professional digital experience. You should be comfortable creating mockups, developing visual direction, working with developers, and being hands-on with WordPress when needed.



You don’t need to be a full-time developer. Strong design and creative thinking come first.



What You’ll Do



Lead the visual and creative direction of website and software projects

Translate briefs and ideas into clear visual concepts, layouts, and mockups

Create website designs that are clean, modern, professional, and user-focused

Develop page layouts and design systems rather than relying solely on pre-built templates

Design website interfaces and user experiences with attention to usability and conversion

Customize themes, layouts, and page-builder components when needed

Work closely with developers and internal teams to bring designs to life

Review completed work and ensure the final product matches the intended design

Identify design, layout, UX, and usability issues and propose solutions

Manage multiple creative projects and keep work moving toward deadlines

Communicate directly with internal teams and, when needed, clients





Required Skills



Strong background in web and digital design

Excellent eye for layout, typography, spacing, hierarchy, color, and visual consistency

Experience designing websites from scratch or through custom mockups

Strong WordPress experience, including themes, page builders, plugins, and customization

Good understanding of UX/UI principles and responsive design

Ability to turn a brief or rough idea into a clear visual direction

Ability to manage multiple projects independently

Strong written English and communication skills

A portfolio that demonstrates actual website and digital product design work





Nice to Have



Figma or similar design/prototyping tools

JavaScript knowledge

Experience working with developers

Experience managing designers or creative teams

SEO and website performance knowledge

Experience designing web applications or software interfaces

Branding and visual identity experience





What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who can look at a blank page and know how to turn it into something good.



You should be able to:



Take a vague idea and develop a creative direction

Create mockups before jumping into a template

Explain why a design works, not just make something look nice

Recognize when a website feels dated, cluttered, inconsistent, or poorly structured

Balance aesthetics with usability and business objectives

Work independently and make thoughtful creative decisions

Collaborate with developers without needing to be a developer yourself

Take ownership of a project from concept through completion





This Role Is NOT For You If



Your experience is primarily social media graphics or Canva

You primarily work from pre-built templates without developing your own design direction

You consider yourself a developer first and have limited experience with visual design

You need detailed instructions for every step of a project

You’re looking for a short-term freelance gig

You’re not comfortable taking ownership of creative decisions





What We Value

Design thinking. Ownership. Initiative. Attention to detail.



We want someone who doesn't just execute instructions, but can look at a project and say, “Here's how I think we should approach this."



Technical skills are valuable, but your ability to think creatively, solve design problems, and produce strong digital experiences is what matters most.



How to Apply

Please include:



Your resume

Your portfolio

Examples of websites or digital products you have designed

A brief explanation of your role in those projects





Please do not submit a portfolio consisting primarily of social media graphics or Canva templates. We are specifically looking for strong web and digital design work.
