title: YouTube Video Podcast Editor
description:
Role (Overview of the Position)

Fertility Friday Publishing — a High-Level Women's Health and Fertility Coaching Business — is looking for a skilled YouTube Video Podcast Editor to join our content production team on a per-video basis.



We are launching a video podcast on YouTube and need an editor who can take raw podcast recordings and turn them into polished, professional, engaging video episodes. Our episodes will be 10 to 20 minutes and will feature multi-camera setups.



This is an execution-focused, deliverable-based role. You will receive raw footage, audio files, and creative direction, and you will deliver completed, publish-ready YouTube videos on a consistent schedule. Thoughtful creative input is welcome — if you see a way to make the final product better, we want to hear it — but the heart of this role is reliable, high-quality editing output, not strategy or content planning.



It's a great fit for someone who takes pride in clean, professional edits, has a sharp eye for pacing and visual quality, delivers on time without reminders, and enjoys the craft of making videos that hold a viewer's attention.



Responsibilities (Tasks Associated with the Role)

- Editing raw podcast video recordings (10–20 minutes) into polished, publish-ready YouTube episodes.

- Seamlessly syncing and cutting between multiple camera angles to create a dynamic, professional viewing experience.

- Syncing audio and video tracks cleanly, ensuring perfect alignment throughout.

- Adding on-brand graphics, lower thirds, text overlays, background images, and visual elements that enhance the content without cluttering it.

- Creating and maintaining a branded video intro (approximately 15–30 seconds) and outro, and applying them consistently across episodes.

- Color correcting and adjusting footage for a clean, consistent visual quality.

- Exporting final videos in YouTube-optimized formats and specs.

- Incorporating revision notes promptly and accurately.

- Designing eye-catching YouTube thumbnails for each episode that are on-brand, visually compelling, and optimized for click-through (strong plus — not required, but a significant advantage).

- Communicating any issues, questions, or delays proactively — before the deadline, not after.



Requirements (Expected Proficiencies)

- Minimum 2 years of experience editing podcast or interview-style videos for YouTube — this is non-negotiable. We need someone who already knows how to edit this content format and can demonstrate it.

- Proficient in professional editing software (Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or equivalent).

- Demonstrated skill with multi-camera editing — syncing, cutting between angles, and maintaining a natural flow.

- Competent with motion graphics, text overlays, lower thirds, and visual enhancements (After Effects, Canva, or similar tools are a plus).

- Strong audio-video sync skills and basic audio cleanup ability.

- Reliable and accountable — you meet deadlines, communicate clearly, and own your work, including mistakes.

- A try-first problem-solver — when something is unclear, you make a reasonable attempt or do your own research before asking, and when you do ask, the question is specific.

- Comfortable receiving direct feedback and revision notes without taking it personally — you see revisions as part of producing great work.

- Fluent enough in written English for clear communication via
 and project management tools.

- Experience with YouTube upload specs, formats, and best practices.

- Experience designing YouTube thumbnails (Canva, Photoshop, or similar) is a strong plus — if you can deliver both the edit and the thumbnail, that's a significant advantage.

- Familiarity with AI-assisted editing tools is a plus, but not required.





What We're Not Looking For:

This role is not a fit if you:

- Have experience only with short-form social media clips (Reels, TikToks, Shorts) but not long-form YouTube video editing.

- Prefer to work without deadlines or structured feedback cycles.

- Are looking for a strategy or creative director role — this is hands-on editing work.

- Cannot provide links to published YouTube videos you have edited.



How Success is Measured in this Role:

- Turnaround Time — Completed edits are delivered within the agreed timeframe, consistently and without reminders.

- Edit Quality — Videos are polished, cuts are clean and natural, audio is perfectly synced, graphics are on-brand, and the final product looks professional upon first delivery.

- Responsiveness & Communication — Messages are replied to within 24 hours. Blockers, delays, or questions are raised proactively and specifically — before the deadline is missed, not after.

- Revision Turnaround — Revision notes are incorporated accurately and returned promptly, without the same corrections needing to be repeated.



How to Apply

To be considered for this position, please submit the following:

- Complete the application form (all questions completed): 

- Link to your CV / resume.

- Links to 1–2 YouTube channels or specific YouTube videos where you did the editing. This is required. We want to see your actual published work — the quality, pacing, graphics, and camera-angle cuts in a real video. Please link directly to the YouTube video(s).



This description is not all-inclusive and certain activities, duties, or responsibilities may be required of the employee as needed.

title: Facebook Media Buyer
description:
Hello. Currently, I am looking to hire a
 media buyer who understands how the ad platform works.



Things you must understand:

- We hate Advantage Plus creative features. Turn them off at all costs.

- You must understand how big caps work, how to navigate the Meta platform, and work with us to get our campaigns launched and ready.



I'm looking for someone to work with long term, but want to start you off with some gig work in terms of launching our ads. 



Here's the situation we are currently in: our old ad account had gotten banned, and we need to relaunch all of our old ads. (It's a lot)



You will be guided on the way you want to do it. You will be provided with a creative tracker, and the bulk majority of our ads are already launched for you. 



You will need to finish setting up our USA campaign and also set up a worldwide campaign for us. 



You are going to take it slow with the initial launches, meaning you will launch three ad sets at a time. Wait for the ads to get scheduled/approved, and then launch the next ones. 



If an ad gets rejected, you immediately replace it with an image of a puppy. Let that ad get approved, and then turn it off. 



We need to maintain the integrity of our ad account, especially with the current end wave going on. If you're up for a media buying challenge and you want to potentially work with us long term, drop your resume, and I'll be in touch with you to get you going, possibly even today.

title: Shopify Developer & CRO Specialist
description:

We're a Toronto-based children's e-commerce brand looking for a Shopify Developer & CRO Specialist to be our on-demand technical resource. This isn't a fixed daily role — it flexes with what the team needs each week, from building out a new page to fixing conversion friction to implementing a design/content request. You'll work directly with our founder and our content and social teams to turn requests into live, working improvements on our Shopify store.

title: E-Commerce Manager / Growth & Funnel Specialist (AI-First)
description:
Remote · Full-Time  

$1,200–$2,500/month based on experience



Pet Printed is an international DTC e-commerce company operating across multiple European markets and the US.



We're looking for an E-Commerce Manager / Project Lead who can take new ideas, products and opportunities and turn them into real, live e-commerce projects.



This is a hands-on role with a high level of ownership.



You won't just manage projects. You'll help shape them, build them and drive them from the initial idea to launch.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



You will take ownership of new e-commerce projects from idea to execution.



That could mean launching a new product, building a new funnel, testing a new e-commerce concept or developing a new customer journey.



You'll be expected to understand the opportunity, figure out what needs to happen and drive the project forward.



Depending on the project, this can include:



• Researching markets, competitors and customers  

• Developing new e-commerce concepts and funnels  

• Turning opportunities into clear plans and concrete next steps  

• Building and launching landing pages, PDPs and funnels  

• Developing offers, positioning and customer journeys  

• Using AI to research, prototype, build and automate  

• Working across marketing, creative, development and operations  

• Bringing in the right people when their expertise is needed  

• Solving problems and removing blockers independently  

• Taking projects from concept to a live first version quickly  

• Testing new tools, technologies and workflows  

• Continuously finding better and faster ways to execute  



The expectation is simple:



If you own a project, you move it forward.



You don't wait for someone to break the project down into individual tasks or tell you what the next step should be.





AI-FIRST



AI is a core part of how we work and a core requirement for this role.



We're looking for someone who has already gone deep into modern AI tools and workflows and actively uses them to increase what they can accomplish.



We work with tools such as Claude, Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, MCP connectors and AI automations.



But the specific tools matter less than your ability to use them effectively.



You should be able to use AI to research faster, build faster, automate repetitive work, solve technical problems and turn ideas into working solutions.



We're looking for someone who follows this space closely, experiments with new tools independently and continuously improves their own workflows.





WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Your previous job title matters less to us than what you've actually done and how you work.



You may currently work in e-commerce, growth, CRO, product, funnels or another adjacent field.



What we're looking for is a combination of e-commerce understanding, technical curiosity, AI proficiency and strong ownership.



You should:



• Have hands-on experience in DTC or e-commerce  

• Understand funnels, offers, landing pages, customer journeys and conversion  

• Have a strong general understanding of digital marketing  

• Have taken meaningful ownership of projects before  

• Be comfortable making decisions and moving forward without perfect information  

• Be able to turn ideas into things that actually go live  

• Be highly proficient with modern AI tools and workflows  

• Have strong technical problem-solving skills  

• Learn new tools and systems quickly  

• Work independently without needing detailed instructions  

• Communicate clearly and proactively  

• Move quickly without sacrificing quality  

• Be curious and resourceful  

• Have high standards for your own work  

• Actively look for better ways to do things  

• Want to become exceptionally good at e-commerce and AI-enabled execution  



We care more about your ability, ownership and learning speed than the number of years on your CV.





WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT



This is not a traditional project management position.



Your job is not to move tickets around, schedule meetings and ask other people for status updates.



It's also not a narrowly defined specialist position where you only touch one part of the project.



We want someone who can see the bigger picture, get into the details and take responsibility for moving a project from an idea to something real.



You should be comfortable operating in an environment where the answer isn't always obvious and where figuring out how to make something work is part of the job.





HOW WE WORK



We move quickly, test frequently and keep our teams lean.



You'll work closely with our founders and people across marketing, creative, development and operations.



We expect people to take ownership, communicate openly and continuously raise the standard of their work.



As you prove that you can successfully own and execute projects, you'll take responsibility for increasingly important parts of the business.



There is significant room for this role to grow.





HOW TO APPLY



We care much more about what you've actually built and how you think than about your CV.



Start your application with the words:



I'M ALL IN FOR PET PRINTED



Applications that don't start with these words will not be considered.



Then please send us:





1. THE PROJECT YOU'RE MOST PROUD OF



Show us one project you've worked on that you're genuinely proud of.



This should be a project where you personally had meaningful responsibility for making it happen.



Please include a link to the actual project.



Briefly explain:



• What was the project?  

• What was your personal responsibility?  

• What was the biggest challenge?  

• How did you solve it?  

• What made the project successful?  

• What was the outcome?  



Be specific about what you personally did rather than what the overall team accomplished.



We want to understand how you approach problems, how you execute and how much ownership you actually take.





2. YOUR MONTHLY COMPENSATION EXPECTATION



Tell us your expected monthly compensation for a full-time role.





3. YOUR AVAILABILITY



When would you be able to start?





HIRING PROCESS



Application → Short Interview → Paid Test Project → Final Call



The paid test will give you a real problem similar to the projects you'd work on in this role.



We're looking for someone who combines strong e-commerce instincts with AI, technical problem-solving and the ability to turn ideas into execution.



If that sounds like the way you already work, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Acquisition Training & Performance Coach
description:
PLEASE APPLY THROUGH THIS LINK: 
/apply-job-1



About us:



With over 100 years of combined industry experience, the Community Minerals team specializes in the purchase of mineral or royalty rights all over the US. We have earned a stellar reputation with hundreds of satisfied customers and an “A” Rating with the Better Business Bureau. With our proven track record, we continue to serve mineral owners in several states with transparency, accountability, and a personalized experience to meet individual needs.



Job Summary:



The Acquisition Training & Performance Coach is responsible for providing dedicated training, coaching, and performance support to the Acquisition Department. This role focuses on developing role-specific knowledge, skills, processes, and behaviors required for successful performance across Acquisition functions. The role is responsible for delivering Acquisition-specific training, facilitating onboarding and refresher sessions, identifying capability gaps, and providing ongoing coaching to improve contractor performance, quality, productivity, and adherence to established processes and standards.



What You’ll Do:



Training Program Design & Development:

• Design and develop engaging training programs, modules, and materials aligned with Acquisition operational goals and requirements.

• Apply instructional design principles and adult learning methodologies.

• Customize learning solutions based on Acquisition business needs, role requirements, and competency gaps.

• Develop practical learning activities, assessments, and knowledge checks to reinforce understanding and application.

• Update training materials and resources when Acquisition processes, systems, tools, or SOPs change.

• Identify recurring knowledge gaps and develop appropriate training interventions.



Training Delivery & Facilitation:

• Facilitate instructor-led and virtual training sessions for contractors within the Acquisition Department.

• Ensure high-quality delivery and participant engagement.

• Coach and support facilitators/trainers as needed.

• Conduct onboarding, process training, refresher training, and upskilling sessions specific to Acquisition functions.

• Provide additional training or remediation to contractors who require further support.

• Support newly trained contractors during their transition into production.



Performance Coaching:

• Provide individual and group coaching to Acquisition contractors to support continuous performance improvement.

• Review performance results, quality findings, productivity data, and other relevant metrics to identify coaching opportunities.

• Provide timely, constructive, and actionable feedback to contractors.

• Develop coaching or performance improvement plans for contractors who require additional support.

• Monitor progress following coaching interventions and provide follow-up coaching as needed.

• Reinforce correct processes, behaviors, and best practices through continuous coaching.

• Recognize strong performance and encourage continuous development among high-performing contractors.

• Partner with Acquisition Team Leads to support performance improvement while maintaining clear accountability within the operational leadership structure.



Training Needs Analysis & Capability Assessment:

• Conduct training needs assessments within the Acquisition Department.

• Collaborate with Acquisition Team Leads to identify recurring performance issues that may be addressed through training or coaching.

• Analyze performance trends to determine whether gaps are related to knowledge, skills, process understanding, or execution.

• Recommend appropriate training and coaching interventions based on identified needs.

• Identify opportunities to strengthen role readiness, competency, and overall team capability.



Program Evaluation & Continuous Improvement:

• Measure training effectiveness through feedback, assessments, and performance metrics.

• Continuously improve programs based on evaluation results.

• Evaluate whether training and coaching interventions result in improvements in quality, productivity, accuracy, and process adherence.

• Identify recurring performance trends and recommend improvements to training content, coaching strategies, or operational processes.

• Work with Acquisition leadership to address recurring knowledge, skill, and performance gaps.

• Recommend improvements to onboarding, training, coaching, and knowledge reinforcement processes.



Stakeholder Collaboration:

• Partner with the Acquisition Operations Team Lead and Acquisition Team Leads to align learning initiatives with Acquisition operational priorities and performance goals.

• Provide recommendations to Acquisition leadership regarding capability gaps and performance development opportunities.

• Collaborate with Acquisition stakeholders to support process changes, new initiatives, and operational improvements requiring training or coaching.

• Support Acquisition initiatives that require training, coaching, or capability development.



Learning Administration & Reporting:

• Track training attendance, completion, and effectiveness.

• Maintain accurate training records and generate reports.

• Track coaching activities, performance improvement interventions, and competency outcomes.

• Prepare reports on training participation, competency results, coaching activities, and performance trends.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date Acquisition training materials and documentation.

• Provide management with insights and recommendations based on training and coaching data.



What We’re Looking For:



Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Education, or related field.



Experience:

• At least 7 years of experience in Learning and Development, Training, Coaching, Operations Training, or a related field.

• Approximately 3–5 years of relevant Sales experience, preferably with BPO or outbound Sales experience. Relevant Sales experience and demonstrated capability are highly preferred given the operational requirements of the role.



Technical Skills:

• Strong knowledge of instructional design models

• Experience in creating learning modules, facilitator guides, and e-learning content

• Proficiency in Learning Management Systems (LMS) and digital learning platforms

• Skilled in Microsoft Office tools, particularly PowerPoint, Excel, and Word

• Ability to analyze training metrics, completion rates, and effectiveness reports

• Familiarity with survey and assessment tools for learning evaluation.

• Strong understanding of Sales processes and customer engagement, with the ability to evaluate performance and identify areas for improvement.

• Ability to audit and review customer calls and assess areas such as confidence, engagement, probing, active listening, and adherence to established processes and standards.



Soft Skills:

• Excellent communication and presentation skills

• Strong facilitation and audience engagement capability

• Stakeholder management and business partnering skills

• Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking ability

• Effective time management and project coordination skills

• Adaptability in handling diverse learners and changing priorities

• Ability to provide clear, constructive, and actionable feedback through performance coaching.



Industry Knowledge:

• Foundational knowledge of upstream oil and gas operations, production, and well lifecycle.

• Understanding of marketed deal structures and acquisition processes is a plus.



Competencies and Attributes:

• Thrives in a fast-paced, remote-first work environment.

• Demonstrates discipline, focus, and reliability in support tasks.

• Aligns with the team’s emphasis on operational excellence, compliance, and support for technical evaluation.

• Open to collaboration, feedback, and process alignment across teams.



What's in it for You:

• Competitive Compensation: Earn $5.85 per hour paid in foreign currency, commensurate with your skills and experience.

title: Creative Editor - Direct Response - E-commerce
description:
Creative Editor - Direct Response - E-commerce



Remote · Full-time · Long-term



A little about us

We’re looking for an enthusiastic and experienced Creative Editor to join our e-commerce business.

We’ve been running our business successfully for more than 2 years, mainly in the health, wellness and beauty space. We use direct-response funnels and sell our products by understanding the customer behind them, their problems, desires, fears and emotions, and translating that into ads and funnels that convert.

We’re a small, ambitious team with high standards, but we also want people to be themselves, bring their own ideas and genuinely grow together with the business.

And right now, we’re looking for an important addition to our team: a strong Creative Editor.



The role

As a Creative Editor, you’ll turn our creative briefs, research and winning concepts into direct-response ads that actually sell.

You’ll work on both first-test creatives for new products and new iterations for our winning products.

Most of our creatives are currently image ads, but we want to expand further into video. So strong video editing skills are a big advantage.

We already have our own strategies, systems and SOPs in place. We want someone who can first learn the way we work and execute it consistently at a high level, but who also thinks with us.

If you see something that could be better or have an idea for a stronger execution, we want you to bring it to the table.

What you'll be doing



You will:

- Create direct-response image ads based on creative briefs.

- Turn hooks, angles and concepts into strong visual executions.

- Create creatives for both new product tests and existing winners.

- Create variations and iterations based on winning creatives.

- Adapt competitor inspiration into creatives for our own products and funnels.

- Make sure creatives follow the brief and communicate the intended message clearly.

- Pay close attention to copy, layout, product presentation and overall quality.

- Work closely with our Creative Manager and Creative Strategist.

- Process feedback and revisions quickly and accurately.

- Help us expand further into video creatives.

- Bring your own ideas when you see opportunities to improve.



For us, a good creative isn't simply something that looks nice. It needs to grab attention, communicate the right emotion or problem, and ultimately make someone want to take action.

Understanding why a creative should work is just as important as being able to create it.



Who we're looking for

Ideally, you already have experience creating ads for direct-response e-commerce. Experience in health, wellness or beauty is a big plus, but not a requirement.



We’re looking for someone who:

- Has experience creating direct-response e-commerce ads.

- Has strong image editing and design skills.

- Understands that performance creatives are different from regular graphic design.

- Can translate a brief into a strong creative without needing every detail explained.

- Has a good eye for layout, typography, visual hierarchy and composition.

- Is very detail-oriented and cares about delivering high-quality work.

- Can recreate, adapt and iterate on winning concepts.

- Works efficiently and handles feedback and revisions well.

- Takes ownership and brings their own ideas.

- Is curious, open to feedback and always looking to improve.

- Communicates clearly in English.

- Is looking for something long-term and genuinely wants to grow with the team.



Some of the tools we use

Canva · Higgsfield / other editing software · Anstrex · Meta Ads Library · Google Sheets · 
 · AI tools

If you use other tools that help you create better or faster, we're always open to that as well.



What you can expect from us

- A small, ambitious team with open communication.

- Clear briefs, systems and expectations.

- Honest feedback and room to improve.

- Freedom to bring your own ideas and opinions.

- A team focused on both personal and business growth.

- The opportunity to learn more about direct-response marketing.

- A long-term opportunity to grow your responsibilities and impact with the business.



Compensation

We believe good work should always be rewarded fairly.

Compensation will depend on your experience, editing skills, previous work and the value you can bring to the business.

The exact rate will be discussed together with you, with the goal of finding fair compensation that feels right for both sides.



Interested?

Then we'd genuinely like to hear from you!

Please send us your application, but don't just send us your CV.

Tell us a little about yourself, your experience with e-commerce creatives, what kind of editing you enjoy and why you think you could be a great fit for our team.

Most importantly, send us examples of your previous work.

We'd especially like to see direct-response image ads, e-commerce creatives and any winning creatives you've worked on. If you have experience with video ads, we'd love to see those too.

If you can share performance results behind some of your creatives, even better. We'd love to hear what worked and why you think it worked.

Just be yourself and tell us who you are, what you've done and what you're looking for.

Looking forward to hearing from you!

title: E-commerce Operations Specialist — Webshop
description:
Shopify · AI Automation · Product Feeds · Technical SEO · GSC

Roots & Branches Group — Remote · Full Time · Reports to Website Manager



Who we're looking for

You're young in your career and deeply technical. You learn like a beast - hand you a tool you've never seen and you'll have it figured out by Thursday. AI genuinely excites you, and you've already been using it to do things nobody asked you to automate.

Most importantly: you think in optimisation, not in tasks. You don't just fix the broken thing. You ask why it broke, write the SOP so nobody has to think about it again, and build the check that catches it next time. You're comfortable enough with SQL and data that you can answer your own questions instead of asking someone to pull a report.



Who we are

Roots & Branches Group runs a portfolio of D2C brands - Ella Sleeps, Backerz and Fitage,  across Shopify storefronts in NL, BE, DE and FR. We're small, we move fast, and the webshop is scaling faster than the operations behind it.

Let's be honest about the job

We have a backlog. Merchant Center has store-quality issues we haven't resolved. Our Channable feeds need real attention on images and product names. Search Console is flagging things nobody has triaged. Collection-pages SEO plan have been "pending" for months. Microsoft Clarity is installed but not configured.CRO roadmap is just a desire.

None of this is glamorous, and all of it is costing us money right now.

That's the opportunity. You'd walk into a defined, visible list where every item you close has a number attached. And you'd own it - not wait to be assigned tickets.



What you'll own 

Product feeds and merchandising

Google Merchant Center health across four markets, Channable feed rules, Shopping image selection, product listing structure, feed completeness for DE and FR.

Technical SEO

Search Console triage, schema markup including localised schemas, internal linking between collection pages, on-page fundamentals across the blog and landing pages.

Shopify site operations

Making sure website is functioning as it should and up to date with promotional periods. Collection, landing pages, policies, payment options etc



Tracking and analytics

GA4, server-side tracking, Microsoft Clarity, Triple Whale dashboards. You'll QA Intelligems A/B tests and validate that what works so we can discuss next steps accordingly.

Lifecycle and CRO support

Klaviyo flows, back-in-stock, browse and cart abandonment. On-site quizzes and popups. Building test variants and checking they fire correctly before launch.



Competitive intelligence

Automated trackng of competitor pricing, promotions and page changes. Today we do this by hand. You'll make it run itself.i

AI and automation — the part that matters most

We want recurring work to stop recurring. Feed audits, competitor monitoring, review responses, SEO research, report generation. If you can build the agent or the script that removes a weekly task permanently, that's worth more to us than the task itself.



What you'll need

Must have

Hands-on Shopify experience - not just the admin panel, but themes, apps, collections and feeds

Google Merchant Center and Search Console, at diagnostic level

Comfortable with data: GA4, spreadsheets at a serious level, and basic SQL

Proven self-teaching. Tell us something complex you learned without being taught

Genuine AI fluency - not "I use ChatGPT", but things you've actually built

Strong and direct English.

Nice to have

Channable, Klaviyo, Triple Whale, Intelligems

Technical SEO and structured data

Light scripting - Python or JavaScript

Multi-market or cross-border e-commerce

What this role is not

It isn't an assistant job. No inbox management, no calendar management. 

You'll work independently on technical problems but together with our Development, Website, Google Ads and AI managers

What We Offer

- Competitive monthly salary, based on experience and level of independence.

- Fully remote and flexible work, with guaranteed EU working-hours overlap (no graveyard shifts, only evenings sometimes).

- Performance-based bonuses

- Health insurance & pension funds of an extra 80 USD after 3-months probationary

- 25 holidays per year

- A genuine growth path: as you prove yourself, more ownership and responsibility follow.

- The chance to make a visible, direct impact on the growth of multiple international brands.

- A 40-hour work week with a healthy work-life balance.

- A young, international, and ambitious team that's passionate about health, design, and building online brands.

How to Apply

To apply, please fill out the short application form: 

Note: applications will only be considered if the form is completed and the video is included. We do not want a general video. Please make one specifically why you think you are a great fit for R&B.

title: Creator Outreach & Operations VA (Part-Time, E-commerce / UGC)
description:
ChaosWorks is a creative and performance marketing agency working with e-commerce brands. We're looking for a part-time VA to manage the day-to-day work of finding, contacting and coordinating UGC creators across our clients.



You'll report to our Creative Ops Manager, who will give you the briefs, creator requirements, budgets and priorities. You'll do most of the hands-on research, outreach and follow-up, keeping each collaboration moving from first contact to content delivery.



The role starts at 20 hours per week, with the option to grow into a full-time position supporting creator operations and related coordination across the agency as workload grows.



What you'll do



- Research and shortlist creators who fit each brand, brief, audience and budget. Review their previous work and keep our creator database organised.

- Find contact details, send personalised
s and DMs, manage replies and follow up consistently.

- Collect portfolios, rates and availability. Discuss deliverables and terms within the guidelines provided, and get approval before committing spend or changing an agreement.

- Coordinate onboarding, agreements, product shipping and brief delivery. Make sure creators understand what they need to submit and by when.

- Track deadlines, check in with creators and flag delays early. Arrange replacements with the Creative Ops Manager when needed.

- Collect footage, check it against the delivery checklist and organise files for the creative team. Relay feedback and follow up on revisions or missing assets.

- Keep records of creator fees, agreed usage rights, invoices and payment status, and pass payment requests to the team for approval.

- Maintain clear updates on outreach, booked creators, expected deliveries and anything that needs a decision. Build relationships with reliable creators for future projects.



Experience we're looking for



- At least one year of hands-on creator or influencer outreach and coordination experience for an e-commerce brand or an agency serving e-commerce clients. This experience is required.

- Experience taking collaborations beyond the first message: agreeing the details, coordinating briefs and following through until content is delivered.

- Strong written English and confidence communicating professionally with creators.

- Good judgement when reviewing UGC portfolios for product-focused video ads, plus familiarity with deliverables, turnaround times and content usage rights.

- Strong organisation and consistent follow-through across several creators and client projects at once.

- Comfortable with Google Sheets, Google Drive, Slack and project-management tools. We'll show you our internal systems.

- A reliable computer and internet connection.



Hours and pay



- Fully remote, Philippines-based.

- Part-time: 20 hours per week, normally spread across Monday to Friday so creator conversations keep moving.

- US$500 per month for 20 hours per week.

- Daily working hours and overlap with the Creative Ops Manager will be agreed before starting.

- Potential to move full-time, with hours and pay reviewed together based on performance and agency needs.



How to apply



Please use "Creator Operations VA" as your application subject and include:



1. A short summary of your creator-management experience, including the types of e-commerce brands or agencies you've supported and the stages you personally handled.

2. One example of a collaboration you managed from outreach to delivery. Include how you handled a delay, a non-response or a revision request.

3. An anonymised example of an outreach message or creator tracker you've used. Please remove confidential information.

4. Your CV, earliest start date, confirmation that US$500 per month for 20 hours per week works for you, and availability in Philippine time. Let us know whether you'd be open to full-time work later.



Please keep your application specific to your experience with creators. A short, relevant application is plenty.

title: SOFTWARE ENGINEER, SALESFORCE
description:
POSITION SUMMARY



The Software Engineer is responsible for developing, supporting, and continuously improving the business applications that run on our Salesforce platform - custom Apex, Lightning, and automation built around them. 

The position is a primary engineering resource for our Salesforce org. It uses modern AI-assisted development tools, including Cursor and agentic coding workflows, to build, extend, and improve the system quickly.



TYPICAL DEVELOPMENT WORKFLOW

Ideas, feedback, and enhancement requests are captured as issues in Linear. That work is built and tested in a Salesforce sandbox using AI-assisted tools, then deployed to production through source-controlled releases. When work ships, the loop closes in Linear, and the requesting user hears what was implemented and how it addresses their original feedback. Throughout the cycle, you share progress and outcomes in plain, non-technical language.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Salesforce Development

•Develop and maintain custom functionality in Apex, including classes, triggers, and batch, queueable, and scheduled jobs.

•Build user-facing components with Lightning Web Components and write efficient SOQL/SOSL.

•Design and maintain Flows, custom objects, fields, validation rules, and page layouts, and know when declarative tools are a better fit than code.

•Extend and customize managed packages, including Revenova TMS and Accounting Seed, without breaking upgrade paths.

•Write well-tested, bulkified code that respects governor limits and meets or exceeds coverage standards.

•Participate in technical design and solution architecture for new applications and data models.



Application Support

•Troubleshoot production issues, debug Apex and Flow failures, and resolve defects.

•Perform root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes.

•Manage sandboxes, source control, and deployments to production.

•Monitor org health, maintain security and permission models, and reduce technical debt.

Systems Integration & Automation

•Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce and Microsoft 365/Entra, Slack, ZoomInfo, and other enterprise systems.

•Work with the Salesforce REST, SOAP, and Bulk APIs, Platform Events, and Named Credentials.

•Keep data accurate and in sync across connected systems.

AI Engineering & Continuous Improvement

•Use Cursor, Salesforce's AI tooling, and agentic coding workflows to speed up development.

•Evaluate emerging AI-assisted engineering capabilities and set secure, maintainable best practices.

•Maintain a prioritized backlog and deliver iterative improvements that raise usability and adoption.



Quality Assurance & Documentation

•Perform testing and support UAT before deployment.

•Maintain technical documentation, org configuration notes, and release history.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

•Hands-on Salesforce development experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, and SOQL.

•Strong command of Salesforce declarative tools, especially Flow, and judgment about when to use code instead.

•Working knowledge of governor limits, bulkification, the security and sharing model, and Apex testing.

•Experience deploying with Salesforce DX/CLI and Git-based source control.

•Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems through REST APIs.

•Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar.

•Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and analytical skills.

•Ability to independently manage a production org and its enhancements in a fast-paced, continuously evolving environment.

•Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate technical work into plain language.

•Comfortable using a tool such as Linear to track feedback, issues, and delivery status.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

•Salesforce Platform Developer I or II certification.

•Experience with Revenova TMS, Accounting Seed, or other logistics and accounting managed packages.

•Experience with Salesforce CI/CD tooling such as Gearset, Copado, or GitHub Actions.

•Experience with prompt engineering and agentic coding workflows.

•Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript web development outside Salesforce, including Replit.

•Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Slack, Entra, ZoomInfo, and logistics technology ecosystems.



SUCCESS MEASURES

•Reliable, secure operation of the Salesforce org and its custom applications.

•Timely delivery of enhancements and bug fixes.

•High user adoption and satisfaction.

•Reduced manual effort through automation.

•Clean, well-documented, upgrade-safe customizations.

title: Creator Outreach & Operations VA (Part-Time, E-commerce / UGC)
description:
ChaosWorks is a creative and performance marketing agency working with e-commerce brands. We're looking for a part-time VA to manage the day-to-day work of finding, contacting and coordinating UGC creators across our clients.



You'll report to our Creative Ops Manager, who will give you the briefs, creator requirements, budgets and priorities. You'll do most of the hands-on research, outreach and follow-up, keeping each collaboration moving from first contact to content delivery.



The role starts at 20 hours per week, with the option to grow into a full-time position supporting creator operations and related coordination across the agency as workload grows.



What you'll do



- Research and shortlist creators who fit each brand, brief, audience and budget. Review their previous work and keep our creator database organised.

- Find contact details, send personalised
s and DMs, manage replies and follow up consistently.

- Collect portfolios, rates and availability. Discuss deliverables and terms within the guidelines provided, and get approval before committing spend or changing an agreement.

- Coordinate onboarding, agreements, product shipping and brief delivery. Make sure creators understand what they need to submit and by when.

- Track deadlines, check in with creators and flag delays early. Arrange replacements with the Creative Ops Manager when needed.

- Collect footage, check it against the delivery checklist and organise files for the creative team. Relay feedback and follow up on revisions or missing assets.

- Keep records of creator fees, agreed usage rights, invoices and payment status, and pass payment requests to the team for approval.

- Maintain clear updates on outreach, booked creators, expected deliveries and anything that needs a decision. Build relationships with reliable creators for future projects.



Experience we're looking for



- At least one year of hands-on creator or influencer outreach and coordination experience for an e-commerce brand or an agency serving e-commerce clients. This experience is required.

- Experience taking collaborations beyond the first message: agreeing the details, coordinating briefs and following through until content is delivered.

- Strong written English and confidence communicating professionally with creators.

- Good judgement when reviewing UGC portfolios for product-focused video ads, plus familiarity with deliverables, turnaround times and content usage rights.

- Strong organisation and consistent follow-through across several creators and client projects at once.

- Comfortable with Google Sheets, Google Drive, Slack and project-management tools. We'll show you our internal systems.

- A reliable computer and internet connection.



Hours and pay



- Fully remote, Philippines-based.

- Part-time: 20 hours per week, normally spread across Monday to Friday so creator conversations keep moving.

- US$750 per month for 20 hours per week.

- Daily working hours and overlap with the Creative Ops Manager will be agreed before starting.

- Potential to move full-time, with hours and pay reviewed together based on performance and agency needs.



How to apply



Please use "Creator Operations VA" as your application subject and include:



1. A short summary of your creator-management experience, including the types of e-commerce brands or agencies you've supported and the stages you personally handled.

2. One example of a collaboration you managed from outreach to delivery. Include how you handled a delay, a non-response or a revision request.

3. An anonymised example of an outreach message or creator tracker you've used. Please remove confidential information.

4. Your CV, earliest start date, confirmation that US$750 per month for 20 hours per week works for you, and availability in Philippine time. Let us know whether you'd be open to full-time work later.



Please keep your application specific to your experience with creators. A short, relevant application is plenty.

title: Customer Support Associate (Remote)
description:
This is a fully remote position and may require shifting schedules, weekend coverage, and overtime based on business needs.



Who We Are



At Neuro, we empower better minds with innovative, science-backed formulas. Our products are accessible, portable, shareable, and designed to work fast, wherever life takes you.



We're a premium functional wellness brand helping people optimize focus, clarity, energy, and cognitive performance through clean, effective gum and mints.



Neuro has been featured by The Joe Rogan Experience, Fast Company, The New Yorker, and The Daily Beast, and our founders appeared on Shark Tank Season 11.



About the Role



We're looking for an experienced Customer Support Associate who genuinely enjoys helping people and thrives in a fast-paced environment.



This role goes beyond answering tickets - you'll be responsible for delivering an exceptional customer experience across phone,
, live chat, and social media while exercising sound judgment, solving problems independently, and representing the Neuro brand with professionalism and empathy.



The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator who can think critically, prioritize effectively, and take ownership of customer issues from start to finish. We're looking for someone who communicates naturally not someone who relies on scripted responses. Clear writing, sound judgment, and genuine empathy are far more important to us than memorizing processes.



What You'll Do

- Deliver thoughtful, empathetic, and on-brand support across
, live chat, phone, and social media.

- Resolve customer inquiries related to orders, subscriptions, shipping, billing, products, and promotions.

- Prioritize multiple customer requests while maintaining accuracy and response quality.

- Investigate issues independently and determine the best course of action before escalating.

- Take ownership of customer concerns through resolution while keeping customers informed every step of the way.

- Communicate clearly, professionally, and confidently across all support channels.

- Maintain accurate documentation, tagging, and customer records within our CRM.

- Identify recurring customer issues and proactively suggest process improvements.

- Collaborate with Operations, Fulfillment, Marketing, and Ecommerce teams to resolve customer issues.

- Assist during product launches, promotions, and seasonal volume spikes.

- Adapt to changing priorities, workflows, and support channels based on business needs.

- Use AI-powered tools responsibly to improve efficiency while maintaining personalized customer interactions.



What We're Looking For

**Required Qualifications**

- 2+ years of experience in customer support, customer success, or another customer-facing role.

- Excellent written English with strong grammar, spelling, and the ability to communicate naturally and concisely.

- Professional verbal communication skills and confidence speaking with customers by phone.

- Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to prioritize competing tasks and remain organized in a fast-paced environment.

- Demonstrated ability to work independently while knowing when to seek guidance.

- Exceptional attention to detail.

- Customer-first mindset with empathy, professionalism, and accountability.

- Comfortable switching between phone,
, live chat, and social media support depending on business needs.

- Reliable internet connection and a distraction-free remote work environment.

- Willingness to work shifting schedules and overtime when required.



**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience using one or more of the following:

- Shopify

- Gorgias

- Zendesk

- Amazon Seller Central

- TikTok Seller Center

- Skio, Recharge, or other subscription platforms

- ShipHero or similar warehouse/order management systems

- AI tools that support customer service workflows



**What Success Looks Like**

You'll be successful in this role if you:

- Deliver accurate, thoughtful, and timely responses across every customer interaction.

- Know how to balance multiple priorities without compromising quality.

- Take ownership of customer issues instead of simply responding to tickets.

- Communicate with confidence, empathy, and professionalism.

- Make sound decisions independently while recognizing when escalation is appropriate.

- Continuously look for opportunities to improve the customer experience and internal processes.

- Represent the Neuro brand with every interaction.



**Why You'll Love Working at Neuro**

- Fully remote work environment.

- Opportunity to grow with one of the fastest-growing functional wellness brands.

- Collaborative, supportive, and high-performing team.

- Work that directly impacts our customers and business growth.

- A culture that values ownership, initiative, and continuous improvement.



**How to Apply**



If you're interested in joining the Neuro team, please
 the following to 

- A PDF copy of your resume.

- A 1–2 minute video introduction (Loom, Google Drive, or another shareable link) telling us a little about yourself, your customer support experience, and why you're interested in joining Neuro.

- Your response to the customer scenario below.



Customer Scenario



A customer
s the following:



Subject: Subscription Charge



Hi,



I was charged for my Neuro subscription again, but I was sure I canceled it last month. I'm pretty frustrated because I wasn't expecting this charge. Can you please refund me and let me know what happened?



Thanks.



Please draft the
 you would send to this customer.



**** We're looking for your natural communication style, problem-solving approach, and ability to deliver a thoughtful customer experience. Please complete this exercise using your own words.



 Subject Line



Rockstar CS – [Your Full Name]



***Please Note***

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Due to the high volume of applications, only candidates selected to move forward in the interview process will be contacted.

title: FULL-TIME VIDEO EDITOR (ECOMMERCE ADS) | LONG-TERM | PAID TRAINING + ECOM TALENT COURSE
description:
FULL-TIME VIDEO EDITOR (ECOMMERCE ADS) | LONG-TERM | PAID TRAINING + ECOM TALENT COURSE



READ THIS FIRST

We only review applicants who fill out our application form (link at the bottom).

We don't answer OJP messages. If you skip the form, we won't see your application.



WHO WE ARE

We're a small, fast-growing ecommerce company running two brands: one sold in

Europe and one sold in the US. Every month we spend serious money on
 and

Instagram ads, and video ads drive most of our growth.



Our team is small, remote and stable. Everyone on it has been with us for 1.5 years or

more. We don't hire for projects. We hire people we want to keep for years.



THE ROLE

You'll edit video ads for both brands, full time.



- Each week you get clear written briefs with the script, the hooks, reference ads and

  notes on exactly what to make.

- You turn each brief into finished ads, usually in several versions (different hooks,

  different lengths) so we can test what works.

- You work next to our current editor, so you're never figuring things out alone.

- You see the results. We run every ad and track which ones win, and part of your pay

  is tied to that.



Some of our ads are in German. You don't need to speak it: every German ad comes with

an English version of each line.



WHAT YOU GET

- Paid training: $7/hour for your first 14 days (about $1,200/month full time).

- After training: $8/hour (about $1,390/month).

- Performance bonus on top, based on the ads you produce. We share the details during

  the interview.

- Full access to eCom Talent, the most elite video ad editing course in ecommerce,

  paid for by us. You'll learn hooks, retention, pacing, statics and AI tools: the

  reasons ads work, which most editors are never taught.

- Room to grow. We run two brands, both growing, and we promote from within. Editors

  who understand why ads win move into bigger roles.

- A long-term home: full time, remote and stable.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Hunger matters more to us than your current level. If you're already great, amazing.

If you're good and determined to become great, we built this role for you.



You're a fit if:

- This will be your ONLY job. Full time, no school, no side clients. We mean this.

- You want to stay somewhere for years, not months.

- You're strong in CapCut and have a portfolio of short vertical videos (ads, TikToks,

  Reels, UGC).

- You know what a hook is and why the first 3 seconds d
 everything.

- You take feedback well and fix things fast.

- You have a reliable computer and stable internet.



Bonus points:

- You've edited paid ads for ecommerce brands.

- You've used HeyGen, Google Flow or other AI video tools.



HOW WE WORK

- Flexible hours, with a few hours of overlap each day with our team in Europe.

- A team meeting every two weeks. Attendance is mandatory.

- Briefs come in through Trello, you deliver in Google Drive, and we talk on Slack.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Fill out this form: 

2. In the form, include a Loom video (5 minutes max). Introduce yourself, show 2 or 3

   videos you're proud of, and walk us through how you made one of them.

3. Type the words HOOK FIRST as your first answer in the form. This shows us you read

   the whole post.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

1. We watch every Loom that comes in through the form.

2. Shortlisted editors get a call with us. Ask us anything, this goes both ways.

3. Final candidates get a test brief: a real ad brief, about 3 to 4 hours of work. The

   test is unpaid. If you're the editor we're looking for, you'll enjoy it.

4. We hire one editor, who starts with the 14-day paid training.

HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip this are ignored)
